triage.notes: 記事はエボラ、インフルエンザ、ハンタウイルス感染症の3疾患を述べているが、サマリーの主題はDRC及びウガンダにおけるエボラ流行。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。米国のインフルエンザジェネリック医薬品承認及びハンタウイルス患者隔離命令については米国内の政策及び個別患者事例であり、感染症流行イベントではない。シグナルトリアージはDRC側のエボラ流行に基づく。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : une église et les professionnels de santé harmonisent leurs actions contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: A church and health professionals coordinate their actions against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to kill in Ituri and the Haut-Uélé provinces in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with an outbreak declared about a month ago still active. In Bunia, at the Salema Cathedral Parish of the 80th AIC community within the Monts-Bleus diocese, ECC church leaders and health professionals reaffirmed commitment to the response after an evaluation. They plan to strengthen community sensitization and coordinate actions to bolster the Ebola fight. Mgr Théodore Katembo urged adherence to preventive measures: regular handwashing with soap, use of disinfectants, and avoiding risky contacts. Dr Kaki Kambale, ECC Health Focal Point, underscored churches’ role in risk communication and mobilization to counter rumors. He stressed that anyone with fever, vomiting, or diarrhea should be promptly referred to Ebola treatment centers, not managed at home. ECC aims to mobilize pastors, health facilities, and faithful to sustain prevention and ongoing interventions in Ituri and Haut-Uélé.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：教会と保健専門家がエボラ対策行動を調整
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の進行中アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性）に2つ以上該当。DRCでの確認されたシグナルであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年6月18日現在、DRCのイトゥリ州とオートゥエレ州においてエボラウイルス病の活動的なアウトブレイクが約1ヶ月前から継続している。記事は教会と保健専門家による対策強化の調整を報道しており、既知の進行中エボラ事案の継続報告と考えられる。社会・政治的関心が高く、国際的な支援機構の関与が見込まれる状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Mehr als 200 Ebola-Tote im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 200 Ebola deaths in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-18, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have killed 204 people overall, including two deaths in neighboring Uganda, with 894 confirmed cases (875 in Congo) and 74 recoveries. Africa CDC says the resurgence is not under control; the first month outbreak is the continent's largest by cases, about three times the second-largest. Contact tracing is severely limited: only 4,112 contacts of confirmed patients are actively followed, out of an estimated 35,000. The outbreak centers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with spillover fatalities in Uganda; authorities warn that transmission remains ongoing and containment is far from achieved.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴで200人以上のエボラ死亡者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な健康被害、異常な規模、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。エボラウイルス病は最高度の警戒対象疾患であり、複数国での活動的な感染拡大、管理不十分な接触追跡、継続的な伝播リスクが確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴでの死者204名（うち875確認例、ウガンダでの2死亡を含む）、接触者追跡の深刻な不足（35,000推定中4,112のみ追跡）、アフリカCDCが管理不十分と警告、継続的な伝播リスク存在。ウガンダはサマリー上で「隣国での流行」として言及されているが、発生地域の主体はDRCであり、同国のみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Bahrain provided critical medication to Kerala during Nipah outbreak
article.articleSummary: Kerala, India confirmed a Nipah virus case on June 11 in a 43-year-old man who remains in critical condition; no further cases have been reported and contacts’ test results are negative. Emergency stocks of Ribavirin were unavailable in India, prompting Kerala authorities to source the antiviral from Bahrain within 24 hours. The first batch of 50 vials arrived on June 14 via an emergency arrangement coordinated by state authorities, with additional consignments expected. Bahrain’s assistance enabled prompt treatment and helped sustain the response amid an ongoing Nipah outbreak in Kerala. Kerala Chief Minister V D Satheesan announced the procurement, stressing international support. As of June 18, there are no new locally acquired cases; infection is lab-confirmed, with no positive tests among tested contacts.

triage.headline_ja: ニパール発生時のケーララへのバーレーンによる重要医薬品提供
triage.triage_reason: ニパール・ウイルスの確認症例があり、国際的な医療支援が必要となった異常イベント。IHR基準では異常性と国際的関心が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度・管理可能性が該当。
triage.notes: ニパール・ウイルスは高致死率の新興感染症であり、確認症例の重症化および国際的な医療支援の必要性が生じた点が重要。バーレーンからの抗ウイルス薬調達は医療体制の限界を示唆。現在のところ接触者の陰性確認と新規症例なしという点は好材料だが、ニパール・ウイルスは散発的な発生パターンを示す傾向があり、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 200 muertos confirmados por el brote del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses 200 confirmed deaths from the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: 2026-06-18: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 202 deaths among 875 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 67 recoveries and a 23% case fatality rate. The outbreak, declared in eastern DRC on May 15, continues to unfold under Africa CDC monitoring. Wessam Mankoula, Acting Head of Africa CDC’s Emergency Preparedness and Response Divisions, told a virtual briefing that the fatalities are included in the confirmed case tally. No details are provided on infection sources, laboratory turnaround times, or imported/exported cases in the report. These figures underscore ongoing, deadly transmission in eastern DRC, illustrating the current scale and severity of the outbreak as of June 18, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ出血熱の流行で確認死者数200人の大台を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目以上に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。確認死者202人、23%の高い致命率、継続的な人-人感染の確認により、国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に東部DRCで宣言されたエボラ出血熱の流行。875例の検査確認例中202人の死亡、23%の高い致命率。Africa CDCによる監視下にあり、継続的な人-人感染が東部DRCで進行中。国際的な支援と監視体制が強化されている。

article.articleHeadline: Armed groups in Congo hinder Ebola response -- UN
article.articleSummary: Armed groups obstruct the Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with five response workers briefly detained in Ituri province, the epicenter of the outbreak, which accounts for more than 90% of confirmed cases. In South Kivu, access is heavily restricted as fighting forces civilians to flee; nearly 20,000 people were displaced on Monday after clashes in Mwenga and Shabunda. Displaced families need food, shelter, health care, safe drinking water and protection. In Fizi territory, humanitarian access remains under pressure as repeated interference threatens aid delivery and worker safety. In South Kivu, 57 incidents directly affecting humanitarians were recorded from January-May. The UN says missions continue to support authorities but cannot operate safely without security guarantees and reiterates calls to protect civilians and ensure rapid, unhindered access. Ebola’s first outbreaks were in 1976 in Nzara (South Sudan) and Yambuku (DRC near the Ebola River).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの武装勢力がエボラ対応を妨害 -- 国連
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認事例が確認されており、IHR基準の重症度・異常性・国際拡大リスク・公衆衛生への深刻な影響が該当。武装勢力による対応妨害により管理可能性が低下し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: DRC東部でのエボラ発生・クラスターが確認され、Ituri州が流行の中心地（確定例の90%以上）。武装勢力による対応妨害で人道的アクセスが阻害されており、国連も安全保障の保証なしに活動継続不可との声明。South Kivu州でも2024年1月5月間に人道支援関係者に直接影響する57件のインシデント記録。歴史的背景としてエボラの最初の発生は1976年のNzara（南スーダン）とYambuku（DRC）で、本件は極めて重大。

article.articleHeadline: Donald Trump botched COVID, but his new gift to the world is an Ebola outbreak - NJTODAY.NET
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) is not contained and is growing; the official count stands at roughly 1,000 suspected cases, with about 250 deaths, and the virus has crossed into Uganda. Bunia, the provincial capital, faces a near-total flight ban; commercial and humanitarian flights are largely blocked, hindering supplies, testing equipment, and staff. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected bodily fluids; it is not airborne, though aerosol-generating procedures require N95 respirators, given a 50% case fatality rate. Full PPE (double gloves, gown, waterproof apron, face shield, boot covers) must be donned for suspect cases and doffed under supervision; any exposure triggers immediate reporting—never wait for lab confirmation. Aid groups operate with limited access. The U.S. policy reduction—CDC rapid-response, withdrawal from WHO, and abolition of USAID—has left global containment weaker. A Kenya quarantine/treatment facility for Americans exposed to Ebola faced court challenges and protests, undermining containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ドナルド・トランプはCOVIDを失敗させたが、世界への新しい贈り物はエボラ流行である
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大の明確な証拠、渡航制限実施）。エボラ出血熱で死亡率50%、1,000疑似症例、250死亡、複数国への拡大が報告されており、即時的なフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRC（Ituri州、Bunia）が発生地であり、ウガンダへの越境例が明記されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。ケニアの隔離施設言及はあるがケニアでの発生ではないため除外。死亡率50%、ヒト-ヒト接触感染、複数州での確認、飛行禁止措置により多国籍な関心が喚起されている。CDC体制縮小等の政策的背景も記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Is this how the COVID-19 virus jumped from bats to people? | Medical News Bulletin
article.articleSummary: A single amino acid substitution in the Orf9b protein is described as a key factor enabling SARS-CoV-2 to transition from a bat coronavirus to a human-adapted pathogen. Researchers from UCSF and Mount Sinai compared SARS-CoV-2 with BatCoV RaTG13, which shares 96% genome identity with SARS-CoV-2, and found that this tiny change governs whether the virus can replicate efficiently in humans while evading the immune response. The May study in Cell Host & Microbe supports the idea that small genetic tweaks can drive a bat virus to spill over into people, contributing to a pathogen estimated to have caused as many as 15 million deaths worldwide. Past spillovers include SARS-CoV-1 from Guangdong Province, China (2002) and MERS-CoV from Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (2012). The work aims to inform an early warning system by identifying risky bat viruses.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19ウイルスはどのようにコウモリから人間へ飛び移ったのか？ | Medical News Bulletin
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は歴史的な感染症イベント（2002年SARS、2012年MERS）の科学的メカニズム解析であり、現在の発生地での新規アウトブレイクを報告するものではない。学術的な研究内容であって、現時点での感染症危機を示すシグナルではない。
triage.notes: 記事は過去のSARS（2002年広東）とMERS（2012年ジェッダ）の歴史的事例を言及しており、中国が対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めたが、本記事自体は現在の新規アウトブレイク報告ではなく、ウイルスの起源と進化に関する学術的研究である。シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists say current Ebola strain came from wildlife into human population
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola Virus outbreak in DRC and Uganda is linked to a fresh wildlife spillover. Congo reports more than 800 confirmed cases and 196 deaths; Uganda 19 confirmed cases with 2 deaths. Outbreak declared May 15. Genomic analysis shows the Bundibugyo Ebola Virus strain is genetically distinct from past Uganda (2007) and DRC (2012) outbreaks, ruling out long-standing human transmission. The eastern Congolese provinces of Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu are affected, with Ituri accounting for about 95% of cases. Cross-border collaboration between Uganda's Health Ministry's Department of National Health Laboratory and Diagnostic Services and Congo's Institute National Biomedical Research supports surveillance, hospital preparedness, and protection of border communities.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者、現在のエボラ株は野生動物から人間集団への感染と指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。DRC・ウガンダでの確認症例800以上、死亡196例という深刻な公衆衛生影響、新規の野生動物由来スピルオーバー（異常・予想外）、国際境界での拡大、渡航制限のリスク。スクリーニング基準も複数該当し、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）での症例も報告されているが、Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUgandaが含まれているものの、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。DRC は対象国リスト（203312）に含まれるため追加。ゲノム解析により新規の野生動物由来スピルオーバーが確認され、過去の流行との区別が明確。5月15日に宣言された公式なアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 200 mortos por ebola na RD Congo quase um mês após início da epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 200 dead from Ebola in DR Congo nearly a month after the outbreak began.
article.articleSummary: On 18 June 2026, Africa CDC reported >202 deaths and 875 confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, yielding a 23% case-fatality rate, about one month after the outbreak's declaration. The figures show ongoing transmission and a substantial mortality burden. The report provides a succinct update on counts but does not specify outbreak locations within the DRC, laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or any imported/exported cases. The data underscore the continued public health impact of the Ebola outbreak in the country and the need for sustained surveillance and response efforts. Updates are from Africa CDC as of 18 June 2026. No details on vaccination campaigns or control measures are provided.

triage.headline_ja: RD コンゴでエボラにより200人以上が死亡、流行開始から約1ヶ月後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（202死亡、875確定患者、23%の致命率）、国際的拡大リスクが明確に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（高い死亡率）、流行しやすさ（継続的な感染伝播）が該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は既知の高リスク病原体。DRCでの継続的な感染伝播（875確定患者）と高い致命率（23%）は、Africa CDCからの公式報告に基づいている。流行開始から約1ヶ月での202死亡は、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威を示唆。国際的な支援と監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: PT Vale edukasi pencegahan DBD bagi masyarakat di Desa Puubenua Kolaka
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PT Vale educates the community on dengue fever prevention in Puubenua Village, Kolaka.
article.articleSummary: PT Vale Indonesia Tbk, through its Indonesia Growth Project Pomalaa, conducted dengue fever prevention and management education in Puubenua Village, Baula District, Kolaka Regency, Southeast Sulawesi. Health Educator Mokhammad Syifak stated the outreach is part of the company’s social-environment program aimed at reducing dengue case fatality by empowering communities to act. Puubenua’s proximity to forests and plantations is noted as high-risk for Aedes transmission. The program cites a prior drop in dengue fatalities by about 0.4 percentage points and targets further reduction in 2026 via extensive awareness. Families are urged to seek early care at the local puskesmas (community health clinic) when dengue-like symptoms appear to prevent severe illness. In addition to dengue, PT Vale delivered PHBS (Clean and Healthy Living Behavior) education. Baula Health Center Chief Sukmawati praised the collaboration, and Baula District Secretary Asdimansyah Muis called for continued outreach to other villages as of 18 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: PT Valeがコラカ県プウベヌア村でデング熱予防教育を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は企業による予防啓発活動の報道であり、デング熱の異常発生、重症例の集中、国際的拡大の兆候を示していない。既知の地域で進行中の通常の予防活動を記述しており、新規のシグナルに該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の予防啓発キャンペーンについての報道であり、新規患者集団発生、未知のアウトブレイク、または異常な疾病パターンを示していない。インドネシアではデング熱は地風土病であり、企業による継続的な予防教育は通常の公衆衛生活動である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Следы древнейшей в истории эпидемии чумы нашли в Сибири
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Traces of the oldest plague epidemic in history were found in Siberia
article.articleSummary: Ancient Yersinia pestis traces found in Neolithic burials near Lake Baikal (Pribaikalye), Siberia. Russian and international researchers analyzed genetic material from four archaeological sites and detected Y. pestis in nearly 40 percent of 46 individuals from the Neolithic era. Published in Nature, the study suggests large plague outbreaks occurred well before the emergence of cities and complex civilizations. The recovered bacterial variant differed markedly from later strains, with a spread pattern that could rapidly involve whole communities despite its differences. Some Siberian samples appear older than comparable European samples, challenging the prevailing view that plague originated in Europe. The findings illuminate Eurasian population history and abrupt demographic changes in antiquity. No modern outbreaks are described; focus remains on ancient pathogen evolution and migration.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアで古代の歴史上最古のペスト流行の痕跡が発見された
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は古代遺骨から検出された歴史的なペスト菌株の遺伝学的分析であり、現代の感染症イベントではない。現在の公衆衛生上の脅威、国際的な感染拡大リスク、または渡航・貿易制限の懸念はない。
triage.notes: 本記事は考古学的研究であり、新石器時代の古代遺骨に関するペスト菌の遺伝学的分析の発表である。シベリア（ロシア領）の古代埋葬地から採取された遺骨が対象であり、対象国リストに含まれない。現代の感染症ショーシグナルではなく、歴史的な病原体進化に関する学術報告である。

article.articleHeadline: Paraíso intensifica combate ao Aedes aegypti com aplicação de fumacê em 18 bairros a partir desta sexta-feira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraíso steps up the fight against Aedes aegypti with fogging in 18 neighborhoods starting this Friday.
article.articleSummary: On June 18, 2026, Paraíso do Tocantins, Brazil, launches a heavy Ultra-Low-Volume (ULV) fogging operation to target Aedes aegypti in 18 neighborhoods (Bueno, Marista, Aeroporto, Oeste, Jardim América, Nova Fronteira, Paraíso dos Ipês, Vila Regina, Santa Clara, Pouso Alegre, Setor Sul, Nova Esperança, Novo Jardim Paulista, Vale do Araguaia, Jardim Paulista, Vila Milena, Bela Vista, Jardim Serrano). Despite the dry season, dengue, Zika, and chikungunya remain actively transmitted with persistent vector circulation. The fumigation runs during 5:00–8:00 and 17:00–20:00, using a highly effective insecticide applied as fine droplets; visible clouds may be limited, but the procedure is reported as properly executed and aimed at rapidly reducing adult mosquitoes. This emergency measure complements ongoing surveillance; residents should keep doors/windows open during spraying and continue removing water-collecting containers, as eggs/larvae/pupae are not eliminated by fumigation.

triage.headline_ja: パライーゾがデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱対策としてネッタイシマカの駆除を強化―18地区での燻蒸作業を今週金曜日から開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・トカンティンス州パライーゾで複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）に対する防除活動が報告されており、病害虫管理の実施という事実は確認されるが、新規感染症の発生報告ではなく、既知疾患の継続的な流行への対応段階であるため。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は既知疾患（デング熱、ジカ熱、チクングニア熱）の継続的流行への公式な防除対応を報告しており、新規感染症の発生やアウトブレイク宣言ではない。ネッタイシマカの活発な伝播が継続している状況が確認されるが、病原体の新規出現、重症度の変化、地理的拡大などの具体的な懸念情報は記事に含まれていない。市当局による計画的な防除活動であり、管理能力の欠如は示されていない。WPRO基準で「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するため、DISMISS ではなく WATCH 判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് 19 പേർക്ക് ഷിഗെല്ല സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shigella confirmed in 19 people in the state.
article.articleSummary: Shigella infection confirmed in 19 people across Kerala with Kozhikode district reporting the highest number (9 cases). Other affected districts include Thrissur, Kannur, Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam, Ernakulam, and Malappuram. As of 18 June 2026, total Shigella cases this year reach 186, with 110 reported in June alone. A Nipah patient remains on a ventilator at Kozhikode Medical College, and the contact list totals 104 people with no new additions. In parallel, Kerala has reported dengue (68), leptospirosis (14), malaria (4), jaundice (15), chickenpox (80), and rare detections of amoebic meningoencephalitis (1) and monkeypox (1). The report highlights Shigella as the primary outbreak driver in multiple districts while other infections are under ongoing surveillance by health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州で19人がシゲラ菌感染確認
triage.triage_reason: ケーラ州で複数の感染症が同時多発的に報告されており、特にシゲラ菌は今年186件（6月だけで110件）と急増している。公衆衛生への影響が深刻であり、スクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの疾患名リストにShigellaが含まれていない矛盾があるが、記事サマリーではShigellaが主要な報告対象である。複数疾病同時発生（Nipah、Dengue、Leptospirosis、Malaria、Varicella、Meningoencephalitis、Mpoxも検出）であり、ケーラ州は感染症ホットスポット。Nipah患者が人工呼吸器装着中であることも懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് 19 പേർക്ക് കൂടി ഷിഗല്ല സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു; ഒരാൾ സംശയ പട്ടികയിൽ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shigella confirmed in 19 more people in the state; one person on the suspected list.
article.articleSummary: As of June 18, 2026, Kerala reports a surge in Shigella infections with 19 additional lab-confirmed cases and one person on the suspected list. A case of monkey fever has been noted, with the Shigella infection confirmed in a Pulimath, Thiruvananthapuram resident. Amoebic meningitis was also reported in Thiruvananthapuram. In broader surveillance, 4 malaria, 16 elippani, and 68 dengue cases were confirmed across the state, with one dengue-related death recorded in Thrissur’s Nattika. The report emphasizes laboratory confirmation for these infections but provides no details on transmission sources, outbreak origin, or whether cases are imported or exported. No further symptoms or exposure information are included beyond the counts and the single dengue fatality.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でシゲラ菌感染が19人に追加確認、1人が疑い例リストに
triage.triage_reason: シゲラ菌感染の急増（19人の確定例）、デング熱関連死亡1名、複数の新興感染症同時発生（猿熱、アメーバ性髄膜炎）がインドで報告されており、IHR基準（異常性、公衆衛生への影響）に該当し、WPRO基準（重症度、流行可能性）を複数満たすため、フルRRA対象シグナルと判定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに記載された疾患名（Shigella、monkey fever、amoebic meningitis）とBluedot APIの記載（Malaria、Dengue）に不一致がある。サマリーの主題はシゲラ菌感染の急増であり、マラリア・デングはサーベイランス統計として言及されている。デング関連死亡1名の報告が重症度の根拠。感染源、発生源、輸入/輸出感染の別など詳細情報がないため、WPRO manageability と国際拡大リスクは「不明」と評価。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് പകർച്ച വ്യാധികൾ ബാധിച്ച് ചികിത്സയിലെത്തുന്നവരുടെ എണ്ണം പെരുകുന്നു. ഇന്ന് 19 പേര്‍ക്ക് കൂടി ഷിഗെല്ല സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു. കോഴിക്കോട്, തിരുവനന്തപുരം, കണ്ണൂര്‍, തൃശൂർ, കൊല്ലം, എറണാകുളം, മലപ്പുറം എന്നീ ജില്ലകളിലാണ് ഇന്ന് രോ​ഗം സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചത്. ജൂണ്‍ മാസത്തില്‍ മാത്രം 110 കേസുകള്‍ റിപ്പോര്‍ട്ട് ചെയ്തു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people seeking treatment for infectious diseases in the state is rising. 19 more cases of Shigella have been confirmed today. The disease was confirmed in Kozhikode, Thiruvananthapuram, Kannur, Thrissur, Kollam, Ernakulam, and Malappuram districts today. In June alone, 110 cases have been reported.
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports rising infectious-disease activity. Shigella morbidity has surged with 19 more cases confirmed today across Kozhikode, Thiruvananthapuram, Kannur, Thrissur, Kollam, Ernakulam and Malappuram, raising June totals to 110 and year-to-date to 186. Today’s district breakdown shows Kozhikode with 9, Thiruvananthapuram and Kannur with 2 each, Thrissur with 3, and one case in Kollam, Ernakulam and Malappuram. Monthly Shigella tallies are Kozhikode 33, Wayanad 18, Thrissur 9, Malappuram 14, Thiruvananthapuram 13, Kannur 7, Kollam 8, Ernakulam 2, Idukki 3, Alappuzha 3. Dengue infections rose to 68 cases today, with Thiruvananthapuram reporting the highest daily tally. Nipah: one patient discharged; three people remain under observation at Kozhikode Medical College; a Ramanattukara resident is on ventilator. No new Nipah infections; 104 contacts are being monitored (4 highest risk, 14 high risk, 86 low risk). A state-wide campaign against diarrheal illnesses runs June 16–July 31 with district-level awareness sessions.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州で感染症患者の増加が報告。シゲラ菌感染症の新規確認患者が19人増加し、6月の症例数が110件に達する。デング熱も68件に増加。ニパウイルスの患者も継続監視中。
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2項目（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準で3項目（異常性、重症度、流行可能性）が該当。複数の感染症が同時多発的に増加している異常な状況であり、ニパウイルス（高致死率）も含まれるため、シグナルとして認識し、フルRRAが必要である。
triage.notes: 記事はシゲラ菌感染症の急速な増加（6月に110件、年間累計186件）、デング熱の増加（68件）、ニパウイルス患者の継続監視（1人が人工呼吸器装着）を報告。複数の感染症が同時に増加しており、州当局は啓発キャンペーンを実施中。言語はマラヤーラム語で、地域はインドのケーラ州（南西部）。公開情報に基づくものであり、インド保健当局による監視下にある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : une paroisse catholique de Bunia durcit les mesures de prévention - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: a Catholic parish in Bunia tightens preventive measures - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola prevention measures were adopted by Notre-Dame de Annonciation parish in Nyakasanza, Ituri province, in Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, to curb the spread of Ebola virus disease. The assembly suspended baptisms, first communions, and marriage registrations and celebrations; Sunday liturgy attendance restricted, with only Sacré-Cœur and Saint-Rosaire sectors participating in the first Mass; altar servers, lectors, and choir members reduced to minimize contacts. Strict hygiene protocols include hand disinfection at entrance, offertory, and communion, plus systematic bench disinfection after each service; each sector must stock disinfectants. Sick individuals are advised to receive confessions, Eucharist, and the anointing of the sick before hospitalization. Isolated faithful can request prayers by phone or video call. Sector meetings will address Ebola exclusively, and funeral rites will be tightly controlled, with death certificates required before burial and post-funeral meals canceled to limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ブニアのカトリック教区が予防措置を強化 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生地（DRC、イトゥリ州ブニア）が確認されており、IHR基準の「異常・予想外」および「公衆衛生への影響」の該当により、かつWPRO基準で「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の発生が確認されている。記事サマリーは、DRCのイトゥリ州ブニアのカトリック教区が予防措置を強化した内容であり、エボラの流行が進行中であることを示唆。死亡例の言及（埋葬手続き）もあり、重症度の懸念あり。配信日時が2026年6月という将来日付だが、情報の信憑性確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le chef de l'OMS "a des raisons d'espérer" à Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the WHO chief has reasons to be hopeful in Bunia.
article.articleSummary: On 18 June 2026, in Ituri's Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, a new Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain raises concern. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the area, praising the Congolese authorities who have already released $20 million to support the response. While there is no licensed vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola, the WHO remains hopeful that a coordinated government–international partnership can quickly contain transmission. Emphasis is on early detection, case isolation, rapid access to care, and thorough contact tracing to halt spread. Field teams continue to identify contacts and curb transmission. Following the visit, WHO released recommendations on treatments and candidate vaccines that could be used to curb the outbreak in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：WHO事務局長がブニアでの状況に「希望の理由がある」と述べる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。新規エボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）で、WHO事務局長訪問、国際パートナーシップの必要性が明記されており、シグナルとしてフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 新規エボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo株）がコンゴ民主共和国東部イツリ州のブニアで報告。ライセンス済みワクチン・治療法がない株であること、WHO事務局長の現地訪問、政府の資金拠出（2000万ドル）、国際パートナーシップの強調など、複数の懸念要因が存在。コンタクトトレーシング・初期検出に重点が置かれており、拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie eboly: i mapy mohou zachraňovat životy
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic: maps can also save lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared in Ituri, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, on 15 April 2026, prompting a broad MSF humanitarian and medical response. Missing Maps volunteers contributed from the outset, with baseline mapping already in place months before the outbreak and further work two weeks after to focus on Mongbwalu and Bunia in Ituri, spanning roughly 22,000 km², with potential expansion as the situation evolves. New MapSwipe projects help detect changes in terrain and settlement, guiding updates to village/residential locations, housing, and ultimately individual buildings, plus road networks to improve logistics and access for health teams. Data are uploaded to OpenStreetMap to support epidemiological surveillance, logistics, and field safety planning. Cross-border collaboration extends to Uganda, where volunteers revise health-facility databases for potential cross-border cases. Hundreds of volunteers worldwide back each update, accelerating response to those in need.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：地図も命を救うことができる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行宣言であり、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高く、また国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダとの国境越え対応）が明記されている。重大な公衆衛生イベント。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダも含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥーリ州モングワル・ブニア）が主な流行地であり、ウガンダは国境越えケースの可能性の監視対象として言及されている。したがって verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。2026年4月15日の流行宣言であり、国際的なMSFおよびボランティア対応が既に展開中。

article.articleHeadline: Ученые нашли следы древнейшей в истории эпидемии чумы в Прибайкалье
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists have found traces of the oldest plague epidemic in history in the Baikal region.
article.articleSummary: Scientists in Russia and international colleagues analyzed ancient burials in the Baikal region (Transbaikal, Siberia) and detected traces of Yersinia pestis, the plague, in four sites. Genetic material was found in about 40% of analyzed bone fragments, indicating large plague outbreaks occurred more than 5,500 years ago, well before cities and civilizations. The pathogen sequence differs from later strains, as reported in Nature. The findings imply plague pandemics emerged far earlier than previously thought and suggest the Black Death may have had non-random patterns, with medieval analysis indicating heightened vulnerability among young people and those with serious health issues or childhood malnutrition. The study highlights ancient pathogens and raises questions about the origins and spread of pandemics in Eurasia.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者がバイカル地域で史上最古のペスト流行の痕跡を発見
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は5,500年以上前の古代のペスト流行に関する考古学的研究報告であり、現在の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。現在発生している感染症イベントではなく、歴史的な微生物遺伝子の分析結果の報道である。
triage.notes: 本記事は古代歴史に関する考古学的発見であり、現在のアウトブレイク情報ではない。Bluedot APIが付与した地域情報（タイ、ロシア）は古代遺跡の所在地であり、現在の感染症イベント発生地ではない。シグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Un mois après le début de l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC, le bilan dépasse les 200 morts (Africa CDC)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One month after the start of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, the death toll has surpassed 200 (Africa CDC).
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 200 confirmed deaths, a little over one month after it was declared in the region. Africa CDC, the African Union's health agency, announced the figure on June 18, 2026. The outbreak is centered in the northeast part of the DRC, with laboratory-confirmed deaths contributing to the tally. The visible portion of the article ends with the fragment 'Les tests en ...', and no additional details are provided in the excerpt. No further data on symptoms, case counts by date, infection sources, or exported/imported cases are included in the available text.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでのエボラ流行開始から1ヶ月、死者数が200人を超える（アフリカCDC）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認死亡者200人超は深刻な公衆衛生影響であり、IHR基準の「深刻な影響」「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極度に危険な病原体であり、200人超の死亡は既に大規模流行の兆候。DRCは過去エボラ流行の多発地域であり、国内医療体制の限界が懸念される。国際的なコンタジョン（伝播）リスクが極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll tops 200 in Congo outbreak, Africa CDC says
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-18, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda has killed 204 people (including Uganda) with 894 confirmed cases, of which 875 are in the DRC, and 74 recoveries. Africa CDC representative Wessam Mankoula notes this is the highest first-month case count in any Ebola outbreak, about three times larger than the second-largest in the same period. He warns of poorly tracked contacts, with only 4,112 contacts of confirmed patients currently under active monitoring, far short of the roughly 35,000 that should be tracked. Authorities are thus far from having the situation under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者200人以上、コンゴでの感染拡大がアフリカCDCの発表で明らかに
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルスの大規模outbreak（204人死亡、894確定患者）であり、公衆衛生に深刻な影響がある。初月としては過去最大の発生であり予想外である。隣国ウガンダへの拡大が既に発生し、国際的拡大リスクが高い。接触者追跡の不十分さから国境管理困難となり、国際的な渡航・貿易制限リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCが明確に主要発生地であり、アフリカCDCによる公式発表の情報。初月での過去最大発生数（3倍規模）と接触者追跡の大幅な不足が管理可能性の深刻さを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情肆虐奪逾兩百命　致死率達23%無疫苗 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Ebola outbreak ravages, killing more than 200 people; fatality rate reaches 23% with no vaccine - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is battling a new Ebola outbreak as of June 18, 2026, driven by Bundibugyo strain. In just over a month, the outbreak has claimed 202 lives and infected 875 people, producing a case fatality rate of 23%. Africa CDC and WHO warn that contact tracing is lagging as security instability and limited transport hinder access for responders. The Red Cross says the outbreak, declared on May 15, may not peak for a year. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC's history. There is currently no approved vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo strain. The hardest-hit northeastern provinces Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu have long suffered armed conflict and mass displacement, complicating surveillance and care. The outbreak has crossed borders into Uganda, with 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, mostly travelers from Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ疫情が猛威を振るい200人以上が死亡；致死率は23%でワクチンなし
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準5項目すべてにも該当。致死率23%の高い重症度、確認された国際拡大（ウガンダへの越境）、ワクチン・治療法なしの管理困難性により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも確認されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでの発生。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。17回目のエボラアウトブレイク、Bundibugyo株、ワクチンなし、セキュリティ不安定性による対応困難、武装紛争地域での発生という複合リスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se esconde no sistema nervoso central, descobre estudo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola hides in the central nervous system, study finds.
article.articleSummary: Brain organoid models show Ebola and other filoviruses can replicate up to 120 days in tissue resembling the human brain, infecting neurons, astrocytes and microglia. The immune response rises but fails to clear the persistent infection, suggesting local inflammation linked to survivors’ meningitis, encephalitis, or ocular inflammation after illness. Mutations in Ebola genomes appeared in persistent organoid infection, though causality with patient persistence remains uncertain. Researchers urge broader studies of filoviruses—including Reston, Taï Forest, Bombali and Bundibugyo—to understand persistence in privileged sites. Outbreak context: Bundibugyo Ebola strain driving transmission in the DRC and Uganda. As of June 16, DRC reports 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (CFR 23.1%), with 40 new cases in 24 hours; Uganda has 19 cases and 2 deaths (CFR 15%). WHO declared a PHEIC in mid-May; risks are high for neighbors, high within DRC, and low globally. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976 and the third PHEIC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが中枢神経系に隠れることを研究が発見
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。進行中のBundibugyo Ebolaアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）とWHO PHEIC宣言により、高いシグナル価値を有する。
triage.notes: 記事はBundibugyo Ebolaストレインによる進行中のアウトブレイクを明示。DRC：875確認症例、202死亡（CFR 23.1%）。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、記事の主題はDRCでの流行であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに未含有のため除外。研究データは中枢神経系での長期感染の可能性を示唆し、後遺症リスク増加を示唆する重要な知見。

article.articleHeadline: Les chercheurs français face au hantavirus et à Ebola : " Les épidémies nous apprennent "
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: French researchers face hantavirus and Ebola: "Epidemics teach us."
article.articleSummary: France confronts hantavirus and Ebola outbreaks as researchers summarize the surveillance and response. In France (Jan–Mar 2026), 19 confirmed hantavirus infections were recorded; an Andes hantavirus outbreak on a cruise ship caused three deaths and about 40 people quarantined. Hantaviruses are rodent-borne and worldwide, with European circulation of Puumala, Seoul, and Tula strains and relatively low fatality; transmission is mainly by inhalation. On the ship, the attack rate remained under 10% and the case-fatality among exposed reached 25%. Separately, Ebola is causing a severe outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with ~220 deaths and over 900 suspected cases; the Bundibugyo strain currently lacks approved therapy or vaccine. France emphasizes decentralized field diagnostics, rapid testing, isolation of the ill, and learning from international research collaborations, noting a patient in Paris no longer contagious after weeks in intensive care.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスとエボラに直面するフランス研究者：「流行から学ぶ」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（重篤性：エボラで死亡220例・疑似症例900例以上、異常性：フランスでのハンタウイルス集団発生は予想外、国際的拡大リスク：クルーズ船での感染拡大、渡航制限リスク：パリで患者確認）。WPRO基準でも複数該当し、国際的関心が高い。DRC のエボラ流行は深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: 記事はフランスのハンタウイルス事例とDRCのエボラ流行の両方に言及しているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。フランスはEU国で対象外。DRCでのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株、死亡220例、疑似症例900例以上、治療法・ワクチンなし）が主要な懸念。クルーズ船での感染（致命率25%、隔離40名）はハンタウイルスの国際的拡大リスクを示す。

article.articleHeadline: Un mois après le début de l'épidémie d'Ebola en RDC, le bilan dépasse les 200 morts : Actualités
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One month after the start of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, the death toll exceeds 200: News
article.articleSummary: One month into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, lab-confirmed cases total 875 with 202 deaths in DRC since the May 15 declaration (case fatality rate ~23%). In neighboring Uganda, 19 cases have been confirmed, including two deaths. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. The epicenter is Ituri Province in northeast DRC, a region challenged by insecurity and poor road access, hampering response efforts. Africa CDC warns of weak contact tracing in parts of DRC amid security/access constraints, while NGOs report gaps in the response. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; risk is very high in DRC, high regionally, and low globally. Ebola transmission occurs through close contact with bodily fluids, with a cumulative global toll exceeding 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past five decades.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行開始から1ヶ月、死亡者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の確認患者875名、死亡202名の深刻な公衆衛生影響。Bundibugyo型は予防薬・治療薬なし。WHO PHEIC宣言、隣国ウガンダへの国際的拡大。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み。ウガンダでも19確認例と2死亡が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRC。Bundibugyo型による流行で有効ワクチン・治療法なし。Ituri州の不安定な治安と悪路が対応を妨げている。Africa CDCが不十分な接触者追跡を警告。5月15日から流行開始で約1ヶ月経過した時点での報告。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ebola, Muyaya réprouve l'alarmisme de certaines ONG pour lever des fonds | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ebola: Muyaya condemns the alarmism of certain NGOs to raise funds.
article.articleSummary: As of June 18, 2026, the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo is defended against NGO alarmism by Minister of Communication and Media Patrick Muyaya, who decries reports he says aim to raise funds rather than accurately reflect field conditions. He acknowledges ongoing challenges but argues the international narrative does not faithfully portray realities in Ebola-affected zones. Muyaya cites a recent visit by WHO Emergency Programme Director Dr. Michael Ryan Chikwe to the area, using it to illustrate government and partners’ commitment to patient care, contact tracing, and frontline support. He commends the daily work of the Ministry of Health, the WHO, Africa CDC, and other partners. Separately, new sanitary-control corridors are now operational at N'djili International Airport to bolster traveler surveillance and early detection of suspected Ebola cases, as part of broader containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | エボラ：ムヤヤが資金調達を目的とした特定のNGOの扇動的言動を非難
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準は2つ以上該当する可能性があるが、記事の主題はエボラ対応の政治的議論であり、新規の疾患クラスター報告や深刻な公衆衛生上の新展開ではない。継続的な対応状況の監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応について、NGOの報告姿勢を政府が批判する政治的議論である。既知の流行の継続的対応段階であり、新規の急性悪化やクラスター報告ではない。ただしエボラの継続的発生と感染追跡努力、空港での衛生管理強化が述べられており、流行の継続を確認できる。IHR基準は『深刻な公衆衛生影響』でYes、『異常/予想外』はNo（既知の流行内）、『国際的拡大リスク』はNo（記事内に明記なし）、『渡航・貿易制限リスク』はNo（監視強化のみ）。WPRO基準では『長期曝露』『流行しやすさ』『管理可能性』でYes。社会的・政治的関心は高いが、情報が政治的議論に偏向しており、フルRRA前に続報による事態確認が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Perché i vaccini esistenti non funzionano contro questa epidemia di Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why existing vaccines do not work against this Ebola epidemic.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo highlights limits of current vaccines. Ervebo, based on Zaire ebolavirus glycoproteins, likely offers only partial cross-protection against Bundibugyo, which differs by about 35% on its surface glycoproteins. In nonhuman primates, a Zaire-specific vaccine yielded 75% survival after Bundibugyo challenge in a 2011 study, while a Bundibugyo-targeted version showed 100% protection in 2013 testing; however, WHO deems cross-protection evidence limited and inconclusive, complicating deployment amid public distrust. CEPI has funded candidates tailored to Bundibugyo glycoproteins to address this gap. Other approaches include vesicular stomatitis virus (VSV)–based vaccines, which can trigger strong immunity from a single dose but carry higher adverse-event risks and production demands, and the ChAdOx1 platform (chimpanzee adenovirus) from Oxford that may require two doses. AstraZeneca and the Serum Institute of India are advancing development and manufacture.

triage.headline_ja: 既存のワクチンがこのエボラ流行に対して機能しない理由
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイク報告。IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスクが該当し、複数基準を満たすシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイクが主題。発生地域にインドが列挙されているが、サマリー内容はDRCのアウトブレイク対応中心であり、インドは血清研究所のワクチン製造関与という文脈のみのため verified_locations から除外。2026年6月という将来日時が設定されているが、評価はイベント内容に基づく。

article.articleHeadline: ಪರಿಸರ ಸ್ವಚ್ಛವಾಗಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಮೂಲಕ ರೋಗ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಕೈಜೋಡಿಸಬೇಕು: ವೀರಶೆಟ್ಟಿ ಚನ್ನಶೆಟ್ಟಿ | Bidar: Malaria Awareness Month
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: We must join hands for disease control by keeping the environment clean: Veerashhetty Channashetty | Bidar: Malaria Awareness Month.
article.articleSummary: Bidar, India observes Malaria Awareness Month with a school- and community-focused program urging residents to prevent standing water around homes and school compounds. Senior Health Inspector Veerashhetty Channashetty emphasized that malaria is transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes, which breed in clean, stagnant water. The program, organized by the District Health and Family Welfare Department alongside district administration, district panchayat, and other health offices, aimed to raise awareness about malaria, elephantiasis (lymphatic filariasis), dengue, and chikungunya. Officials urged removal of mosquito breeding sites such as open tanks, old tires, plastic containers, and other sources of standing water. Core symptoms—high fever, nausea, chills, and headache—were highlighted, with guidance to seek free blood testing and treatment at government hospitals. The initiative targets schoolchildren to reinforce prevention during June, Malaria Awareness Month.

triage.headline_ja: 環境衛生を保つことで病気の管理に協力すべき：ビダール地区のマラリア啓発月間
triage.triage_reason: インドのビダール地区におけるマラリア啓発月間の実施報告であり、既知の流行地における定期的な公衆衛生キャンペーン。新規の流行、異常な増加、または国際的リスク拡大の兆候がない。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発・予防活動の報告であり、感染症シグナルではなく定期的な公衆衛生イベント報告。複数の媒介蚊疾患（マラリア、デング、チクングニア、リンパ性フィラリア症）が言及されているが、いずれも既知流行地でのルーチン対応。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 200 mortos por ebola na RD Congo quase um mês após início da epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 200 died of Ebola in DR Congo, nearly a month after the outbreak began.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 June 2026, Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) have reached 875 laboratory-confirmed cases and 202 deaths, according to the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC), the health arm of the African Union. The case-fatality rate is about 23%. Africa CDC notes the outbreak began a little over a month earlier, indicating sustained transmission within affected areas. The report provides the counts and mortality but does not specify provinces, transmission chains, or infection sources beyond the confirmed case tally. The update signals ongoing spread of Ebola in the DRC and reflects a substantial burden on communities and health systems, with regional public health authorities continuing to monitor and respond under Africa CDC coordination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス病により200人以上が死亡、流行開始からほぼ1ヶ月経過
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。確認症例875件、死亡202件（致命率23%）と重大な公衆衛生影響があり、持続的な感染拡大が進行中。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラウイルス病の継続的な流行。Africa CDCによる正式な統計情報に基づいており、確認症例875件、死亡202件、致命率約23%。流行開始から1ヶ月強で継続的な感染拡大を示唆。高度の緊急性に相当する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Butembo : PAM rassure la contribution alimentaire aux cas suspects et confirmés - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Butembo: WFP reassures about food assistance for suspected and confirmed cases - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Butembo, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with World Food Programme (WFP) food assistance reassurances for suspected and confirmed cases in Ebola treatment centers (CTEs). Butembo operates two CTEs—Katwa health zone and Butembo health zone—each reporting 25 confirmed cases, totaling 50 in the city. WFP’s support targets patients, their families, and quarantined contacts to stabilize individuals and enable medical follow-up. Authorities link the surge to increased movement between Nord-Kivu and Ituri, the epicenter of the 17th Ebola outbreak. A mother and her baby tested positive and were reportedly extracted from a local medical facility by unidentified men; they are currently being sought by health services. The urban authority expressed gratitude to WFP for the nutritional support essential to care and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボのエボラ出血熱：WFPが疑い例および確定例への食糧支援を確認 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国ブテンボにおけるエボラ出血熱の確定例50件報告は重大な公衆衛生上の影響であり、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを持つ。スクリーニング基準も全て該当し、医療施設からの患者逃走など管理の課題も明白。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月18日配信（将来日付）。ブテンボ（北キブ州）での確定例50件、17次エボラアウトブレイク関連、医療施設からの患者逃走、キブ州とイトゥリ州間の移動増加など複数の懸念要因あり。WFPの国際支援関与も社会政治的関心の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll tops 200 in Congo outbreak, Africa CDC says
article.articleSummary: On 18 June 2026, Africa CDC reported an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with more than 200 deaths, rising to 204 when including neighboring Uganda. A total of 894 confirmed cases have been identified, 875 of them in the Congo, with 74 recoveries. Health authorities warned the situation is far from under control. Monitoring gaps are stark: only 4,112 contacts of confirmed patients are currently being actively watched, far short of an estimated 35,000 contacts that should be monitored. The outbreak’s first-month case count is the highest on record for Ebola, and the current total is about three times larger than the second-largest outbreak in the same period. The Uganda component contributes to the overall toll, underscoring cross-border transmission concerns.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の死者が200人を超える、コンゴでの感染拡大をアフリカCDCが報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤で致死的、記録的規模の感染拡大、国境を越えた伝播を示すウガンダへの拡大により、国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。ただしサマリーで国境を越えた伝播が述べられており、DRCでの大規模感染の確認と合わせてリスク評価は極めて高い。監視ギャップが大きく、追跡対象の接触者が35,000人中4,112人にとどまっている点も危機管理上の懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole v DR Kongo terjala več kot 200 življenj
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo claimed more than 200 lives.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed 201 lives among 875 reported infections, yielding a case-fatality rate of about 23%, according to the Africa CDC. The figures were announced from Kinshasa, the reporting city cited in the update. The release notes ongoing efforts to curb transmission, indicating the epidemic remains active within the country. The excerpt does not provide details on specific symptoms observed, laboratory confirmation status, the source of the infection, or any information on imported or exported cases. The headline emphasizes that the death toll has surpassed 200, underscoring the continued public health impact of this Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行がコンゴ民主共和国で200人以上の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）し、死亡201件・感染875件の大規模流行であるため、フルRRA対象シグナル。
triage.notes: 2026年6月18日現在、DRCのキンシャサを中心としたエボラ流行は201死亡875感染確認。CFR約23%。Africa CDCからの公式発表。流行は活動継続中。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事項として対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo: Mehr als 200 Ebola-Tote in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: More than 200 Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 200 deaths, with Africa CDC reporting 204 total fatalities—two linked to cases in neighboring Uganda. There are 894 confirmed Ebola cases, 875 in the DRC, and 74 recoveries. Health officials say this month’s case count is the highest ever in Africa for a single Ebola outbreak, with three- to fourfold higher numbers than the second-highest outbreak on record. A critical concern is weak contact tracing: only 4,112 contacts of confirmed patients are being actively followed, while authorities estimate about 35,000 contacts may exist. Africa CDC Director Wessam Mankoula cautioned that the situation remains far from under control. Germany has pledged €13 million to aid containment, with Federal Development Minister Reem Alabali Radovan voicing deep concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で200人以上のエボラ死亡者
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で200人以上の死亡が報告され、IHR基準4項目すべて該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当し、国際的な支援を必要とする緊急のシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの限定的な拡大（2例）が報告されているが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国の大規模流行。接触者追跡が極めて不十分（4,112/推定35,000）で、制御不能のリスクが高い。ドイツを含む国際的な支援体制が既に構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémia eboly v Konžskej demokratickej republike si za mesiac vyžiadala už viac ako 200 obetí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has already claimed more than 200 victims in a month.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed more than 200 lives in just over a month since its May 15 start. Africa CDC reports 202 deaths out of 875 laboratory-confirmed cases (about 23% fatality). Surveillance is hampered by security issues and restricted access, complicating contact tracing in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. The International Red Cross warns the outbreak has not peaked and could take up to a year to control. The strain is Bundibugyo, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. The epidemic has also reached neighboring Uganda, with 19 cases and 2 deaths, predominantly among travelers from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が1ヶ月で200人以上の死者を出した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という高致死性病原体の大規模流行、国境を越えた拡大（ウガンダで確認）、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に追加しない。記事サマリーから確認できる重要な情報: 確認病例875例、死亡202例（約23%の致命率）、Bundibugyo株（ワクチンなし）、セキュリティ問題による防疫阻害。1年以上の流行継続が予想され、管理困難性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Över 200 dödsoffer bekräftade i ebola i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 200 Ebola deaths confirmed in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of June 18, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces an Ebola outbreak. Official figures list 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths, a case fatality rate of about 23%. Underreporting is suspected, and the outbreak may have been underway longer than the CDC’s mid-May confirmation. The current outbreak concerns the Bundibugyo variant of the Ebola virus disease. The report notes that the official toll may underestimate the true scale, suggesting surveillance gaps. No details on symptoms, infection sources, or imported/exported cases are provided in this brief. The figures reflect official counts reported on Thursday and may not capture all regional transmissions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラウイルス死者200人以上が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo variant）の確認された大規模アウトブレイクで、875例の確定例、202名の死亡例（致死率23%）が報告されている。国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo variant のエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク。公式統計では875確定例、202死亡例（致死率23%）が報告されている。過小報告の疑い、監視ギャップの存在、実際の規模の過小評価の可能性が指摘されている。DRCは過去のエボラアウトブレイク経験国であり、地域内およびアフリカ大陸での拡大リスクは極めて高い。国際的な支援と強化された監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 200 muertos confirmados por el brote del ébola - Proceso Digital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC surpasses the 200 confirmed deaths from the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has 202 deaths among 875 confirmed cases, a 23% case-fatality rate and 67 recoveries, as of June 18, 2026. Ituri remains the epicenter, with 91% of cases and 78% of deaths, while the virus has spread to North and South Kivu. North Kivu shows a high fatality rate amid conflict hindering response and low contact tracing. The outbreak is the third-worst in history, behind 2014–2016 West Africa and 2018–2020 eastern DRC outbreaks, with cases up 38% since last week. It has reached Uganda, with 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, 14 imported from the DRC. Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO declared an international emergency May 17; Africa CDC/WHO launched a $518 million response plan on June 5. Transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids; fever and hemorrhagic symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ出血熱の確認死者200人の壁を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（確認死者202人、症例875人、致命率23%）で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO国際緊急事態宣言済み、国際支援体制が確立している重大事象。
triage.notes: DRC南東部Ituri州を中心とした大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク。2026年6月18日時点で確認死者202人（致命率23%）。Bundibugyo株であり有効なワクチンなし。すでにウガンダへの越境拡大あり（確認死者2人含む）。WHO国際緊急事態宣言（2026年5月17日）済み、5月18日で国際緊急事態宣言。Africa CDC/WHOが5億1800万ドルの対応計画を展開中。紛争による対応困難が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: NHM confirms seven Japanese encephalitis deaths in Assam this year
article.articleSummary: Seven people have died from Japanese encephalitis (JE) in Assam since the start of 2026, with 32 AES fatalities reported in the state as of June 17, according to NHM. Assam has accounted for about 62% of India's JE deaths since 2018 (609 of 985), while 376 JE deaths occurred in the rest of the country. JE outbreaks in India typically run May–October, peaking in July–August. NHM clarifies that JE is one cause of AES, not all AES cases are JE. NCVBDC data show Assam reporting 35 JE cases and seven JE deaths up to June 17; AES totals include 470 cases with 32 deaths. In anticipation of the peak JE season, the Assam government has strengthened surveillance, case management, hospital preparedness, vaccination coverage, and inter-departmental coordination to curb transmission and improve outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: NHM、アッサム州での日本脳炎死亡者数が今年7人と確認
triage.triage_reason: 日本脳炎の死亡例報告であり、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行性）に複数該当するが、アッサム州での通例的な季節性流行パターンの範囲内であり、国際的拡大リスクの記載がなく、社会的・政治的関心の程度も明確でない。継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 日本脳炎はインドの季節性疾患であり、毎年5月〜10月に流行、7月〜8月がピークというパターンが確立している。アッサム州が過去数年間で全国のJE死亡者の62%を占める高リスク地域であることが記載されている。アッサム州政府が監視・ワクチン接種・病院準備など対策を強化している旨が述べられており、対応能力の整備がうかがわれる。IHR基準は重症度のみで国際的拡大リスクについての記載がないため、PICKUP基準（2つ以上）に達していない。

article.articleHeadline: Emiten alerta epidemiológica por difteria en toda América: ¿qué es y cómo prevenirla?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemiological Alert Issued for Diphtheria Across the Americas: What It Is and How to Prevent It.
article.articleSummary: Diphtheria outbreak alert from the OPS across the Americas reports 163 confirmed cases in 2026: Brazil 2, Haiti 159 (including 5 deaths), Peru 2. Vaccination coverage has declined slightly, reversing prior gains and raising regional transmission concerns. Diphtheria is an acute, highly contagious infection caused by Corynebacterium diphtheriae, spread by direct contact with lesions or respiratory droplets; the respiratory form is most common and severe, risking airway obstruction, renal failure and myocarditis; about 10% die despite treatment. Prevention hinges on vaccination; 2020–2024 average was 61 cases per year across 10 countries. Chile remains diphtheria-free, but gaps persist, especially in the north, underscoring the need to bolster vaccination and surveillance. Chile’s hexavalent vaccine at 2, 4, 6 months with an 18-month booster; up to age 6 for laggards. Suspected cases require immediate isolation, rapid testing, notification, and timely antibiotics; contagiousness usually ends after 48 hours of therapy.

triage.headline_ja: 米州全域でジフテリアに関する疫学的警報が発令：それは何か、そしてどのように予防するか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、予想外の発生）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。対象国ブラジルで確認事例あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、米州全域でジフテリアの流行警報が発令。ハイチが159例（死亡5例）で最大の影響を受けているが、ハイチは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。対象国ではブラジルのみ2例確認。ペルー、チリは対象国外。スペインのカナリア諸島の記載は誤った地域タグ（スペインは対象国外）と考えられる。ワクチン接種カバレッジの低下と地域的な伝播リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Acre registra aumento nos casos de Síndrome Respiratória Grave
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre records increase in Severe Respiratory Syndrome cases.
article.articleSummary: Acre is among 14 Brazilian states with a rising Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) and a growing trend in Week 23 (7–13 June), per Fiocruz InfoGripe. Rio Branco is among 11 capitals showing increases in severe SRAG cases. The rise spans youths, adults and the elderly, linked to higher hospitalizations from respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in young children and influenza A and B in others; growth is slowing for children ≤4 years and declining for 5–14-year-olds. Fourteen states are at alert/risk/high risk with upward long-term trends; nine others have high incidence without a rising trend. Last four weeks’ positives: RSV 51.4%, rhinovirus 23.9%, influenza A 19.1%, influenza B 7.1%, SARS-CoV-2 2.2%; influenza A accounted for 43.7% of deaths. Year-to-date SRAG: 89,725 cases, 3,842 deaths; mortality concentrated in 65+, influenza A main cause; under-2s highest SRAG incidence from RSV. Vaccination: influenza vaccine for at-risk groups; vaccinate pregnant women from week 28 to protect newborns against RSV.

triage.headline_ja: アクレ州で急性呼吸器症候群患者が増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおいて14州でSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）が増加傾向にあり、RSV、インフルエンザA/Bなど複数の呼吸器病原体が検出されている。WPRO基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）に該当し、社会的関心（公開統計機関による監視報告）も認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事はポルトガル語の地域メディア（AC24HORAS）の報道。Fiocruzの疫学監視システム（InfoGripe）の公式統計に基づく報告。年間3,842死亡、89,725症例の既報告あり。RSV、インフルエンザA/Bが複合流行している状況。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるため、PICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 200 muertos confirmados por el brote del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 200 confirmed deaths in the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality 23%), with 67 recoveries. Ituri province remains the epicenter, accounting for 91% of cases and 78% of deaths, while the virus has spread to North and South Kivu. North Kivu’s conflict-related inaccessibility hampers response and coincides with the highest fatality rate and lowest contact-tracing. The outbreak has extended to Uganda, reporting 19 cases (14 imported from the DRC) and two deaths. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, which has a 30–50% fatality rate and no approved vaccine or specific treatment per WHO. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, and a June 5 plan aims to raise $518 million to support African countries. This is the third-worst Ebola outbreak in history, after 2014–2016 West Africa and 2018–2020 eastern DRC outbreaks, with transmission via direct contact and symptoms of fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic signs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の流行で確認死亡者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全て該当。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済みの重要シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大（19症例、死亡2例）が確認されているが、発生地域の主要な集中はDRCであり、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Bundibugyo株（致死率30-50%）による流行で、ワクチン未承認。WHO PHEICの宣言状態。紛争地帯（North Kivu）での対応困難が報告されている。歴史的に3番目に規模が大きいエボラ流行。

article.articleHeadline: 最新版埃博拉病毒病防控方案，对疫区来华人员有哪些防控要求
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Latest Ebola Virus Disease Prevention and Control Plan: What Preventive Measures Apply to People Entering China from Ebola-Affected Areas?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda prompted China to publish the Ebola Virus Disease Prevention and Control Plan (2026 edition). As of 2026-06-18, there are no Ebola cases in China. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak an International Public Health Emergency on May 17. The plan centers on early discovery, reporting, diagnosis, isolation, and disposal, with two-hour online reporting for suspected, contact, and confirmed cases. It expands multi-channel surveillance to international organization alerts, domestic laboratories, and aircraft wastewater testing, and requires laboratory work under appropriate biosafety levels. Emphasis is placed on epidemiological investigation and risk communication. Close contacts are identified and subjected to 21 days of medical observation, with twice-daily temperature checks; symptom development necessitates hospital transfer. Incoming travelers from affected regions undergo 21 days of health monitoring and must disclose travel history and exposure when seeking medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 最新版エボラウイルス病防控方案、疫区来華人員の防控要件はいかなるものか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言したエボラ出血熱の集団発生が対象国DRCとウガンダで報告されており、中国の防疫対応も含まれている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks are reported in DRC and Uganda. The article focuses on China's preventive measures in response to the outbreak in affected regions (DRC and Uganda). Although China is mentioned as the country implementing prevention plans, the actual disease outbreak location is DRC. Uganda is not in the target country list. DRC is the verified location where the outbreak event is occurring.

article.articleHeadline: Броят на жертвите на епидемията от ебола в ДР Конго надхвърли 200
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak in DR Congo has surpassed 200.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 200 deaths, with fatalities at 204 including Uganda. Africa CDC spokesperson Wesam Mankula said there are 894 confirmed cases, 875 of them in DR Congo, and 74 recoveries. Experts note no previous Ebola outbreak had so many confirmed cases this early, and the current outbreak is about three times larger than the second-largest outbreak for the same period. Contact tracing is a major concern: 4,112 contacts are under active surveillance, though officials estimate the true number could be around 35,000. Authorities remain far from containment, and the virus’s spread continues to pose a serious challenge.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行による死亡者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な規模、国際的拡大の実績、国際支援の必要性）。エボラウイルスによる大規模流行で死亡者200人超、確認患者894人、接触者追跡対象35,000人と極めて重大な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダが言及されているが、死亡者204人のうち203人がコンゴ民主共和国であり、実質的な発生地はDRCが中心。エボラの過去最大級の流行であり、従来同時期の流行の3倍の規模との記述から、対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll passes 200 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has killed 202 people among 875 laboratory-confirmed cases (mortality 23%) as of 18 June 2026. Declared 15 May, this is DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, spanning Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for the Bundibugyo strain. Response faces security-related access challenges; contact tracing remains low, hampering containment. The Red Cross warns the outbreak is not yet peaked and could take up to a year to contain. The epidemic has crossed into Uganda, with 19 confirmed cases and two deaths; most Ugandan cases are Congolese travellers. Africa CDC, WHO, and partners continue risk assessment and response amid ongoing outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ死者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大も記事で言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC内での発生が主題。202人の死亡、875確認症例、有効なワクチン/治療なしという重症度、セキュリティアクセス課題による管理困難性から、フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases on the rise in Kerala
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Kerala, India, shows an escalating pattern in 2026 with 3,565 confirmed and 10,428 probable cases, and 17 confirmed deaths plus 15 probable deaths. As of June 18, 2026, 105 cases were reported on Wednesday and 68 cases with one death on Thursday. Officials warn intermittent monsoon rainfall followed by warm spells could trigger a surge in vector indices, though heavy rainfall might wash away breeding sites. Kerala remains hyperendemic, circulating all four dengue serotypes; DENV-2 dominates, with notable DENV-1, and shifts to DENV-3 and DENV-4 observed in prior years. Historical context includes 2017’s outbreak (21,993 confirmed, 165 deaths; 66,329 probable) and 2023–2025 trends (2023: 16,766/153; 2024: 20,674/128; 2025: 10,865/56). Roughly 80% of infections are subclinical; antibody-dependent enhancement raises risk of severe secondary infections, underscoring need for serotype surveillance and hospital monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州のデング熱患者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（重症度、流行易性）。対象国インドでの確認事例数と死亡者数から公衆衛生への影響が明確。
triage.notes: 2026年のケーラ州デング熱は、確認患者3,565例、疑い患者10,428例、確認死亡17例、疑い死亡15例と重症度が高い。2017年の大規模流行（21,993例、165死）と比較しても継続的なリスク。モンスーン降雨と気温変化による蚊媒介指数の増加予測あり。全4血清型が循環しており、セカンダリー感染による重症化リスク（抗体依存性増強）が指摘されている。継続的な監視と対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Yli 200 on kuollut ebolaan Kongon demokraattisessa tasavallassa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 200 have died of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 202 confirmed deaths among 875 laboratory-confirmed cases, with the death toll above 200 as of mid-May 2026, when the outbreak began. The African Union health authority outlined the ongoing outbreak and warned that the peak had not yet been reached. There are no approved vaccines for this Ebola variant in the DRC. The virus has crossed into Uganda, reporting a couple of dozen infections and two deaths, most cases among Congolese travelers. The situation underscores ongoing transmission and the need for effective containment, given the absence of a targeted vaccine for this variant.

triage.headline_ja: 200人以上がコンゴ民主共和国でエボラで死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された大規模流行で、国際的な拡大が既に発生している。
triage.notes: サマリーではウガンダへの越境も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。エボラ流行は高い公衆衛生への影響を有し、ワクチン未対応の変異株であること、ピークに達していないこと、国際的拡大のリスクが高いことから、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Santos adota nova tecnologia para impedir reprodução do mosquito da dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santos adopts new technology to prevent reproduction of the dengue-carrying mosquito
article.articleSummary: Santos, Brazil, has added a new Aedes aegypti larvicide growth regulator to its vector-control program to curb dengue, chikungunya, and Zika transmission. The Health Department bought 1,000 disk-shaped devices that release a growth-regulator larvicide, designed to interrupt the larva-to-pupa-to-adult cycle. Deployment begins Friday in specially monitored properties, with teams applying the product to water-holding containers such as uncovered tanks and wells in 40–500 liter reservoirs. The regulator does not kill larvae immediately; it prevents the pupal-to-adult transition, allowing initial development but stopping adult formation. The initiative is experimental, overseen by the Center for Zoonosis and Vector Control (CCZV), and lasts up to six months, aiming to strengthen arbovirus prevention from Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: サントスが蚊由来デング熱の繁殖を防ぐ新技術を採用
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジル・サントス市における蚊媒介感染症の予防対策（新しい幼虫成長抑制剤の導入）についての報道であり、感染症の新規発生・流行を示すシグナルではない。実装段階の防虫対策プログラムであり、深刻な公衆衛生への悪影響、異常性、または国際的拡大のリスクは示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は予防対策・ベクターコントロール施策に関する情報であり、感染症の発生や流行を報告するシグナルではない。対象は新規患者発生や疾患リスクの急増ではなく、既存の蚊媒介感染症に対する技術的な対応策である。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique: L'OMS publie des lignes directrices complètes sur la maladie à filovirus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: WHO publishes comprehensive guidelines on filovirus disease.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 June 2026, the World Health Organization published its first comprehensive clinical management guidelines for filovirus diseases, covering all Ebola and Marburg viruses. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s current Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, the guidelines emphasize early, patient-centered supportive care, underpinned by 16 evidence-based recommendations. Africa has experienced about 72 Ebola and Marburg outbreaks since 1967, with fatality rates from 25% to 90% in severe episodes. There are no approved vaccines or antivirals for Marburg; for Bundibugyo and Sudan viruses, prompt supportive care remains foundational. Recommendations include prioritizing laboratory monitoring for treatable abnormalities, rapid management of dehydration (oral and IV), early use of IV fluids and vasopressors with continuous monitoring, and antibiotics for bacterial coinfections when present, plus structured survivor follow-up. For Bundibugyo virus, early identification and optimized supportive care are central and support antiviral research.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：WHOがフィロウイルス病に関する包括的ガイドラインを発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラアウトブレイクが進行中であり、WHOが臨床管理ガイドラインを発表した重要な情報である。ただし、記事の主焦点はガイドライン発表であり、新規感染数や流行の急速な拡大に関する具体的な新情報を含まないため、フルRRA段階に進む前に続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月18日時点のWHOによる新規ガイドライン発表を報じており、コンゴ民主共和国でのブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラアウトブレイク対応に焦点をあてている。WPRO基準で3つ該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。ただし、記事の主体はガイドライン発表であり、現在の流行状況の詳細（新規症例数、致命率、拡大速度等）は含まれていないため、続報による確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Another Nipah contact leaves hospital, cases under observation drop to 3
article.articleSummary: On 18 June 2026, Kerala Nipah updates show easing transmission. One more of nine hospitalised Nipah contacts at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital has been discharged after testing negative, bringing total discharged to six; three remain under observation. The Nipah patient remains on ventilator support at the Kozhikode facility. No new contacts were added on Thursday, leaving 104 people under monitoring (4 high-risk, 14 moderate-risk, 86 low-risk). Field surveillance continued in Ramanattukara Municipality’s Ward 5, with 50 households visited for monitoring and awareness as the Nipah case is tracked in the area.

triage.headline_ja: 別のニパー接触者が退院、観察下のケースが3件に減少
triage.triage_reason: ニパーウイルスの確認事例だが、記事内容は患者数の減少・退院・接触者数の減少を示しており、流行の拡大傾向は認められない。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月18日時点でのニパー患者の退院・回復を報じており、新規患者の発生や感染拡大ではなく、むしろ状況の緩和を示唆している。ただし、ニパーウイルスの人獣共通感染症としての特性、高い致命率、及び継続的な接触者監視の存在からWPRO基準2項目が該当。国内の公開情報としては関心が見られるが、国際的な拡大リスクや深刻な公衆衛生への影響は現在のところ認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolaepidemi koster over 200 livet i DR Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic costs over 200 lives in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of June 18, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 202 deaths among 875 confirmed cases, according to Africa CDC via AFP. The epicenter lies in the eastern Ituri province, with heavy impact in North Kivu and South Kivu, regions long plagued by conflict. Health authorities warn that contact tracing is limited due to security challenges and inaccessibility, hindering containment efforts. Aid groups Doctors Without Borders (MSF) and Oxfam have warned that the outbreak’s full scope remains unclear. There are severe shortages of clean water and personal protective equipment for health workers in affected areas. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids, underscoring the need for robust protection of frontline staff to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行がDRコンゴで200人以上の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。確認症例875例、死者202例の大規模流行であり、接触追跡の困難性と国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行。確認症例875例、死者202例の高い致命率。紛争地域での発生により接触追跡が困難。MSF、Oxfamなど国際的援助機関が対応中。水・防護具の深刻な不足。IHR通知要件を満たし、RRA実施対象。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Shigella cases touch 110 in June; Nipah patient remains critical
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports 186 Shigella cases this year, 110 in June, amid rising monsoon diarrhoeal disease. Shigella causes diarrhoea, fever and stomach cramps, spreading via contaminated food/water or contact with infected individuals. A statewide anti-diarrhoeal campaign runs June 16–July 31 to disinfect drinking water, monitor water quality, promote waste management, and ensure ORS and zinc at health centres and anganwadis, under the slogan 'Prevent diarrhoeal diseases, save lives.' The campaign also stresses personal hygiene and ORS preparation. In Nipah news, a positive patient in Kozhikode Medical College remains on ventilator; six of nine Nipah contacts have been discharged, three remain under observation; no new contacts were added. The Nipah list totals 104 (4 very high‑risk, 14 high‑risk, 86 low‑risk); 50 houses were visited in Division 5, Ramanattukara. Nipah is a zoonotic virus with fruit bats (Pteropus) as hosts; symptoms include fever, headache, respiratory illness and acute encephalitis, with high fatality.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でシゲラ症が6月に110例に達する；ニパウイルス患者は重篤な状態が続く
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス感染症は高い致死率を持つ人獣共通感染症で、人－人感染の可能性があり、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク・重症度）に複数該当する。同時にシゲラ症の多数例報告も加わり、シグナルトリアージの閾値を超える。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な関心はニパウイルス感染症（ケーラ州コーチン医科大学での症例、高リスク接触者の監視継続中）とシゲラ症流行の同時発生。ニパウイルスは高致死率の人獣共通感染症で、既に1患者が人工呼吸器装着中という重篤状況。シゲラ症は2026年6月単月で110例と増加傾向を示している。両疾患とも国家レベルの対応キャンペーンが展開中。

article.articleHeadline: La souche actuelle d'Ebola résulte d'une nouvelle transmission de la faune sauvage à l'homme
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The current Ebola strain results from a new wildlife-to-human transmission.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain linked to a new wildlife-to-human transmission in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda as of 18 June 2026. Genomic analyses by Uganda's Ministry of Health labs and the DRC's INRB show the Bundibugyo lineage is genetically distinct from variants behind prior outbreaks (Uganda 2007; DRC 2012). Since the outbreak declaration on 15 May, DRC has recorded over 800 confirmed Ebola cases with 196 fatalities; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases with 2 deaths. Scientists indicate the virus recently crossed from a wild animal reservoir to humans, ruling out long-standing, undetected human transmission. Emphasis on cross-border collaboration to track spread, prepare hospitals, and protect border communities with daily population movements. In the DRC, cases are concentrated in Ituri (about 95% of total) and also in North Kivu and South Kivu provinces.

triage.headline_ja: 現在のエボラ株は野生動物から人への新たな感染に由来する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たし、WPRO基準も5つすべて該当。DRC・ウガンダでの確認された死亡者を伴う多発的エボラ感染、新興の野生動物由来株、国際的拡大とその管理の複雑性が明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダ(Republic of Uganda)は発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの事例は確認されたケースとして言及されているものの、主要な感染クラスターはDRCのイトゥリ州(約95%)に集中している。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載した。DRCは対象国リストの203312に該当。新興の野生動物由来Bundibugyo株系統、確認死亡196名、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスク、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Mãe e criança de seis anos com Ébola raptadas de hospital no Congo por homens armados com facas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mother and a six-year-old child with Ebola were kidnapped from a hospital in the Congo by armed men with knives.
article.articleSummary: Mother and a six-year-old child infected with Ebola were abducted from Wanamahika Hospital in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo by armed men around 22:00 local time. The victims, initially screened in Vutike Furu, were being moved to an Ebola treatment unit in Butembo, North Kivu, when attackers blocked entry; their whereabouts and health status remain unknown, and searches continue. The incident underscores distrust toward treatment centers amid an outbreak, with North Kivu reporting 67 confirmed cases and 38 deaths as of Tuesday, while Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for over 90% of cases; more than 100 Ebola deaths have occurred in less than a month. A rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain has caused about 200 deaths and 840 cases in Africa, for which no vaccine exists. The WHO and Africa CDC have launched a 446 million euro support plan for Congo, including safe burials to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの病院からエボラに感染した母親と6歳の子どもが武装した男たちに銃剣で脅迫されて拉致される
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（稀なBundibugyo株）の活動的な流行において、患者の拉致という前例のない治安イベントが発生し、治療施設への信頼喪失と感染拡大抑制の深刻な脅威となっている。IHR基準3項目該当、WPRO基準4項目該当、国際的支援が進行中である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株はワクチンが存在しない稀なエボラ亜種であり、治療患者の拉致による失踪は感染制御の崩壊と二次感染リスクの深刻な懸念を生じさせている。WHO/Africa CDCによる4.46億ユーロの支援計画が発動中。North Kivu 67例、Ituri 90%以上（流行中心地）の集約構造が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 200 muertos confirmados por el brote del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 200 confirmed deaths from the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality rate 23%), with 67 recoveries. Ituri Province remains the epicenter (91% of cases, 78% of deaths), but transmission has reached North and South Kivu. Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases (14 imported from the DRC), including 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus is involved, with a fatality rate of 30–50% and no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The virus began circulating in Ituri about two months before the outbreak was declared in eastern DRC on May 15; the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. This is the third-largest Ebola outbreak in history. On June 5, African CDC and WHO launched a $518 million response plan. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic manifestations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ熱の流行で確認死亡者200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ熱の大規模流行で875確定症例、202死亡、既にウガンダへの国際的拡大が生じており、PHEIC宣言済み。第3位の規模を持つ流行。
triage.notes: エボラ熱のPHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。ウガンダへの拡大（19確定症例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。案件重要度は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Maintain high level of vigilance for early detection of dengue, malaria cases: Nadda to states
article.articleSummary: Centre directs states and UTs to maintain high vigilance for early detection of dengue and malaria ahead of the monsoon season, after a high-level review in New Delhi chaired by Union Health Minister JP Nadda. The directive urges strengthened surveillance systems, prompt reporting, active monitoring and rapid response to contain outbreaks. It stresses strict adherence to prevention, surveillance, diagnosis, and standard treatment guidelines and clinical management protocols for dengue and malaria. Nadda called for coordinated efforts among the Centre, states/UTs, local administrations and healthcare institutions to minimise disease burden and ensure timely public health response. Hospitals and healthcare facilities across the country should remain fully prepared, ensuring adequate medicines, diagnostic facilities, blood components, hospital beds and trained personnel. Patient care services must remain uninterrupted, with facilities equipped to manage any increase in caseload during the monsoon-driven rise in mosquito-borne diseases.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱およびマラリア症例の早期発見のための高度な警戒態勢を維持するよう要求：ナッダ氏が各州に指示
triage.triage_reason: インドにおけるデング熱とマラリアの監視強化に関する政府指示であり、既存の公衆衛生関心を反映しているが、新たな爆発的流行や重篤事象の報告ではなく、モンスーン季前の予防的対応である。スクリーニング基準での該当可能性はあるが、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本イベントは新規感染症クラスターの報告ではなく、インド政府がモンスーン季節に向けて既知の蚊媒介疾患（デング熱、マラリア）の監視強化と予防対応を各州に指示した行政通達である。デング熱とマラリアはインドで風土病であり、季節的な警戒強化は定期的な公衆衛生対応である。重症度や死亡例の報告がなく、国際的拡大リスクも示唆されていない。スクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」（モンスーン季のリスク）と「流行しやすさ」（蚊媒介感染）に該当するが、現在の実際の病例増加や異常事象の報告がないため、フルRRA前の継続的なシグナル監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberkulose: Schnelltest aus China erkennt Infektion ohne Labor - Deutsches Ärzteblatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis: Rapid Test from China Detects Infection Without Laboratory - German Medical Journal
article.articleSummary: Battery-powered rapid test from China detects Mycobacterium tuberculosis genes in sputum or tongue swab within 30 minutes, and can be operated by medical auxiliary staff. In field studies conducted in high-endemic countries across Africa and Asia, the test achieved performance comparable to the current laboratory standard.
