The findings, published in the New England Journal of Medicine (2026; DOI: 10.1056/NEJMoa2509761), prompted the World Health Organization to issue a recommendation. By enabling rapid, decentralized TB testing outside traditional laboratories, this assay could shorten time to diagnosis and treatment in resource-limited settings. The study confirms diagnostic parity with lab-based methods and supports scaling for TB control as of 2026-06-18.

triage.headline_ja: 結核：中国の迅速検査が検査室なしで感染を検出 - ドイツ医学雑誌
triage.triage_reason: これは結核の診断技術に関する医学的な前進報告であり、新規感染症の爆発的流行やアウトブレイクではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準いずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核診断技術の臨床的成功に関する医学論文報告であり、感染症アウトブレイク・流行イベントではない。フィールド研究がアフリカ・アジアで実施されたが、記事の焦点は診断技術の有効性確認であり、特定地域の結核流行のシグナルではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah: only three persons under observation at Kozhikode MCH
article.articleSummary: On 18 June 2026, Nipah updates from Kozhikode, Kerala, India, indicate only three persons from the infected patient’s contact list are under observation at Government Medical College Hospital, Kozhikode. A release from the office of Health Minister K. Muraleedharan says one more contact has been discharged after lab results turned negative for Nipah virus and symptoms subsided. So far, six of the nine identified contacts have been discharged. There are no new additions to the contact list, and the patient remains on ventilator support. The report highlights ongoing monitoring of exposed individuals and continued clinical management at the facility as officials track the outbreak. No details on the infection source or broader case numbers were provided.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス：コジコード医科大学病院で観察中の3人のみ
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高い致死率を持つ新興感染症であり、インドでの発生は異常かつ懸念事項だが、現時点では接触者の大多数が陰性化し、新規症例の追加がなく、流行拡大の明確な兆候に乏しい。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスの確定患者は報告されているが、記事では接触者の追跡と陰性化が主焦点。患者が人工呼吸器装着中である点は重症度を示唆。現時点では流行拡大の兆候がないため WATCH とした。今後の新規症例発生、感染源の特定、地域社会への拡散状況について続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: JP Nadda Reviews Dengue, Malaria Preparedness Before Monsoon
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, 18 June 2026: Union Health Minister JP Nadda chaired a high-level review of dengue and malaria preparedness ahead of the monsoon, urging central–state coordination to strengthen surveillance and vector control. He directed hospitals nationwide to ensure medicines, diagnostics, blood components, beds and trained personnel, and to follow updated dengue and malaria management protocols to reduce complications. The briefing called for district-specific micro-plans in endemic and high-risk areas, intensified source reduction, elimination of breeding sites and fogging, plus robust public awareness campaigns. Community involvement from Resident Welfare Associations, Panchayati Raj Institutions, schools and other groups was emphasized to maintain mosquito-free environments. States/UTs should intensify reporting, rapid response, and surveillance at district and municipal levels. India has reduced malaria burden by ~80% (2015–2025), exited HBHI in 2024, and 160 districts reported zero indigenous malaria in 2022–2025; dengue prevention remains a priority.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン前のデング熱・マラリア対策をナッダ保健相が検討
triage.triage_reason: 対象国インド内での公衆衛生上の重要な準備行動を報告する記事だが、新規患者発生の急増や異常な疾患活動の報告ではなく、既知のリスク（デング熱・マラリア）に対する季節的な予防措置である。記事の主眼は準備態勢の強化であり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当は判断できない。ただし対象国での重要な感染症情報のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱とマラリア（既知の風土病）に対するインド政府の組織的な準備行動を報告している。新規患者発生の急増や異常な疫学的変化は報告されていない。インドはマラリア対策で実績（2015-2025年に約80%負担削減）を示しており、現在の活動は季節的予防措置である。WPROスクリーニング基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、異常性や重症度の急増の証拠はないため、WATCH（要経過観察）判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Infosalus.- El ECDC refuerza su apoyo contra el ébola en RDC y...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infosalus.- The ECDC strengthens its support against Ebola in the DRC and....
article.articleSummary: ECDC to strengthen support against the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda with new experts to bolster response, risk assessment, and field operations. As of 18 June 2026, DRC has 381 confirmed Ebola cases and 63 deaths; a Goma photo shows an Ebola treatment center in use. ECDC Director Pamela Rendi-Wagner said EU risk assessments and guidance will be updated to improve European health security. EU health experts monitor passenger-screening at major airports in affected countries; a second EU health working group, including an ECDC expert, will reach South Sudan to bolster preparedness with emphasis on risk communication and community engagement. Three experts have been deployed rotating, a fourth is enroute, and more are expected. The probability of Bundibugyo Ebola importation into the EU/EEA remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: ECDC、DRCおよびウガンダのエボラ対策支援を強化 — 専門家を現地に派遣
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤で、複数国への拡大リスク、国際的な対応強化が認められ、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を呈している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ爆発。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーでの記述は「DRC and Uganda with new experts」と支援強化の対象国として言及され、実際の発生地はDRCが中心。South Sudanについても準備態勢強化の対象として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれず。EU/EEAへの輸入リスクは「very low」と評価されている。

article.articleHeadline: V Konžskej demokratickej republike zomrelo na ebolu už viac ako 200 osôb, hlási Africké centrum pre prevenciu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, more than 200 people have died of Ebola, according to the African Center for Prevention.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths, according to Africa CDC as of June 18, 2026, yielding a case fatality rate of about 23%. The epidemic, declared May 15, is ongoing and may take up to a year to halt, with the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies warning that it has not yet peaked. The Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment, is responsible. Cases have been detected in Ituri and North and South Kivu provinces, with cross-border spread into Uganda (19 cases, 2 deaths). Security and access constraints hinder contact tracing, complicating containment efforts, as WHO and partners remain engaged to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国ではエボラ出血熱で既に200人以上が死亡しており、アフリカ疾病対策センターが報告している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。Bundibugyo変種によるエボラ出血熱の進行中の流行で875例・202死亡（CFR 23%）、ウガンダへの越境感染（19例、2死亡）、ワクチン・治療法なし、セキュリティ制約による対応困難という重大かつ異常なシグナル。
triage.notes: Uganda への越境感染（19例、2死亡）が確認されているが、Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。Bundibugyo 変種は承認されたワクチン・治療法がなく、セキュリティと移動制限が接触者追跡を妨げている点が重大。最大1年の流行期間予想。

article.articleHeadline: Mittlerweile 875 Infektionsfälle bestätigt: Ebola-Ausbruch: Zahl der Todesopfer steigt in der DR Kongo auf mehr als 200
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Now 875 confirmed infections: Ebola outbreak: death toll in DR Congo rises to more than 200.
article.articleSummary: About a month into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the death toll has surpassed 200, with 875 laboratory-confirmed infections reported by Africa CDC. The case fatality rate stands at roughly 23%. Transmission occurs through direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected people. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, first identified in 2007; there is no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment for this strain. Control remains difficult because Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces are hard to access due to ongoing security conflicts, complicating contact tracing. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in mid-May. The limited accessibility in affected provinces hampers outbreak containment and surveillance, underscoring the need for enhanced outbreak response and safe access for health teams.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の拡大：コンゴ民主共和国での死者数が200人以上に増加、確認感染者875人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱で死亡率23%、セキュリティ問題により対応困難な状況。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月中旬にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebola virus（BDBV）は治療法やワクチンがない株。セキュリティ上の課題により、接触追跡や患者隔離が困難な状況。月初から1ヶ月で死者数が200人超に増加し、感染拡大が急速。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases increase almost 40% in a week as death toll passes 200
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola caused by Bundibugjo virus in eastern Congo and Uganda has reached 894 confirmed cases and more than 200 deaths in its first month, making it the worst known Ebola outbreak to date. About 35,000 suspected contacts are being tracked; the outbreak spans 32 health zones, with Ituri province accounting for over 90% of cases. Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and two deaths. The outbreak was confirmed on May 15, after earlier suspicion. Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccines or treatments, unlike the Zaire virus, which has a vaccine. So far 74 patients have recovered; experimental monoclonal antibodies are under development. Contact tracing is hampered by Ituri’s remoteness, insecurity, and a mass displacement of nearly a million people. Funding remains a hurdle: more than $900 million pledged, only about $90 million released; Africa CDC says 540 responders are needed, with 84 deployed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が1週間でほぼ40％増加、死亡者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模集団発生で、IHR基準4項目全て該当。確認患者894人、死亡200人超、国際的拡大（DRC＆ウガンダ）、渡航制限リスク明確。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにウガンダが含まれているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めず。DRCのみ検証対象国として列挙。初発症例確認後1ヶ月での最悪規模のエボラアウトブレーク。ワクチン・治療薬未承認のブンディブギョ型。資金不足（$900M誓約で$90M時点）が対応を制約。遠隔地・不安定地域・大規模住民移動により接触者追跡困難。

article.articleHeadline: 'I buried my parents one day after the other' - Ebola mourners learn how to grieve safely
article.articleSummary: Current Ebola outbreak in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola, which kills about a quarter of those infected, and has claimed almost 200 lives in the last few months. Transmission occurs through contact with infected bodily fluids. Traditional burials, including washing the dead, are discouraged; coffins now have transparent panels and body bags carry clear tops so mourners can see inside while staying protected. Nyamurongo cemetery hosts smaller, managed ceremonies with about 15 families. IFRC teams in full PPE pick up bodies, decontaminate, and aim to accommodate family wishes within infection-control limits. WHO anthropologist Anoko negotiates culturally sensitive burial practices, notably for pregnant women. A 34-year-old mother of four died; her burial was completed in under 10 minutes, illustrating the ongoing human toll and response.

triage.headline_ja: 「親を1日違いで埋葬した」- エボラ出血熱の喪に服す人々が安全な追悼方法を学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebola による現在の発生で約200人の死亡、IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準複数該当。国際的な対応と文化的課題を伴うシグナルレベルの事象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola による進行中の発生。WHO や IFRC が関与し、人類学的観点から文化的感受性を考慮した埋葬慣行を交渉中。約200人の死亡確認。DRC は対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Unión Africana promete 910 millones de dólares para acelerar la respuesta al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Union pledges $910 million to accelerate the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-18, the African Union mobilized $910 million in pledges to accelerate the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North and South Kivu) and Uganda. About $80 million comes from AU member states; the rest is mobilized with support from CDC Africa, WHO, regional blocs, and partners. Leaders pledged to disburse $518 million needed for the Continental Plan for Preparedness and Response within four weeks, funding surveillance, contact tracing, laboratories, case management, infection prevention and control, and cross-border coordination. In the DRC, 837 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases have been reported with 196 deaths; the outbreak began May 15 in Ituri near Uganda and South Sudan and has spread to Kivu provinces. Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases with 2 deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with a case fatality rate around 30–50% and no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合がエボラ対策加速のため9億1000万ドルを約束
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な流行、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模アウトブレイク（837確定患者、196死亡）で、極めて高い優先度シグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにDistrict of Columbia（米国）が含まれているが、記事サマリーは DRC と Uganda でのアウトブレイク対応を主題としており、米国での実際の発生を示す記述がない。したがって verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は確認された主要な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、19の確定患者が Uganda で報告されているが、記事の主題はあくまで DRC（837症例）中心。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Número de mortos na RDCongo eleva-se para 202 - União Africana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Death toll in DR Congo rises to 202 - African Union
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 202 deaths among 875 confirmed cases since the outbreak was declared in the eastern region on May 15. Ituri province remains the epicenter, accounting for 91% of cases and 78% of deaths, with the virus spreading to North and South Kivu. North Kivu’s ongoing conflict hampers response and corresponds with higher fatality and the lowest contact-tracing rate. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with a case fatality rate of 30–50% and no approved vaccine or specific treatment, per the WHO. Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases (14 imported from DRC) including two deaths. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17; AU-CDC/WHO launched a US$518 million response plan on June 5. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding; transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids. This is the third-deadliest Ebola outbreak in history.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国の死者数が202人に増加 - アフリカ連合
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大の実績、WHOによるPHEIC宣言）。WPRO基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は対象国DRCおよびウガンダで確認された重大な感染症危機である。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。本アウトブレイクはWHOにより5月17日にPHEIC宣言されており、AU-CDCとWHOによる5億1,800万ドルの対応計画が発動されている。Bundibugyo株による致死率30～50%、歴史上第3位の致死性アウトブレイクである。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Infections Climb, Could Take Year To Contain, Health Officials Say
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo with spillover into Uganda. As of June 15, 2026, CDC counts 837 confirmed cases and 196 deaths in the DRC; as of June 16, 19 more cases and 2 deaths in Uganda. This is the largest Bundibugyo outbreak on record and could last up to a year, potentially sickening thousands more if transmission continues. Symptoms include fever, severe weakness, abdominal pain, and internal bleeding. No approved vaccine or targeted treatment exists; patient care is supportive. Containment slowed by armed conflict, distrust, misinformation, and mass displacement; early testing delays hindered response. Transmission occurs via contact with blood or bodily fluids, including deceased individuals; burial practices have complicated control, though aid groups use body bags with windows. US risk remains low; no cases in the United States and no travel advisories for unaffected regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染が増加、封じ込めに1年要する可能性 - 保健当局が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（歴代最大のBundibugyo株）で837確認例、196死亡例、ウガンダへの越境、1年間の継続リスク、国際的な懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations に DRC のみを記載。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため除外。米国への記載は流入リスクの評価であり、実際の発生地域ではないため除外。本アウトブレイクは歴代最大規模で、武装紛争、住民不信、誤情報、大量避難民による封じ込め困難、早期検査遅延などの重大なリスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : engagement de 21 communautés à faire un front commun contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: 21 Communities Commit to Forming a United Front Against Ebola - ACP.
article.articleSummary: 21 communities in Ituri, members of UNADI, have committed to a united front against Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) in Bunia, North-East Democratic Republic of the Congo. They will support the response by promoting prevention measures, dignified and safe burials, and early treatment to interrupt transmission. Dieudonne Mwamba Kazadi, director-general of the Institut national de santé publique (INSP), explained the WHO’s designation of the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and outlined treatment prospects for patients receiving timely care. The community leaders pledged to relay awareness on barrier measures, collaboration with health teams, and countering misinformation. The 21 UNADI communities will stand with health authorities and partners to end the outbreak and protect Ituri. Attendees included the COUSP coordinator, the Ituri provincial assembly president, and the adviser to the President on sociocultural issues for Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ：21のコミュニティがエボラに対する共同戦線を形成することを誓約 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症はIHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO由来のPHEIC指定が明記されており、DRC での現在進行形のアウトブレイク対応を示している。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC イトゥリ州ブニアでのエボラアウトブレイク対応を扱っている。WHO PHIEC指定、コミュニティ動員、政府高官の参加など、国家・国際レベルの対応が進行中であることが示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: GHS launches nationwide campaign to eliminate river blindness, elephantiasis and bilharzia
article.articleSummary: Ghana Health Service (GHS) launches 2026 Integrated Mass Drug Administration (MDA) Campaign to eliminate river blindness (Onchocerciasis), elephantiasis (lymphatic filariasis), and bilharzia (schistosomiasis) as public health threats by 2030. The nationwide campaign runs June 20–July 3, 2026, distributing medicines to millions in endemic communities. It aims to reach about 6.7 million people in 86 districts across 15 regions for Onchocerciasis. Lymphatic Filariasis transmission has been interrupted in 114 of 117 endemic districts, with the campaign targeting the remaining two districts and about 266,000 people. Schistosomiasis deworming will occur in 13 districts across eight regions, protecting more than one million people. The effort will be complemented by improvements in water, sanitation, hygiene, and environmental management. Dr. Samuel Kaba Akoriyea emphasized preventability, burden on families, and the need for community mobilisation and accurate information.

triage.headline_ja: GHSが川盲症、象皮病、住血吸虫症の排除を目指す全国キャンペーンを開始
triage.triage_reason: これは公衆衛生施策（医薬品投与キャンペーン）の報道であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクではない。記事は制御された疾患の排除努力を示しており、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: この記事はガーナ保健局による予防的・計画的な医薬品投与キャンペーンの発表である。3つの熱帯病（オンコセルカ症、リンパ性糸状虫症、住血吸虫症）の排除を目指した公衆衛生介入であり、新規のアウトブレイク、致死性の高い症例の増加、または国際的な感染拡大の徴候はない。むしろ疾患制御の進展を示している。シグナル検知の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: BBC World Service - Focus on Africa, DRC Ebola: stories from the frontline
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo persists at the epicentre, with frontline reporting from Bunia, Rwampara and Mongbwalu. As of 18 June 2026, communities continue to face transmission, yet many patients are surviving and recovering, offering hope amid fear, violence and mistrust surrounding response efforts. The report underscores how every recovery strengthens families struggling with the outbreak. BBC journalist Anne Soy travels to hotspots to document the response teams on the ground and the human dimensions of the crisis. Challenges persist as treatment centres have been attacked and health workers threatened, underscoring the fragility of containment. The focus captures the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC and its impact on affected communities, illustrating the difficulties and small milestones in the frontline fight against the disease.

triage.headline_ja: BBC World Service - Focus on Africa: DRC エボラ：最前線からの報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラの東部DRC流行は継続中。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念があり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRwandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRC東部の流行が主題であり、ルワンダでの実際の患者発生や流行確認は明記されていない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。治療センター襲撃や保健労働者への脅迫など、対応能力への重大な懸念が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: मानसून से पहले अलर्ट मोड में केंद्र; डेंगू-मलेरिया को लेकर राज्यों के लिए जारी की गाइडलाइन, जानें क्या दिए निर्देश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Centre on alert mode ahead of the monsoon; guidelines issued to states on dengue and malaria — what instructions were given.
article.articleSummary: India's central government is on alert ahead of the monsoon to counter dengue and malaria, mosquito-borne diseases. Union Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda ordered hospitals nationwide to ensure availability of medicines, beds, and blood supplies, and to launch a robust war-on-mosquitoes campaign. With dengue and malaria risk expected to rise during the monsoon and the ensuing months, the centre held a high-level review to assess nationwide preparedness and directed states and union territories to undertake comprehensive preventive measures. The measures are intended to bolster hospital readiness and vector-control efforts across the country ahead of the rains. The guidance is countrywide and emphasizes preparedness for the monsoon season.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーン前に警戒態勢に入る中央政府；デング熱とマラリアについて州向けガイドラインを発行——どのような指示が与えられたか
triage.triage_reason: 季節的な感染症対策の行政指示であり、現在の異常なアウトブレイク報告ではない。ただしモンスーン時期に両疾患のリスク上昇が予想されており、公衆衛生準備状況の関心は高い。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の季節性疾患（デング熱・マラリア）に対する予防的な行政対応を報じたものである。現在の患者数急増やアウトブレイク報告ではなく、モンスーン前の準備体制強化の発表。IHR基準は満たさないが、WPRO基準の「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当し、政府・国民の関心が高い。フルRRA判定には至らないが、続報（実際の患者増加報告など）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : le comité provincial de riposte contre Ebola renforce les mesures de prévention - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: the provincial Ebola response committee reinforces preventive measures - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ituri Ebola preparedness in Bunia: In Ituri province, military governor General-Major Kasongo Mulumba Gaby chaired a provincial Ebola response committee meeting to assess readiness for a potential resurgence. The session reviewed the epidemiological situation, surveillance across health zones and at entry points, and coordination mechanisms, with emphasis on risk communication and community engagement. Recommendations included strengthening epidemiological surveillance at entry points, intensifying community outreach, improving coordination among response partners, and maintaining the operational readiness of rapid-response teams. Officials urged residents to observe hygiene measures and promptly report suspected Ebola cases to health facilities. The gathering underscores continued commitment by provincial authorities and partners to prevent Ebola spread and safeguard public health in Ituri. Published 2026-06-18.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：エボラ対策委員会が予防措置を強化 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病はIHR基準で極めて重大な疾患であり、DRCでの継続的な準備体制の強化が報じられている。ただし現在のところ新規患者発生の明確な報告ではなく、予防・準備活動の段階であるため、今後の展開を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は現在のエボラ再発可能性に対する準備強化活動であり、新規患者発生ではない。イトゥリ州はDRC内で地理的に特定されており、過去のエボラ流行で注目された地域である。軍事知事による委員会会議が開催され、サーベイランス強化、コミュニティ関与、連携体制の整備が推奨されている。今後の患者発生報告に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Krisis Ganda di Kongo: Diintai Maut Ebola, Konflik Bersenjata Makin Membara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Twin Crisis in the Congo: Death from Ebola Looms, Armed Conflict Intensifies
article.articleSummary: June 18, 2026: UN OCHA reports armed groups hindering Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Ituri Province as the outbreak epicenter, accounting for more than 90% of confirmed cases. On June 16, five emergency responders were briefly detained by armed groups in Ituri as aid operations faced obstruction. In South Kivu, humanitarian access remains severely constrained amid fighting, forcing nearly 20,000 people to flee their homes by June 15 in Mwenga and Shabunda, with needs including food, shelter, healthcare, safe drinking water, and protection. In Fizi, access remains pressured due to repeated armed group interruptions risking aid delivery and worker safety. Across South Kivu from January–May, at least 57 incidents directly affected aid workers, including threats, disrupted deliveries, and movement restrictions. OCHA and partners continue to support authorities to curb transmission and deliver assistance, urging protection of civilians and safe, rapid access to those in need.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの二重危機：エボラの死が迫る中、武装紛争が激化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全てに該当し、エボラウイルス病の大規模発生と武装紛争による人道的危機が同時進行。国際的な支援と対応が必要な重大事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのイトゥリ州とサウスキブ州でのエボラ発生を主題としている。Fiji (2205218) は発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、サマリー中に言及がなく、検証対象から除外。武装紛争による人道支援の阻害がエボラ対応を複雑化させており、WHO通知の閾値を大幅に上回る事象。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak, DRC and Region, Situation Report #7, June 18, 2026
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on May 15, confirmed as Bundibugyo strain. As of June 16, 875 confirmed EVD cases and 202 deaths in DRC, with 19 cases and 2 deaths in Uganda. Outbreak centered in Ituri province, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu. Uganda reports cases linked to transmission from DRC, including imported cases and secondary infections among contacts and healthcare workers. South Sudan remains at high risk due to transient populations and porous borders, though no confirmed cases yet. International Medical Corps reports: 51 facilities engaged in screening, identification, and treatment; 1,324 screenings conducted and 109 patients treated. 177 personnel trained in EVD case management, response, and prevention; RCCE outreach reached 36,120 people. IMC employs hub-and-spoke model with Ebola Treatment Centers in all three DRC provinces, transit centers, and screening-referral units; Uganda and South Sudan operations include local partnerships and two infectious-disease units, respectively.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、DRC及び地域、状況報告書第7号、2026年6月18日
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2の4基準すべてに該当。Bundibugyo strain Ebolaによる多数の確定例・死亡、複数国への国際的拡大（DRC→Uganda確認、South Sudan高リスク）、国際支援が既に展開中。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda及びSouth Sudanが列挙されているが、記事サマリー上でUgandaは19例2死亡の二次感染が確認されており、South Sudanは「高リスク」だが「未確認」と明記されている。したがって verified_locations はDRC(対象国)のみとする。既に複数の国際組織（International Medical Corps等）による支援が展開中の段階。

article.articleHeadline: Över 200 dödsoffer bekräftade i ebola i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 200 deaths confirmed from Ebola in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kongo-Kinshasa) persists, with Africa CDC confirming more than 200 deaths. As of 18 June 2026, the official death toll stood at 202, from 875 laboratory-confirmed cases, yielding a case-fatality rate around 23%. The true burden is feared to be higher due to substantial underreporting, and the outbreak may have been active longer than the CDC’s mid-May confirmation suggests. The outbreak strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo variant). These figures are reported by Africa CDC and reflect laboratory-confirmed cases; the possibility of undetected cases suggests the outbreak could be larger.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病がコンゴで200人以上の死亡が確認された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目に該当。エボラウイルス病は最高レベルのリスク疾患であり、即座にフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo variant）による200人以上の確認死亡は国際的な懸念事項。実際の患者数・死亡数は過少報告により更に多い可能性がある。DRCはWPRO対象国に含まれていないが、COVID-19パンデミック以降の高い社会的・政治的関心を考慮すると、PICKUP判定が必須。Africa CDCの公式情報に基づいている。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo supera la barrera de los 200 muertos confirmados por el brote del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo surpasses 200 confirmed deaths from the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 18 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak has 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths, with a 23% case fatality rate and 67 recoveries. Ituri province remains the epicenter, accounting for 91% of cases and 78% of deaths, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu. The outbreak was declared on 15 May in eastern DRC. Africa CDC official Wessam Mankoula cited that North Kivu is largely inaccessible due to armed conflict, associated with a high fatality rate and the lowest contact-tracing rate among the three provinces. Data highlight ongoing, concentrated transmission in Ituri and substantial response access challenges in North Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ流行による確認死亡者数200人超の水準を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認症例875例、死亡202例（CFR 23%）を報告する重篤な流行。IHR基準4つすべて該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当する国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した南キブ州およびイトゥリ州はコンゴ民主共和国内の州であり、記事サマリーから同国内の流行が確認されている。IHR Annex2の4基準すべてに該当：(1)確認死亡202例・CFR23%で深刻な公衆衛生影響、(2)エボラ流行は予想外・異常、(3)複数州への地理的拡大と国際的拡大のリスク、(4)アクセス制限による対応困難さから渡航・貿易制限のリスク。WPRO基準も全5項目に該当する重篤なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases increase almost 40% in a week as death toll passes 200
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda driven by Bundibugyo virus: 204 deaths and 894 confirmed cases reported, 74 recoveries. Ituri province in eastern Congo accounts for over 90% of cases, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak, confirmed May 15, has grown about 38% in a week and is the worst on record. Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccines or treatments; experimental monoclonal antibodies are under development. Nearly a million people have been displaced in Ituri, hindering contact tracing in remote, insecure areas and among mine workers. Of roughly 800 confirmed cases used for tracing estimates, 17,000–35,000 contacts should be in lists; only about 4,000 are tracked (<15%). More than $900 million pledged, but only $90 million released; Africa CDC says 540 personnel are needed but 84 are available.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の症例数が1週間でほぼ40%増加、死亡者数が200人を突破
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模多国間アウトブレイク（コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダ）で、過去最悪規模、急速な増加、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、医療体制の逼迫が確認される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus亜型によるエボラアウトブレイク。コンゴ民主共和国（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州）が主要な発生地で、ウガンダへの越境感染も確認。204死亡、894確認症例、1週間で38%増加。ワクチン・治療法なし。接触者追跡の機能率15%未満。資金不足（9億ドル見積もり、9000万ドルのみ給付）。アフリカ地域では過去最悪規模。対象国リストではDRCのみに該当するが、ウガンダはWHO/IHR通知対象として注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ešte nedosiahla vrchol a jej zvládnutie môže trvať až rok. Epidémia eboly v Kongu si vyžiadala už vyše dvesto obetí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The outbreak has not yet peaked, and its containment may take up to a year. The Ebola epidemic in Congo has already claimed more than two hundred lives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues, with 202 deaths among 875 confirmed cases (case fatality ~23%) reported by Africa CDC on June 18, 2026, about a month after the May 15 declaration. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain drives the 17th outbreak in the DRC, with epicenters in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces—regions long plagued by conflict and mass displacement. Experts warn the outbreak has not peaked and containment could take up to a year. Security limitations and restricted access complicate contact tracing, a key challenge for responders. Uganda has recorded 19 cases and 2 deaths, largely among travelers from the DRC. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus amid the ongoing international public health response.

triage.headline_ja: まだピークに達しておらず、その制御には最大1年かかる可能性がある。コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行はすでに200人以上の死者をもたらしている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行、高い死亡率、地域紛争による制御困難、ウガンダへの越境感染が確認され、国際的拡大のリスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダはサマリーに記載されているが、DRC発の越境感染として報告されており、流行の主体はDRCである。記事はDRCの流行を主題としているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・治療法なし）による17番目のDRC流行で、地域紛争による制御困難、ピーク前、最大1年の長期化懸念があり、極めて深刻なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Specialistai sunerimę: pavojingas virusas plinta sparčiau nei tikėtasi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts alarmed: a dangerous virus is spreading faster than expected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with Uganda. As of 2026-06-18, Africa CDC reports 204 confirmed deaths and 894 confirmed cases (875 in Congo), with 74 recoveries. Two Uganda deaths bring the total fatalities to 204. The first month’s case count is the highest on record for the continent, about three times the second-largest outbreak, amid a very low number of traced contacts. Authorities have tracked 4,112 contacts among infected patients, though estimates suggest around 35,000 contacts exist. Mankoula warned the situation is still far from containment. Ebola is transmitted via physical contact and contact with bodily fluids. The Bandibadžio Ebola variant currently has no vaccine or specific treatment, complicating containment in both DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家が懸念：危険なウイルスが予想より急速に拡大している
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの大規模アウトブレイクで、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。204人の死亡、894人の確認症例、ワクチンなし、人間-人間感染のリスク高。地域制御の困難性が明らかで国際支援が急務。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国（id: 203312）であり、記事の主要な発生地として確認された。Bandibadžio Ebola変種にはワクチンおよび特異的治療法が存在せず、制御が極めて困難。初月の症例数は過去最大規模とされており、公衆衛生上の脅威は極大。

article.articleHeadline: BAI: What widespread ASF outbreak in NV? | Ada Pelonia
article.articleSummary: Nueva Vizcaya ASF cases are described as isolated, with 23 infections this year in Kasibu, Bayombong, and Villaverde. Kasibu’s February 2026 case, traced to a single farmer, is contained and no longer active; there is no evidence of transmission or spread in the province, according to BAI and PVSO, which attribute detections to localized surveillance and movement controls. Authorities urge farmers to report suspected cases and maintain farm biosecurity to aid early detection and containment. Seven provinces currently have active ASF: Pangasinan, Romblon, Albay, Northern Samar, Agusan del Norte, Agusan del Sur, and Surigao del Sur. Separately, DA allocated P140.9 million for the Animal Vaccine Development Program (AVDP) to develop vaccines against ASF and FMD, in collaboration with BAI, PCC, and CLSU, over 2026–2028 (P77.6m in 2026, P30.6m in 2027, P32.7m in 2028).

triage.headline_ja: BAI: ニューバイスカヤでの広範なASF流行とは？
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）と口蹄疫（FMD）が複数の地域で同時に発生しており、ASFは7州で活動中。これは動物衛生への重大な脅威であり、国際的な家畜貿易への影響リスクがある。
triage.notes: ASFは7つの州（パンガシナン、ロンブロン、アルバイ、北サマル、アグサン・デル・ノルテ、アグサン・デル・スル、スリガオ・デル・スル）で活動中。ニューバイスカヤは孤立した23件の感染が報告されている。フィリピン政府はASFとFMDに対するワクチン開発に向けて資金配分を行っており、家畜伝染病への対応が進行中。記事日付が2026年6月という将来日付であることに注意。

article.articleHeadline: Veszélyes és nagyon ellenálló gombafaj pusztítja a macskákat, az emberre is veszélyes lehet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dangerous and highly resistant fungal species is decimating cats and could also be dangerous to humans
article.articleSummary: Sporothrix brasiliensis, the fungus causing sporotrichosis, is detected in wildlife in Brazil, raising concerns of broader animal-to-human transmission. A 2017–2023 study examined road-kill carcasses along two Paraná state highways, analyzing 81 animals’ hearts, livers, lungs and bladders for Sporothrix DNA. The fungus was most commonly found in the heart and liver, suggesting many animals may harbor the pathogen asymptomatically; sporotrichosis can cause painful blisters and wounds in humans. Researchers also detected Sporothrix DNA in species not previously recognized as carriers, including reptiles, native birds and mammals such as a false coral snake, a speckled toucan, a southern tiger cat and a European hare. The pathogen’s adaptability implies spread to new hosts, with survival at 42°C noted in birds. Transmission to humans occurs mainly through cat scratches or bites; North America has not yet reported cases, but US authorities warn outbreaks could be possible.

triage.headline_ja: 危険で極めて耐性の強い真菌種がネコを壊滅させており、人間にも危険である可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシスの野生動物での検出と人獣共通感染の可能性が確認されており、複数のWPRO基準に該当するが、現在のところ北米での症例報告がなく、情報が発展途上段階である。継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジル（パラナ州）における野生動物からのSporothrix brasiliensisの検出であり、人獣共通感染リスクが強調されている。米国については警告・リスク評価段階であり、確認された発生地域ではない。対象国リストではブラジルのみが該当。真菌の環境抵抗性が高く、新規宿主への適応可能性が指摘されているため継続監視を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: ดีอาร์คองโกตามหา "ดญ.ป่วยอีโบลา" ถูกแก๊งพกมีดพาออกจากรพ. หวั่นอาการทรุด
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo hunts for Ebola-stricken girl abducted from hospital by knife-wielding gang, fearing her condition will deteriorate.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (North Kivu) intensified as a six-year-old patient and her mother were abducted from Wanamahika Hospital in Butembo on June 15, prompting authorities to search Bunia’s isolation center. Local health official Dr. Lubambo Maboko Gaston said the child was taken by armed men wielding knives and appeared highly angered. It remains unclear whether the attackers knew the family, but officials urged the girl and mother to return to a health center quickly to prevent deterioration and curb transmission. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, with at least 840 confirmed cases and nearly 200 deaths since mid-May. Attacks on Ebola treatment facilities have complicated containment in the region, which includes Bunia and Butembo as authorities work to locate and protect patients and healthcare workers.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ出血熱に罹患した少女の捜索を展開 武装勢力が病院から連れ去る、容態悪化の懸念
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生地がDRCで確認され、IHR基準4項目全てに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを有する。また患者の逃走による管理可能性の低下が懸念される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain エボラで840確認例、約200死亡例を確認。患者の逃走・武装勢力による施設への攻撃により封じ込め困難化。北キブ州Butembo及びBunia地域での発生。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв нынешней вспышки Эболы в Африке превысило 200 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from the current Ebola outbreak in Africa has surpassed 200.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 June 2026, the current Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda has reached 894 laboratory-confirmed cases (875 in DRC), with 204 deaths (202 in DRC, 2 in Uganda) and 74 recoveries. The case fatality rate is 23%. The outbreak began on 15 May, with the epicenter in Ituri Province, DRC, and has spread to Uganda. Public health authorities warn of inadequate contact tracing: 4,112 people are under surveillance, while the total number of contacts is estimated at about 35,000. This outbreak ranks behind only three historic Ebola epidemics in Africa by case and death counts: West Africa 2014–2016 (28,616 cases, 11,325 deaths), East DRC 2018–2020 (3,470 cases, 2,287 deaths), and Uganda 2000–2001 (425 cases, 224 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラ出血熱現在の流行による死亡者数が200人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目適合。894例の確定患者、204名の死亡者、23%の致命率を伴う大規模流行であり、ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的にDRC（イツリ州が震源）とウガンダの発生が記載されているが、対象国リストはDRC（203312）のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。2018-2020年のDRC流行に次ぐ規模の流行であり、接触追跡の不十分さ（追跡者4,112人に対し推定接触者約35,000人）が公衆衛生対応上の重大な懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll passes 200 in DR Congo: AU health agency
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, is causing a major outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). As of 18 Jun 2026, 202 deaths have been reported among 875 confirmed cases (mortality ~23%). The outbreak declared 15 May, with contact tracing hampered by security and accessibility issues across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. The Red Cross warns containment could take up to a year. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo. The conflict-displaced provinces complicate response. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, which has 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, most of them Congolese travellers. Containment measures in Uganda have been effective so far. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴのエボラ死亡者数が 200 人を超える: AU 保健機関
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つ全て該当。確認された死亡者200人超、ウガンダへの国際拡大、セキュリティ障害による対応困難など、重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。DRC での主要な流行が焦点。Bundibugyo 株、承認されたワクチン/治療法なし、紛争影響地域での封じ込めの困難さ、赤十字による最大1年の長期対応予測が重要リスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: La Unión Africana promete 910 millones de dólares para acelerar la respuesta al ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The African Union pledges $910 million to accelerate the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: AU pledges 910 million dollars to accelerate Ebola response, including 80 million from AU member states, announced by Africa CDC. The funds were pledged at a gathering of African leaders, Africa CDC, WHO to bolster the response. Leaders backed disbursing the 518 million needed for the Continental Joint Preparedness and Response Plan over four weeks, covering immediate actions in affected areas and preparedness in at-risk countries—surveillance, contact tracing, laboratory capacity, case management, infection prevention and cross-border coordination. President Évariste Ndayishimiye urged action over words; Mahmoud Ali Youssouf called for shared continental responsibility, and Jean Kaseya pressed rapid funding, supplies and personnel to reach communities. In eastern Congo, 837 confirmed cases and 196 deaths; Ituri outbreak began May 15, with spread to Kivu Nord and Kivu Sud, and Uganda (19 cases, 2 deaths). Bundibugyo Ebola strain; no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; WHO flags high risk in sub-Saharan Africa, low globally.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合、エボラ対応加速に9億1,000万ドルを公約
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスは確認された死亡例を伴う多国間での活動的な流行であり、国際的拡大とトレード制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、東コンゴ（イトゥリ州、キブノール州、キブスッド州）での確認例837件、死亡196件、およびウガンダでの症例19件・死亡2件が報告されている。ただしウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo株、ワクチンなし、治療法なし。アフリカ域内での即時対応と国際的支援が必要とされており、多くの基準を満たすため PICKUP と判定。

article.articleHeadline: IU teacher, former student receive int'l recognition for AI-based research on Mpox
article.articleSummary: Mpox detection via AI earns international recognition for Islamic University, Kushtia, Bangladesh. Associate Professor Dr Md Shamin Hossain and former IU student Dipankar Bala, now at Sungkyunkwan University, South Korea, have a paper on AI-assisted Mpox detection that has been nominated for the Best Paper Award in Neural Networks, a Q1 journal. The award will be presented at the IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence (WCCI 2026) in the Netherlands, with Hossain traveling on June 20. The work, conducted in collaboration with the Computer Vision Lab at IU and the Department of Computer Science and Technology at the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), supervised by Prof Zhangjin Huang, proposes rapid, accurate Mpox diagnosis using AI. Since no standard public dataset existed, the researchers built a new dataset from images of infected patients across multiple international sources and demonstrated an effective diagnostic framework. Mpox was declared PHEIC by WHO on 23 July 2022.

triage.headline_ja: IU教師と元学生がMpoxに関するAIベース研究で国際的認識を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学術研究の表彰に関するニュースであり、新規のMpox感染症アウトブレイクやヘルスイベントではない。疾患検出技術の開発・認可が主題であり、IHR基準やWPRO基準は該当しない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数の国（Bangladesh、China、Netherlands、Republic of Korea）を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーを精読すると、本記事は学術研究論文の表彰と学会発表に関するニュースであり、Mpoxの新規アウトブレイク、感染拡大、患者発生事例ではない。記事に記載されているMpoxに関する唯一の感染症情報は『Mpoxは2022年7月23日にWHOにより公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）と宣言された』という過去の背景情報のみである。対象国リスト内にBangladesh（GeoNames ID不記載）とChina（1814991）が含まれるが、本記事は疾患の実際の発生ではなく学術活動が主題であるため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en RDC supera los 200 muertos y alcanza el 23% de letalidad
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 200 deaths and reaches a 23% case-fatality rate.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 200 deaths and reached a 23% case-fatality rate, with 875 laboratory-confirmed cases since May 15, 2026. The epidemic is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment, and is currently affecting three eastern provinces. Laboratory confirmation supports the ongoing outbreak, and authorities report no cases exported outside the DRC to date. The World Health Organization has characterized the situation as a public health emergency with potential international spread, prompting intensified contact tracing, patient isolation, and cross-border controls with Uganda, Rwanda, and Burundi. International support includes a $10 million contribution from the Alliance for Global Health Action for PPE and supportive medicines, while pharmaceutical labs pursue experimental therapies for Bundibugyo. Containment is challenged by limited access to affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ出血熱流行が200人以上の死亡者と23%の致命率に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行で875例の確定患者、200人以上の死亡、23%の高い致命率、複数国への拡大リスク、国際支援動員という極めて深刻な事象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にDRCの流行を主題としており、ウガンダ、ルワンダ、ブルンジは隣国として境界対策の対象として言及されているが、これらの国での実際の流行発生は報告されていない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとする。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・特異的治療法がないため管理困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: El ECDC refuerza su apoyo contra el ébola en Congo y Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The ECDC strengthens its support in the fight against Ebola in the Congo and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-18, the European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) said it will strengthen support against the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda by sending additional experts to assist risk assessment and field activities. The Africa CDC reports the DRC Ebola death toll at 202. ECDC Director Pamela Rendi-Wagner stated on-the-ground actions will inform Europe’s risk assessments and recommendations. A EU health-working group is monitoring passenger screening procedures at major airports in affected countries; a second EU health group, including an ECDC expert, will arrive in South Sudan to bolster outbreak preparedness with emphasis on risk communication and community engagement. Since the outbreak began, three ECDC experts have been deployed on rotation (a fourth is en route), with more expected. EU authorities coordinate with national bodies and EU delegations; latest risk assessment notes Bundibugyo ebolavirus importation into the EU/EEA remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: ECDCがコンゴとウガンダのエボラ対策支援を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な多国間発生（DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダン）であり、IHR基準3つ以上に該当する重大シグナル。EU・WHO等の国際的対応が既に展開されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ発生が言及されているが、対象国リスト内ではDRC（203312）のみ該当。死亡者202名の既知の発生であり、EU/ECDC、Africa CDCによる国際的対応が既に実施中。南スーダンはWHO監視対象だが対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 누적 사망자 200명 넘어
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cumulative Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 200.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality rate 23%) as of June 18, 2026. Nearby Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. Africa CDC notes active contact tracing for 4,112 individuals, roughly 12% of an estimated 35,000 contacts, a gap compared to the DRC government’s 50–60% tracing rate. International donors pledged $910 million to the Ebola response, including $80 million from AU member states, significantly up from the prior $518 million plan for emergency coordination, surveillance, diagnostics, infection prevention and control, clinical care, research, logistics, and health-service support through November. Donors were urged to disburse the full amount within four weeks; Africa CDC/WHO warn that needs could rise to about $1.5 billion if containment is not achieved promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ累積死亡者200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間発生（DRC 875確定例、202死亡；ウガンダ19例2死亡）、致命率23%、4,112人の接触者追跡中、9.1億ドルの国際支援動員、容器化失敗時に15億ドルへの資金需要増予測。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedotの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダの事例数が限定的（19例2死亡）であり、主要発生地はDRCです。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとしました。エボラは極めて高リスク疾患であり、多国間発生、高い致命率、国際支援ニーズの急速な増加がすべての評価基準で顕著です。

article.articleHeadline: Nenhum município da Bahia alcançou 80% de vacinação contra a gripe em meio ao avanço de casos de SRAG
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No municipality in Bahia reached 80% influenza vaccination amid the surge of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS) cases.
article.articleSummary: Bahia, Brazil has not reached 80% influenza vaccination in any municipality amid a surge of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG). As of 06:31 on 2026-06-18, 38.06% of priority groups in Bahia were immunized, with about 1.3 million doses delivered out of a target of roughly 3.4 million. No municipality surpassed 80% coverage; three are below 20%: Itacaré (18.88%), Guaratinga (19%), Simões Filho (19.29%). Coverage includes 11 cities at 61–80%, 172 at 41–60%, and 229 (54.92%) at 21–40%. The low uptake coincides with a nationwide SRAG rise; Fiocruz’s InfoGripe bulletin flags states at alert/risk/high risk. Co-circulation of Influenza A, RSV, and rhinovirus complicates clinical attribution. Salvador is among 10 capitals with SRAG activity in the last two weeks. Most vaccines went to seniors over 60; doses to children aged 6 months–<6 years and to pregnant women were smaller.

triage.headline_ja: バイア州内のいかなる自治体もインフルエンザワクチン接種率80%に到達していない。重症急性呼吸器症候群(SRAG)患者の増加の中で
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・バイア州でRSV、インフルエンザA、ライノウイルスの同時流行により重症急性呼吸器症候群(SRAG)患者が急増し、ワクチン接種率が低い状況が報告されている。複数の呼吸器病原体の共流行は公衆衛生的影響が深刻であり、国内的に警戒レベルが引き上げられている状況がWPRO基準（異常性、重症度、流行性）を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事ではブラジル（バイア州）での複数呼吸器病原体の同時流行が主題。El Salvadorは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、サマリーに記載されていないため除外した。Fiocruz InfoGripeが全国的な警戒レベルの引き上げを報告しており、複数州が影響を受けている。ワクチン接種率が低いことが管理可能性の低さを示している。

article.articleHeadline: Mental hospital records 280 typhoid cases
article.articleSummary: At the National Center for Mental Health (NCMH) in Mandaluyong, Metro Manila, Philippines, 280 typhoid fever cases were logged as of June 16, 2026. Of these, 216 patients have recovered; 12 remain in treatment and under observation by NCMH staff. Typhoid fever is caused by Salmonella Typhi and spreads via contaminated food or water. Reported symptoms include high fever, abdominal pain and headache. The Department of Health (DOH) urged continued basic hygiene, noting the patients' mental state requires careful guidance on handwashing and hygiene. DOH cautioned that untreated or delayed treatment can be life-threatening. The figure reflects ongoing outbreak within the facility; no information on imported/exported cases was provided. The update underscores infection control in a mental health setting and the need for prompt medical attention.

triage.headline_ja: 精神病院が280件の腸チフス患者を記録
triage.triage_reason: 限定された施設（精神保健センター）内での集団発生であり、公衆衛生への影響、異常性、管理可能性の観点からシグナルに該当。フルRRAを進めるべき。
triage.notes: フィリピンの国立精神保健センター内での腸チフス集団発生。280例（うち回復216例、治療中12例）が報告され、サルモネラ・ユキダの水系・食物伝播が確認。精神障害者を含む脆弱人口での感染拡大リスク、感染管理の複雑性が懸念される。DOHが対応中だが、施設内での継続的な曝露リスクと衛生管理の課題がある。

article.articleHeadline: JE Deaths in Assam: 7 Fatalities, 35 Cases Reported
article.articleSummary: Assam, India, reports 35 confirmed Japanese Encephalitis (JE) cases and seven JE deaths through June 17, 2026, according to NCVBDC data cited by NHM Assam. AES totals of 470 cases and 32 deaths are separate and should not be conflated with JE. NHM Assam clarifies JE is one cause of Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES) but not synonymous with AES, urging distinct reporting for accurate public understanding. Surveillance is being intensified across districts ahead of the monsoon AES-JE season, with strengthened case management and expanded vaccination in vulnerable areas and improved inter-department coordination. Media and public are urged to rely on verified data and report AES and JE separately to prevent misinformation and panic. Mosquito-borne JE remains the focus of ongoing control as Assam prepares for the seasonal surge.

triage.headline_ja: JE Deaths in Assam: 7 Fatalities, 35 Cases Reported
triage.triage_reason: 日本脳炎による7名の死亡と35例の確認患者がインドのアッサム州で報告されており、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」と「異常/予想外」に該当。雨季前の監視強化が実施されており、国内対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事はアッサム州（インド）での日本脳炎アウトブレイク報告。7名の死亡と35例の確認患者が報告されている。蚊媒介感染症として季節性の懸念があり、雨季前の監視強化が実施されている。AES（急性脳炎症候群）との区別が重要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reports large daily jump in Ebola cases a month after outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-18, Congo's Ministry of Health reports 72 new Ebola cases in 24 hours, bringing confirmed cases to 782 and deaths to 181 (29 new). The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus and confirmed May 15, is about one month old and centered in Ituri province, which accounts for more than 90% of cases, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu and across the border into Uganda. Contact tracing coverage stands at 56%, down from last week, hampered by community resistance and rapid expansion into new health zones; nearly a million people displaced by conflict in Ituri complicate tracing and surveillance. So far, 40 recovered; fatality rate 23%. WHO is intensifying testing, tracing and treatment; supplies have arrived, and Africa CDC head Jean Kaseya calls for urgent resources to stop transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、アウトブレイク発症から1ヶ月後にエボラ患者数の大幅な日次増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された多発アウトブレイクで、既に782例の確定患者と181人の死亡、急速な増加傾向、国境を越えてウガンダへの拡大、高い致命率（23%）、接触者追跡カバー率の低下（56%）と対応の課題が明確。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「ウガンダ国境を越えての追加症例」と記述されており、主な発生地はDRCのIturi州。対象国リストにはUgandaが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。エボラ（Bundibugyo virus）は極めて深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola na RD Congo tem taxa de mortalidade de 23% em quase um mês após início da epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo has a mortality rate of 23% nearly a month after the outbreak began.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 875 laboratory-confirmed cases and 202 deaths, a 23% mortality rate, as of June 18, 2026 ( Africa CDC reports). More than 200 deaths have occurred roughly a month after the epidemic was declared. Health authorities warn the outbreak could worsen significantly, potentially lasting up to a year and infecting thousands. The eastern/nearby regions of the DRC face challenges from distrust of authorities and violence, hampering health workers’ efforts. This outbreak is one of the major ongoing Ebola events, with the World Health Organization noting the severe West Africa outbreak of 2014–2016 as the deadliest on record (>11,000 deaths). Bruno Michon, managing Congo response for the IFRC/Red Cross, told The New York Times the response could take months to contain and may extend to a year if infections rise. The virus has spread from Congo to Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱、流行開始からほぼ1ヶ月で死亡率23%
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当する（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。確認症例875例、死亡202例、23%の致命率を示す極めて危険な感染症。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの拡大が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみを登録。本イベントはWPRO基準5項目全て該当し、IHR基準も4項目全て該当する最優先度のシグナル。地域内の不信と暴力による保健対応の困難性が記載されており、マネージャビリティの懸念も高い。

article.articleHeadline: ഷിഗല്ല വ്യാപനം തുടരുന്നു; കേസുകളുടെ എണ്ണം മുന്‍വര്‍ഷത്തെ മറികടന്നു, ഇതുവരെ ആറു മരണം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of Shigella continues; the number of cases has surpassed last year, with six deaths so far.
article.articleSummary: Shigella spread continues in Kerala, India, with six Shigella deaths this year; five occurred this month. Confirmed Shigella cases so far this month total 110, with today’s 19: Thiruvananthapuram 2, Kollam 1, Ernakulam 1, Thrissur 3, Malappuram 1, Kozhikode 9, Kannur 2. Historically higher in Thiruvananthapuram, Kozhikode, and Kochi, this year’s cases are reported across most districts. Shigella is transmitted via contaminated food and water, affecting mainly children and the immunocompromised; fever, abdominal pain, and bloody diarrhea are key symptoms. High population density and water contamination heighten risk; authorities warn about ice in cold beverages and urge improved sanitation. Fever cases surged: yesterday 13,849 sought care; this month total 193,000. Dengue shows 68 yesterday and 297 dengue-like illnesses; one dengue death. District counts for dengue include Thiruvananthapuram 24, Kollam 12, Pathanamthitta 2, Alappuzha 1, Ernakulam 11, Thrissur 13, Malappuram 2, Kasaragod 3. Other notable increases: leptospirosis 16, malaria 15, chickenpox 80, typhoid 1, influenza 105, meningitis 1, encephalitis 1, and severe diarrhea 3,842.

triage.headline_ja: シゲラ菌の拡大が継続；症例数が前年を超過、これまでに6人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーラム州でシゲラ菌による集団発生が継続しており、6人の死亡と110症例が報告されている。同時に複数の感染症（デング熱、レプトスピラ症、マラリア、チフス、インフルエンザなど）の増加も認められており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事ではシゲラ菌が主疾患として報告されているが、Bluedot APIの疾患リストにはシゲラ菌が含まれていない（代わりにレプトスピラ症、マラリア、インフルエンザ、チフス、脳炎、デング熱、水痘が列挙されている）。記事では同時に複数の感染症の増加が報告されており、発熱患者の急増（昨日13,849人、今月193,000人）も記されている。ケーラム州全域（8地区以上）に拡大しており、水道の汚染と密集した人口が危険因子として指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: O lună de epidemie de ebola în RDC - Numărul morților a depășit 200
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A month-long Ebola outbreak in the DRC - the death toll has surpassed 200.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 200 deaths, with 202 confirmed fatalities from 875 cases since its declaration on May 15 in the Ituri province of north‑east DRC (mortality 23%). The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo, a rare Ebola strain with no vaccine or approved specific treatment. By cross‑border spread, 19 infections have been reported in Uganda, including two deaths. The DRC epicenter in Ituri is challenging due to poor roads and security issues, complicating contact tracing. Africa CDC warns of gaps in case‑finding and access, while NGOs voice concerns about the response. Uganda reports the outbreak as under control as of June 11. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola transmits via close contact with bodily fluids; the disease has killed over 15,000 people in Africa in the last 50 years. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでの1ヶ月間のエボラ流行 - 死亡者数が200人を超過
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の高死亡率、国際的な越境感染、渡航制限のリスク）。WHOがPHEICを宣言済みであり、既にフルRRAの対象。
triage.notes: Uganda での越境感染も報告されているが、記事の主題は DRC のエボラ流行。Uganda は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo strain（ワクチンなし、治療法なし）による高死亡率（23%）は極めて深刻。WHO が PHEIC を宣言済みため、既に国際レベルの対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Nadda directs states to boost response measures against dengue, malaria
article.articleSummary: On 18 June 2026, India's Health Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda directed states and Union Territories to bolster surveillance, vector-control, and healthcare preparedness to counter dengue and malaria during the monsoon and post-monsoon periods. In a high-level review, he ordered strengthened disease surveillance, hospital readiness, and secure supplies of medicines, diagnostic kits, and blood components, with adequate beds and trained staff to handle surges. States were urged to adhere to standard treatment protocols for dengue and malaria and to update diagnosis and case-management guidelines. Emphasis was placed on district-specific response plans, hotspot mapping, anti-larval measures, rapid response mechanisms, and intensified monitoring. Public awareness campaigns to prevent mosquito breeding and seek timely care were urged, with participation from resident welfare associations, panchayati raj institutions, and schools. India reports sustained malaria progress: about 80% decline in cases and deaths from 2015–2025; 160 districts had zero indigenous malaria between 2022–2025; exited HBHI in 2024.

triage.headline_ja: ナッダ保健大臣がデング熱とマラリア対策の強化を州に指示
triage.triage_reason: インドで複数の蚊媒介感染症（デング熱・マラリア）に対する公式な対策強化指示が発出されており、異常性と管理可能性の基準に合致するが、具体的な患者数増加や重症化の報告がないため、情報不足の状態で経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は保健大臣による対策強化指示であり、現在の流行状況や患者数増加の具体的報告がない。モンスーン・ポストモンスーン期間における季節的な対策強化であり、全国的な警戒態勢の発動と解釈される。デング熱とマラリアは両者ともWPRO域内で流行の可能性が高い疾患であり、ヒト-ヒト感染やベクター媒介による拡大リスクがある。今後の実際の患者数報告や状況悪化を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Regierungsdaten - Zahl der Ebola-Toten in DR Kongo auf über 200 gestiegen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government data – Ebola death toll in DR Congo has risen to over 200.
article.articleSummary: As of June 18, 2026, about one month into an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the toll has risen to over 200 deaths. The African Union health authorities report 875 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, with a case fatality rate of 23%. The three eastern provinces are affected by the current Bundibugyo-type strain, for which there is no available vaccine or approved therapy. Ebola virus disease is highly contagious and life-threatening, transmitted through close contact and exposure to bodily fluids. The report underscores ongoing transmission and the lack of targeted medical countermeasures for this Bundibugyo variant, highlighting the need for continued monitoring and public health measures to contain spread within the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: 政府データ - コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死亡者数が200人超に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の急速な蔓延、高い死亡率、ワクチン・治療法未開発のBundibugyo型、三東部州での継続的な感染拡大により、公衆衛生への深刻な影響および国際的拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスはワクチンと承認済み治療法が存在せず、致死率23%で200人超の死亡を記録。東部三州での継続的な感染拡大と医学的対抗手段の欠如が深刻。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Health minister J.P. Nadda reviews monsoon plan for vector-borne diseases | Today News
article.articleSummary: India's health ministry, led by Union Minister Jagat Prakash Nadda, reviewed monsoon preparedness for vector-borne diseases, focusing on malaria, dengue, chikungunya, Japanese Encephalitis, kala-azar, and lymphatic filariasis. With around 5,000 dengue cases reported in the 2026 season so far, officials ordered mapping of high-risk hotspots, stockpiling of essential medicines, diagnostic kits, blood components, and hospital beds, plus strengthened local surveillance across states and union territories. The National Center for Vector Borne Diseases Control urged district-specific micro-plans, anti-larval measures, and regular fogging to curb transmission. Malaria declined about 80% from 2015-2025; India exited the WHO High Burden to High Impact program in 2024, maintaining over a 70% reduction in incidence and mortality, and 160 districts reported zero indigenous cases during 2022-2025. In 2024 malaria totaled 255,500 cases, concentrated in Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, and West Bengal; 2025 dengue numbered 91,015 and chikungunya 34,876. Community participation through local bodies is emphasized for source reduction.

triage.headline_ja: 保健大臣J.P. Naddaがベクター媒介感染症に対するモンスーン対策計画をレビュー
triage.triage_reason: 複数のベクター媒介感染症（デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア等）が対象国インドで同時に発生しており、スクリーニング基準複数該当するが、公式な緊急対応状況の言及がなく、社会的関心の程度が不明。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインドの衛生省によるモンスーン時期のベクター媒介感染症対策計画のレビューを報道しており、これは定期的な予防対応の一環と見られる。デング熱5,000件程度、マラリアは過去10年で80%低下、チクングニアも報告されており、複数のベクター媒介感染症が流行しやすい状態が続いている。しかし緊急事態宣言や異常な増加傾向の明示がないため、IHR基準は満たさない。スクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」（モンスーン季節の継続的リスク）と「流行しやすさ」（ヒト-ベクター接触、対策継続中）が該当する。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Searches for 6-Year-Old Ebola Patient Kidnapped by Knife-Wielding Attackers
article.articleSummary: Two people, a woman and her six-year-old daughter, were abducted at gunpoint from Wanamahika Hospital in Butembo, North Kivu, DRC; both are believed Ebola-positive. The outbreak is Ebola Bundibugyo, with 856 confirmed cases and 198 deaths; 235 suspected cases in DRC and 19 confirmed in Uganda. Most cases are in North Kivu and Ituri, with Ituri suspected as the origin of the first case this year. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, and the outbreak may have begun as early as January. Armed clashes, including ADF attacks, hinder response and aid delivery. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids; traditional burial rituals facilitate transmission. Authorities fear that removing patients from isolation could spread infection to relatives. The kidnapping targeted the two individuals; no other victims reported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、ナイフで武装した攻撃者に誘拐されたエボラ患者の6歳の少女を捜索
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的懸念状況（PHEIC宣言済み）において、患者の誘拐という危機的事象が発生。感染者の隔離解除による地域感染拡大リスク、ウガンダへの越境拡大実績、および暴力衝突による対応阻害は、IHR基準4項目すべてとWPRO基準5項目すべてに該当する。
triage.notes: エボラBundibugyo型の流行中（確認856例、死亡198例、疑い例235例）、WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）、ウガンダへの越境確認（19例）。患者誘拐により隔離破綻リスク、地域伝播リスク上昇。武装勢力による治療妨害（ADF攻撃含む）は対応能力を著しく低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: Japanese Encephalitis Claims 7 Lives in Assam, 35 Confirmed Cases Reported So Far
article.articleSummary: Japanese Encephalitis (JE) in Assam, India, has recorded 7 deaths and 35 laboratory-confirmed JE cases through June 17, 2026, according to NHM Assam. NCVBDC data show JE accounted for 7 of the 35 JE cases, while a broader Acute Encephalitis Syndrome (AES) total of 470 cases occurred during the same period with 32 AES deaths; officials stress JE and AES are distinct and must not be reported interchangeably. The rise coincides with the May–October monsoon transmission peak, with July–August as the high-season. Assam is responding with intensified district-level surveillance, improved hospital case management, and expanded vaccination in high-risk zones. The state’s vulnerability is linked to ecological factors: heavy rainfall, flooding, extensive paddy farming, and a large livestock population that favor Culex mosquitoes. Since 2018, Assam has accounted for about 62% of India's JE deaths (609 fatalities).

triage.headline_ja: 日本脳炎がアッサム州で7人の命を奪う、35件の確定症例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: インドのアッサム州における日本脳炎の集団発生で7人の死亡、35件の確定症例が報告。IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常性」を満たし、同時にWPRO基準の「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」が該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: アッサム州は2018年以来インドの日本脳炎死亡者の約62%（609人）を占める高リスク地域。モンスーン時期（5月～10月）の伝播ピーク期に発生。蚊媒介疾患対策が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases increase almost 40% in a week
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-18, Africa CDC reports the Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda has claimed more than 200 lives in its first month, with 894 confirmed cases to date and up to 35,000 suspected contacts. The outbreak is the worst known at this stage, about three times larger than Uganda’s 2000 outbreak (281 cases). Case counts have risen 38% over the past week and the transmission spans 32 health zones in eastern Congo. The virus involved is Bundibugyo, a rare Ebola strain with no approved vaccines or treatments and which was not tested in the early days; the outbreak was confirmed on May 15, weeks after suspected. By contrast, the more common Zaire virus—responsible for most past Congo outbreaks—has a vaccine. No imported/exported case details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ症例が1週間でほぼ40%増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：200+死亡・894確定例、予想外：Bundibugyo株で治療法なし、国際拡大リスク：ウガンダへ既に拡大、渡航・貿易制限リスク：34地域保健地帯スパン）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（1269750）は発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーでは「Congo and Uganda」と記載されており、実際の症例報告はコンゴ共和国からの報告である。ウガンダは隣国で接触者管理の対象地域と考えられるが、確定例の報告地としては記載されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株は治療法・ワクチンがなく極めて深刻。Africa CDC報告のためアフリカ域内の関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : vaccins, traitements... Quelles sont les solutions pour endiguer la maladie qui a déjà causé la mort de plus de 200 personnes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: vaccines, treatments... What are the solutions to stem the outbreak that has already claimed more than 200 lives.
article.articleSummary: On June 18, 2026, the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda has surpassed 800 confirmed cases and 202 deaths since it was declared on May 15; the true extent remains unknown due to spread into remote RDC regions. With no licensed vaccine or treatment for the Bundibugyo strain, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and funders are advancing candidates and trials. The most promising vaccine is a single-dose rVSV-Bundibugyo, sharing the Ervebo platform used for the Zaïre Ebola vaccine; human testing is likely 7–9 months, potentially 6–7 months per virologist Geisbert. A second candidate uses the ChAdOx1 platform (Oxford University/Serum Institute), and Moderna is developing an mRNA vaccine; CEPI says Phase 1 could start within 2–3 months, potentially by July, with CEPI funding. Three treatments prioritized by WHO for rapid trials: remdesivir (Gilead), MBP134 monoclonal antibody (Mapp Biopharmaceutical), and Maftivimab (Regeneron).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：ワクチン、治療法...200人以上の死者を出ている流行を封じ込めるための解決策は何か
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の確認症例800件以上、死者202人、複数国への拡大、ワクチン・治療法不在という極めて深刻な状況。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに「neighboring Uganda」の記載があるが、詳細な症例数や具体的な発生地情報がウガンダについては述べられていない。対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラ・ブンディブギョ株の新興アウトブレイクであり、ワクチン・治療法不在という点で国際的対応が急務。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果（金）伊波拉死亡人數破200 控疫需時料最少一年 (00:06) - 20260619 - 國際
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Congo (Kinshasa) surpasses 200; containment efforts to curb the outbreak are expected to take at least a year (00:06) - 2026-06-19 - International.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) has surpassed 200 deaths. Among 875 confirmed Ebola cases, 202 fatalities have occurred (case fatality rate 23%). Africa CDC and the WHO say contact tracing remains difficult due to ongoing conflict and high population movement, leaving some regions hard to reach. The International Red Cross warns the Congo and neighboring Uganda outbreak is not yet peaked and could require at least one year to control. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, with most infections linked to Congo. There is currently no vaccine or approved treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The situation highlights the challenges of surveillance and outbreak response in conflict-affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（金）のエボラ出血熱死亡者数が200人を超過、疫学対策に最低1年必要との見通し
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の死亡数増加、国際的拡大の危機、貿易・渡航制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目全て該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダも19例・2死亡と報告されているが、記事サマリーでは主要な発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダの感染はコンゴからの関連と記載。対象国リストではウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株で、現在有効なワクチン・承認済み治療法がないという深刻な状況。紛争地域での接触追跡の困難さと人口移動により長期化のリスク。

article.articleHeadline: ASF cases contained in Nueva Vizcaya
article.articleSummary: As of June 18, 2026, African swine fever (ASF) cases detected in Nueva Vizcaya, Philippines, remain isolated and under control. The Provincial Veterinary Services Office reports 23 ASF cases in Kasibu, Bayombong and Villaverde in 2026, but officials say these were localized incidents rapidly managed through surveillance, movement restrictions and containment measures, easing concerns over a wider outbreak in the province. The Bureau of Animal Industry (BAI) states the outbreak risk has eased and that containment is ongoing. No clinical symptom details are provided in the report, but authorities continue to monitor swine movements and enforce biosecurity to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ヌエバビスカヤ州の豚熱（ASF）症例が封じ込められている
triage.triage_reason: 動物における家畜疾病であり、人への直接的な公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は記事から明確でない。また、当局により既に封じ込められており、予想外性や国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクも低い。
triage.notes: フィリピンのヌエバビスカヤ州における豚熱（ASF）のイベントであり、対象国に該当する。ただし、本イベントは動物疾病（家畜）が対象であり、当局により既に封じ込められている状況が報告されている。IHR(2005)は人の健康に関する国際的懸念に焦点を当てているため、この家畜疾病単独ではシグナルピックアップの基準を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: India News | Union Health Minister JP Nadda Reviews Dengue and Malaria Preparedness Ahead of Monsoon Season
article.articleSummary: India’s Union Health Minister JP Nadda chaired a 18 June 2026 high-level review of dengue and malaria preparedness ahead of the monsoon and post-monsoon season. The national focus is strengthened surveillance, prompt reporting, active monitoring, and rapid response to contain mosquito-borne infections. Hospitals across India were urged to ensure adequate medicines, diagnostics, blood components, beds, and trained personnel to maintain uninterrupted care and handle rising case loads if needed. Strict adherence to dengue and malaria treatment protocols and timely case management were stressed. Intensified vector-control measures—source reduction, breeding-site elimination, fogging—and sustained preventive actions in vulnerable areas were urged, with broad IEC campaigns and community participation (Resident Welfare Associations, Panchayati Raj Institutions, schools). India has cut malaria burden dramatically (2015–2025: ~80% decline in cases and deaths; 160 districts reported zero indigenous malaria in 2022–2025) and exited the WHO HBHI group in 2024, per World Malaria Report 2025.

triage.headline_ja: インド: モンスーン季節前のデング熱とマラリアへの準備態勢をナッダ保健相が検討
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防的な行政レビュー会議の報告であり、新規のアウトブレイク、異常な症例増加、または危機的な公衆衛生事象を報告していない。インドはマラリア制御で顕著な成功を示しており、準備態勢の強化は通常の季節対応である。
triage.notes: 記事はインド政府による季節対応の準備状況に関する行政報告である。実際の感染症流行の急増やアウトブレイク、異常な症例報告ではなく、マラリア制御における過去10年間の成功（2015-2025年で約80%の症例・死亡削減）を背景とした通常の予防的対応である。シグナル価値なし。

article.articleHeadline: Febre amarela: Vale do Paraíba registra nove casos com cinco óbitos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow fever: Paraíba Valley records nine cases with five deaths.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever outbreaks in São Paulo state, Brazil, as of June 18, 2026: Paraíba Valley (Vale do Paraíba) accounts for 9 of the 9 confirmed cases this year (82% of state cases), with five of the state's six deaths in the Vale. The latest case is a 55-year-old man from Lagoinha; vaccination history is absent. Across the state, none of the patients with yellow fever or deaths had been vaccinated. In addition to the Paraíba Valley, one case occurred in the Sorocaba region (no death) and one in the Bauru region (death). Health authorities urge vaccination, especially for travelers to rural, forested areas or other sites with viral circulation, and emphasize constant epidemiological monitoring and prompt reporting of suspected cases to ensure rapid response and prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病：パライバ渓谷で9症例、5人の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで黄熱病の集団発生が報告され、9症例5死亡と重症度が高く、ワクチン接種歴なしの患者多数で管理可能性に懸念。IHR基準2つ以上、WPRO基準4つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: 2026年6月18日時点でブラジル・サンパウロ州パライバ渓谷地域で9症例（州全体の82%）、5死亡を記録。全患者がワクチン接種歴なしで、林地・農村部での感染リスクが指摘されている。オンゴーイングな流行に対する監視強化と報告システムの迅速性が求められている。

article.articleHeadline: Más de 200 muertos por ébola en RD Congo casi un mes después del inicio de la epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 200 Ebola deaths in DR Congo almost a month after the outbreak began.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality rate ~23%), about one month after the outbreak declaration on May 15. The Bundibugyo strain is responsible, and there is currently no vaccine or approved treatment. Africa CDC notes that contact tracing is a major concern due to security and access challenges; WHO and partners are involved. The Red Cross warns the outbreak has not yet peaked and could last up to a year. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DR Congo, unfolding amid significant response challenges. No vaccine or standard therapy exists for Bundibugyo, complicating containment and treatment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱で200人以上が死亡、流行開始から約1ヶ月後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持つ異常イベントであり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: DRCでの確認患者数875名、死亡者202名、致命率約23%。Bundibugyo株による流行で、ワクチンや承認された治療法がない。セキュリティと現地へのアクセス課題により接触者追跡が困難。赤十字は流行がピークに達しておらず、最大1年間続く可能性があると警告。DRCにおける17番目のエボラアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola | Ya son 200 los fallecidos por la enfermedad en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola | There are now 200 deaths from the disease in Congo.
article.articleSummary: June 18, 2026: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo worsens, with Africa CDC reporting 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths, indicating a high mortality rate. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain driving the outbreak has no vaccine or approved treatment. Contact tracing and epidemiological surveillance are hampered by security conditions and limited access to affected communities, potentially sustaining transmission chains. The outbreak centers on Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, regions marred by violence and displacement. Authorities warn the epidemic has not peaked and could persist for months; the Red Cross cautions that containment and response remain challenged.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ | コンゴで既に200人が当該疾患で死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。ブンディブギョエボラウイルス株によるアウトブレイク、875確認症例、202死亡、高い致死率、ワクチン・承認治療なし、セキュリティと限定されたアクセスによる対策困難。フルRRA実施推奨。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is a known pathogen with high mortality. The outbreak is actively spreading in multiple provinces (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu). Security conditions and limited access severely impair outbreak response. WHO notification and urgent international engagement expected.

article.articleHeadline: Brote del ébola en la República Democrática del Congo supera la barrera de los 200 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses the 200-death mark.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 202 deaths and 875 confirmed cases since May 15, with a 23% case fatality rate and 67 recoveries. Ituri Province is the epicenter, accounting for about 91% of cases and 78% of deaths. The Bundibugyo strain is driving transmission. The outbreak has spread to North and South Kivu, where response is hampered by armed conflict, limited access, and weak contact tracing in North Kivu. The epidemic has extended to Uganda, with 19 confirmed cases and two deaths, including imported infections from the DRC. The WHO considers the situation a public health emergency of international concern, and both WHO and Africa CDC have activated a regional response plan aiming to raise about $518 million to contain the outbreak and bolster health capacities. The virus is believed to have circulated in Ituri weeks before the official declaration.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が確認死亡者200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認感染者875名、死亡者202名の大規模流行で、複数国への国際拡大（DRC、ウガンダ）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、国際的対応体制の発動が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの波及（確認例19名、死亡2名）も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主たる発生地で対象国であり、対象国リストに含まれている。エボラウイルス病は23%の高い致死率、武装紛争による対応困難、Bundibugyo株による人間-人間感染が特徴。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、Africa CDC含む国際的対応体制が既に発動されており、直ちにフルリスク評価に進めるべき案件。

article.articleHeadline: En RDC, Alima appelle les communautés à lutter contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, Alima calls on communities to fight Ebola.
article.articleSummary: One month after Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo was officially declared on May 18, Bundibugyo Ebola has caused over 200 deaths and at least 875 cases, per Africa CDC and the Red Cross (likely undercounted). The outbreak spans South and North Kivu and Ituri, with ALIMA deploying across three treatment centers, about 50 health facilities, and 800 staff in the region. Barry Mamadou Kaba, ALIMA’s head in Goma, highlights fear and denial among communities and urges broad community engagement beyond hotspots to curb transmission. There is no vaccine or specific treatment in eastern DRC at this time. Preventive guidance includes hand hygiene, distancing, and rapid follow-up of contacts; ALIMA has established bio-secure emergency rooms with glass viewing for transparency and safe, supervised handling of bodies for funerals. Areas outside Bunia remain underserved.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）において、ALIMAはエボラとの戦いのためにコミュニティに呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は200人以上の死亡と875人以上の確認症例を記録し、複数州にまたがる活動的な流行である。国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在する。
triage.notes: バンジブギオ型エボラウイルスによる2026年の流行。5月18日に公式宣言され、現在3州（South Kivu、North Kivu、Ituri）に拡大。ワクチンと特異的治療法が利用できない状況。社会的な恐怖と否定的態度が感染制御に影響。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ebola já deixa mais de 200 mortos na República Democrática do Congo - Metro 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak has already claimed more than 200 lives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Metro 1
