article.articleHeadline: Mauá Realiza Dia D De Vacinação Contra Gripe E Febre Amarela
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mauá Holds D-Day Vaccination Against Influenza and Yellow Fever
article.articleSummary: On 18 June 2026, Mauá, Brazil announces a D-Day vaccination event on Saturday, 20 June, across 23 Basic Health Units (UBS) from 08:00 to 17:00 to boost vaccination coverage. The campaign prioritizes influenza vaccination amid circulating respiratory viruses and intensifies yellow fever immunization, with vaccines offered to all ages and a focus on maintaining complete vaccination schedules. Health teams will assess individuals’ vaccination status and update records when doses are overdue. Secretary of Health Eliene de Paula Pinto underscored vaccines’ life-saving role and urged residents to visit the nearest UBS and bring their vaccination records. Vaccinations are safe, free, and aimed at reducing hospitalizations, complications, and deaths from vaccine-preventable diseases. Residents should bring photo ID, CPF or SUS card, and, if possible, the vaccination booklet.

triage.headline_ja: マウア市がインフルエンザと黄熱病に対するワクチン接種D-Day（一斉接種キャンペーン）を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは定期的な予防接種キャンペーンの告知であり、異常な疾病発生ではない。既存の定着疾患に対する公衆衛生対策プログラムのため、シグナル化の要件を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は予防接種キャンペーンの案内であり、新規の疾病発生や異常な健康イベント（outbreak signal）ではない。イエローフィーバーとインフルエンザは既知の流行地疾患であり、当局による計画的な公衆衛生措置。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれないが、地域検証ルール上、南米の非対象国のため影響評価には含めない。ただし記事の主題がブラジルのみであることは確認した。

article.articleHeadline: Study finds potential links between virus found in aquaculture and human eye disease
article.articleSummary: Covert mortality nodovirus (CMNV), pervasive in global aquaculture across 49 species and first identified in farmed Chinese shrimp in 2014, is linked to human ocular hypertension viral anterior uveitis (POH-VAU) in a Nature Microbiology study. In 70 POH-VAU patients from January 2022 to April 2025, eye tissue samples yielded CMNV particles with ~99% similarity to aquatic CMNV strains, and patients tested positive for CMNV antibodies. While not proving causation, the strongest exposure signal was handling raw seafood; about 71% reported recent contact with shrimp or other seafood, and 82.8% involved home-based handlers or consumers of raw products. CMNV has been detected in Antarctic krill used for human consumption and as shrimp feed, with prior transmission from krill-based feed to shrimp. Some patients required glaucoma surgery; animal experiments showed transmission via shared water. Authors caution the findings are preliminary and call for further research and protective measures for processors and handlers with wounds.

triage.headline_ja: 養殖業で見つかったウイルスと人間の眼病の潜在的な関連性を研究が示唆
triage.triage_reason: 新規・未知のウイルス（CMNV）と人間の眼疾患との潜在的な関連性が科学誌で報告され、国際的な食品サプライチェーン（中国、南極資源含む）に関連。異常性・重症度・公開衛生関心において複数の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは中国の養殖シロエビで2014年に初めて特定された CMNV と、70人の POH-VAU患者における眼組織からの検出を主要な内容としている。南極オキアミはサプライチェーンの一部として言及されているが、実際の感染事例の発生地は報告患者の居住地が不明であるため、verified_locations は中国のみとした。ただし患者がどの国から報告されたかの明記がないため、潜在的に追加の対象国が関与している可能性がある。フルRRAでは患者の地理的分布を確認すること。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊拉波疫情釀逾200死　恐需一年才能控制下來
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Irabo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 200 people and could take a year to bring under control.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak has caused more than 200 deaths among 875 confirmed cases (case fatality ~23%). The northeast provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu are affected amid long-standing conflict and mass displacement that strain response efforts. Declared about a month ago (May 15), the outbreak risks a protracted course; the Red Cross warns it has not yet peaked and could take up to a year to control. No licensed vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo virus. Access restrictions and security challenges hinder contact tracing and investigations by Africa CDC, WHO, and partners. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, with 19 cases and 2 deaths, most of them travelers from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国のエボラ疫情が200人以上の死者を出し、制御に1年要する可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、Bundibugyo Ebolaウイルスによる大規模アウトブレイク。200人以上の死者、複数国への越境、予防接種なし、紛争地域での対応困難という重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC内でのBundibugyo Ebolasの発生が主題。ウガンダへの越境も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC内のSouth KivuおよびIturi州が主要な発生地域。2026年6月19日時点で875人の確定症例、200人以上の死亡（CFR ~23%）。ワクチン・治療薬なし。紛争地域での対応困難が特徴。

article.articleHeadline: Over 200 døde i Ebola-utbruddet i Kongo - smitteøkning på 40 prosent på én uke
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 200 have died in the Ebola outbreak in the Congo — a 40 percent increase in transmission in one week.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo has killed over 200 people in the first month and reached 894 confirmed cases, according to Africa CDC. The outbreak is about three times larger than Uganda’s 2000 episode, with cases rising 40% in the past week and eastern Congo now heavily affected. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola, a highly contagious viral hemorrhagic fever, spreads via body fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. Ongoing conflict, mass displacement, and weak health systems hinder response; there is no vaccine for the new Ebola variant yet. The African Union has secured pledges totaling $910 million to combat Ebola in Congo and Uganda, with $518 million to be deployed in the next four weeks. Vaccine development is underway; trials for two vaccines targeting the Bundibugyo variant could begin as early as July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行で200人以上が死亡 — 1週間で感染が40%増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concernを宣言。エボラウイルスの高感染性、急速な症例増加、複数国への拡大リスク、および国際的な支援需要が明確に存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでコンゴでの流行が主題であり、ウガンダは比較対象として言及されているのみ。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。WHOの緊急事態宣言、急速な症例増加（40%/週）、高い致死率（200人/894確定例）、ワクチン未開発、東部コンゴの深刻な紛争・難民発生状況が主要な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: OMS redobra esforços para conter ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO redoubles its efforts to contain Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak attributed to the Bundibugyo virus continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, about a month after declaration. DRC reports over 780 confirmed cases and 180 deaths; Uganda records 19 notifications including two deaths. Field response has expanded to roughly 400 beds with four laboratories in operation, two of which process nearly 1,000 samples daily. WHO cautions that effort levels remain far from sufficient, rating current response around 3–4 out of 10. The drive hinges on 11 pillars: community surveillance, rapid investigation teams, transit centers, laboratories, treatment centers, infection prevention and control, and data management, plus psychosocial and nutritional support for patients, families, and contacts. Suspected cases trigger immediate investigations; confirmed alerts proceed to transit centers awaiting lab results before transfer. A MONUSCO subcontractor in Bunia died of Ebola; he hadn’t worked for MONUSCO since May 22, 2026 and hadn’t been on mission premises for over 21 days before diagnosis. WHO also released its first comprehensive filovirus clinical management guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: WHO エボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）のアウトブレイクがDRCとウガンダで継続中で、確認症例780例以上・死亡180例を超える重大な公衆衛生影響を示している。IHR基準の複数該当（重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、国境警備リスク）が明白。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedotの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの症例報告（19例）が言及されているものの、主なアウトブレイクはDRCで発生している。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。ウガンダ（対象国外）への国際的拡大は認識されるが、検証された発生地は対象国内のDRCに限定。WHO公式発表による大規模アウトブレイク、多数死亡、地域での感染継続、国際的関心の高さから優先度極高。

article.articleHeadline: Congo supera las 200 muertes confirmadas por brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo surpasses 200 confirmed deaths from Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province remains the epicenter, accounting for 91% of cases and 78% of deaths. As of June 18, 2026, 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths have been reported, with 67 recoveries (case fatality rate ~23%). The outbreak was declared on May 15 in the eastern region. The virus has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. In North Kivu, ongoing conflict between the army and rebel groups renders large areas inaccessible to response teams, with a high case-fatality rate and the lowest level of contact tracing among the three provinces. Surveillance and response are hampered by security challenges in the affected districts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ出血熱の流行で確認死者数200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（202人の死亡、875人の確認症例）、異常な事象、国際的拡大リスク（複数州への拡散）、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが複数該当する。WPRO基準でも重症度（CFR~23%、多数死亡）、長期曝露の可能性（紛争地域での管理困難）、流行性（ヒト-ヒト感染、対応制限）が認められ、フルRRA進行に値する。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州が流行の中心（症例の91%、死者の78%）。North Kivu、South Kivu州にも拡散確認。紛争による対応困難が報告されており、管理可能性が大きく制限されている。エボラ出血熱の特性上、国際的な懸念と支援需要が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Butembo : une mobilisation communautaire accrue recommandée dans la riposte d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Butembo: Increased Community Mobilization Recommended in the Ebola Response - ACP
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo – An intensified community mobilization effort was urged in Butembo as Ebola virus disease spreads in the Butembo and Katwa health zones. North Kivu province reports 78 confirmed cases, with 25 in each Butembo and Katwa, and a death toll of 45; four patients have recovered. Response challenges include rising case numbers, insufficient community engagement, vandalism targeting health facilities and teams, and the spread of unverified information. Surveillance remains weak, some confirmed patients leave treatment centers, several medical facilities have closed, and resistance to control measures complicates containment. Prevention costs are rising, and many contact chains remain unidentified. Treatments for Katwa patients are at Katwa General Hospital's Ebola Treatment Center, while Butembo patients receive care at Kitatumba General Reference Hospital. A media training session is planned for June 19, 2026, in Butembo, reflecting calls for closer collaboration among authorities, health workers, media, and communities.

triage.headline_ja: ブテンボにおけるエボラ：エボラ対策における地域動員の強化が推奨される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。進行中のエボラウイルス病アウトブレイクで確定症例78例、死亡45例が報告され、対応上の課題も多い。
triage.notes: 進行中のエボラアウトブレイクで、北キブ州のブテンボおよびカトワ保健区域で拡大中。確定症例78例（死亡45例、回復4例）。対応上の課題として、地域動員の不足、医療施設への破壊行為、未検証情報の拡散、患者の治療センター離脱、医療施設の閉鎖、制御措置への抵抗など多数報告。サーベイランスが弱く、接触者追跡が不十分で、費用増加も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: പനിബാധിതർ കൂടുന്നു; 19 പേർക്കു കൂടി ഷിഗെല്ല ഡങ്കിക്കൊപ്പം എലിപ്പനിയും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fever patients on the rise; 19 more people with Shigella dysentery and typhoid.
article.articleSummary: As of June 18, 2026, Kerala reports rising fever cases with 19 new Shigella dysentery cases across districts: Thiruvananthapuram 2, Kollam 1, Ernakulam 1, Thrissur 3, Malappuram 1, Kozhikode 9, Kannur 2. Shigella dysentery totals in June reach 110. The monsoon season coincides with the spread of febrile illnesses across all districts; 13,849 people sought OPD care for fever yesterday. Dengue infections are confirmed in 68 people, with 297 dengue‑like cases under treatment. In the capital district, 24 dengue cases have been confirmed. Chickenpox (varicella) has been diagnosed in 16 people across districts. Typhoid is also cited in the report alongside Shigella in the headline. A diarrheal-disease prevention campaign, led by the health department and other agencies, runs until July 31.

triage.headline_ja: 発熱患者が増加; シゲラ赤痢とともに19人がさらにチフスに罹患
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーラ州で複数の感染症（シゲラ赤痢110例、デング68例確認、水痘16例、チフス）が同時多発的に発生しており、IHR基準の「異常・予想外性」と「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」に該当。スクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度・流行可能性が確認され、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケーラ州での複数感染症の同時多発を報告。シゲラ赤痢(110例)、デング確認例(68例)、水痘(16例)、チフスが並行して発生。モンスーン時期による環境的要因が基盤にあり、衛生キャンペーンが展開中。13,849人が発熱でOPD受診と高い患者流入を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊拉波疫情釀逾200死 恐需一年才能控制下來
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 200 people and could take a year to contain.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 200 people, with Africa CDC reporting 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality rate ~23%) as of mid-June 2026. The strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. The response is hampered by security conditions that hinder entry by Africa CDC, WHO, and partners into several districts, contributing to low contact-tracing rates. The northeast Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, already scarred by decades of conflict and displacement, are at the epicenter. The Red Cross warns the outbreak is not peaked and could take up to a year to contain. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, which reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, largely among travelers from DRC, with Ugandan authorities deploying control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国のエボラ出血熱の流行で200人以上が死亡し、制御に1年要する可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模流行（875確認例、202死亡例）で深刻な公衆衛生影響を呈し、国際的に拡大（ウガンダへ波及）し、渡航制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによれば、エボラ流行の主要発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダへの波及が記述されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。ワクチン・治療法がない Bundibugogyo ebolavirus によるレベルの高い脅威、セキュリティ上の制約による対応困難が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: EU, G7 pledge support amid DRC Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: EU commits €493 million in humanitarian aid and health-security support for the DRC Ebola outbreak, centered in Ituri province. The Bundibugyo strain has caused 837 confirmed cases and 196 deaths, with 29 cases in the last 24 hours. At the G7 summit, leaders urged a strong, coordinated international response to this crisis, which the WHO has designated a public health emergency of international concern. The European funds aim to fund frontline medical support, humanitarian aid in the Great Lakes region and Uganda, vaccine and treatment research, and longer-term health-system preparedness. The risk to Europe remains low, though health security is framed as shared. Some Uganda cases are imported from DRC; Uganda says it has the situation under control inside its borders. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC; the Red Cross warns the outbreak has not yet peaked.

triage.headline_ja: EU、G7がDRCエボラ流行の中で支援を約束
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WHO公式PHEIC指定、837確定例196死亡という重症例の多発、複数国への拡大（DRC、ウガンダ）。
triage.notes: WHO公式PHEIC指定済み。記事サマリーでDRC中心で837確定例196死亡、Ituri州に集中、ウガンダへの限定的な流入を確認。Bundibugyo株による第17次流行。オーストラリア・ニューサウスウェールズ州は発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文での言及なし（Bluedot APIの地理的誤分類と考えられる）。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Síndrome Respiratória Aguda Grave voltam a crescer no Brasil, alerta Fiocruz | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome are rising again in Brazil, Fiocruz warns | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: SRAG (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome) cases are rising across Brazil in epidemiological year 2026. A total of 89,725 SRAG cases have been reported, with 44,485 (49.6%) lab-positive for a respiratory virus, 31,637 (35.3%) negative, and at least 7,740 (8.6%) awaiting results. There have been 3,842 SRAG deaths, of which 1,772 (46.1%) are lab-positive, 1,679 (43.7%) negative, and at least 82 (2.1%) awaiting results. Among lab-confirmed deaths, influenza A accounts for 41.7%, influenza B 5.8%, RSV 9.6%, rhinovirus 20.4%, and SARS-CoV-2 20.1%. Fiocruz notes most states remain at alert/risk/high for SRAG, with hospitalizations rising as winter onset approaches. Fourteen of 27 states and 11 capitals show SRAG activity with a rising long-term trend through week 23, including Acre, Alagoas, Amapá, Goiás, Maranhão, Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Pará, Rio Grande do Sul, Rio de Janeiro, Roraima, Santa Catarina, São Paulo; Belém, Belo Horizonte, Boa Vista, Campo Grande, Curitiba, Florianópolis, Macapá, Porto Alegre, Rio Branco, São Luís, Vitória. Vaccination against influenza and COVID-19 remains the main strategy; InfoGripe monitors SRAG nationwide.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）症例が再び増加、フィオクルス研究所が警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全土で重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）の症例が増加しており、89,725症例・3,842死亡が報告されている。インフルエンザA/B、RSV、SARS-CoV-2など複数の呼吸器病原体が関与し、14州11都市で上昇トレンドが確認されており、IHR基準3項目以上該当かつWPRO基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 複数の呼吸器病原体（インフルエンザA/B、RSV、SARS-CoV-2、ライノウイルス）が同時流行している状況。死亡率46.1%（ラボ確認陽性）は懸念すべき水準。冬季到来に伴い入院患者が増加傾向にあり、フィオクルス研究所による正式な警告も発出されている。

article.articleHeadline: Deux ministres à Bunia pour évaluer les activités de la riposte contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two ministers in Bunia to assess the Ebola response activities - ACP
article.articleSummary: Two Congolese central-government ministers arrived in Bunia, in the North-East of the Democratic Republic of Congo, to assess the Ebola virus disease (EVD) response one month after the 15 May outbreak declaration. Health Minister Samuel-Roger Kamba said the mission is the third organized by the government in 30 days to verify field actions aimed at stopping transmission. The objective is to evaluate the response after a month, identify strengths and weaknesses, and ensure adequate resources and measures are in place to contend with a major outbreak. The ministers also intend to meet the new governor to coordinate collaboration in this epidemic context, noting ongoing discussions with the former governor. The visit underscores government efforts to monitor and adjust the response on the ground to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアに2人の大臣がエボラ出血熱対策活動を評価に到着 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生影響を持つ異常・予想外の疾患であり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクが存在。政府レベルでの対応が進行中。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を持つ感染症であり、2026年5月15日にDRCで感染症宣言されている。政府が3回目の現地評価ミッションを組織するなど、アクティブな対応が進行中。複数省庁による調整・支援の動きあり。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Health dept takes precautions as infections may rise in El Nino year
article.articleSummary: Pune, Maharashtra: In anticipation of a likely El Niño‑driven rise in vector-borne infections, the state health department has ordered intensified surveillance, pre-outbreak preparedness, entomological surveys, larval-source management, and interdepartmental coordination for the monsoon. Dr Sandeep Sangale says hospitals must register suspected vector-borne infections; data updated daily on the health portal. Coordinated monitoring with gram panchayats, municipal bodies, water supply and sanitation dept; regular district reviews mandated. The Union government cautioned dengue cases could rise in 2026 due to El Niño, referencing higher dengue in El Niño years 2021 and 2024. Locally, authorities warn of dengue, chikungunya and Zika spread by Aedes mosquitoes with onset of monsoon. Health staff and ASHA workers to conduct household surveys, inspect water tanks, coolers, tyres, vases; public awareness campaigns including a weekly 'Dry Day'.

triage.headline_ja: エル・ニーニョの年に感染症が増加する可能性があるため、保健部門が予防措置を講じる
triage.triage_reason: ベクター媒介感染症（デングウイルス、チクングニア、ジカウイルス）の予防的監視と準備活動が報告されているが、現在のアウトブレイク発生や深刻な健康被害の報告がなく、予測的な対応段階である。
triage.notes: 記事はプネ、マハーラシュトラ州で季節的なベクター媒介感染症の予防措置が実施されていることを報告している。2026年のエル・ニーニョ現象に伴う感染症増加の予測に基づく事前対応であり、現在のアウトブレイク段階ではない。インド政府による公式な警告があり、保健部門の取り組みは組織的であるが、深刻な影響や国際的な拡大の兆候は報告されていない。継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: الخلية الوطنية للطوارئ تعقد اجتماعها الثالث لمتابعة تطورات وباء "الإيبولا" - الوكالة الموريتانية للأنباء
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The National Emergency Cell Holds Its Third Meeting to Monitor Developments in the Ebola Outbreak - Mauritanian News Agency
article.articleSummary: June 18, 2026 — Mauritania's National Emergency Cell held its third meeting to monitor developments in the Ebola outbreak in Africa. The session reviewed regional and international efforts, including WHO–African CDC collaborations and an African summit emphasizing early warning, surveillance, risk communication, and rapid response capacity. Mauritania reported ongoing diaspora engagement, public awareness campaigns on transmission and prevention, and continuous monitoring of Mauritanian citizens in affected countries. Proactive preparedness measures by the Health Ministry include heightened vigilance in health facilities and municipalities, staff training (hospital directors, district physicians, emergency services), dissemination of infection-prevention leaflets, provision of PPE and supplies, and border-point readiness at airports and land crossings; coordination with the airline Asky. Epidemiologically, infections remain centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo; Uganda has reported 11 consecutive days with no new cases. Mauritania’s risk remains low, but zero risk is not guaranteed, underscoring sustained vigilance and interagency information sharing.

triage.headline_ja: ナショナル・エマージェンシー・セルが、エボラ流行の進展を監視するための3回目の会議を開催 - モーリタニア通信社
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生が確認されており、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）を複数満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（流行しやすさ、管理可能性）も該当する。地域的な重要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、実際のエボラ感染はDRC（民主共和国コンゴ）とウガンダで確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。モーリタニアは主に監視・対応会議の開催国であり、発生地ではなく、また対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。記事は2026年6月18日付（将来の日付）であり、提供データの時間軸に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Estudo com a Ufac revela falhas no diagnóstico de leishmaniose no interior do Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A study with UFAC reveals failures in diagnosing leishmaniasis in the interior of Acre.
article.articleSummary: Cutaneous leishmaniasis in Acre, Brazil, faces major diagnostic and treatment barriers identified by a UFAC-led study in Sena Madureira, Western Amazon. Interviews with 50 patients with clinical suspicion and 51 public health workers (63% community health agents; 37% endemic-control agents) found limited knowledge among both stakeholders, worsened by the geographic isolation of rural endemics, delaying care. The research, published in the May issue of Acervo Saúde (vol. 26), supports Leandro Siqueira de Souza’s IOC/Fiocruz PhD, coordinated by Reginaldo Peçanha Brazil. Acre records extensive transmission history, with more than 11,000 notifications in the last decade; five Acre municipalities—Xapuri, Marechal Thaumaturgo, Assis Brasil, Sena Madureira, and Brasiléia—are classified as intense-risk areas. The mapping will inform municipal training and care flow for frontline agents in the inland Acre forests; funding from CNPq via a multi-institution consortium, including UFAC, Fiocruz, UFMG, UnB, ICMBio, and Sesacre.

triage.headline_ja: Ufacの研究はAcre内部における皮膚リーシュマニア症の診断における失敗を明らかにする
triage.triage_reason: 皮膚リーシュマニア症はブラジル（対象国）で流行している既知の疾患であり、診断・治療の課題が報告されているが、新規の感染症の出現や国際的な拡大リスクの明確な証拠に欠ける。情報は主に研究知見に基づいており、緊急の公衆衛生危機を示す証拠が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の風土病であるAcre州の皮膚リーシュマニア症の診断・治療上の課題に関する学術研究の発表である。過去10年間で11,000件以上の届け出があり、長期的な曝露リスクと流行しやすさが確認される。ただし新規の異常な発生や国際的な拡大の兆候は記載されていない。公開性は低い。対象国リストにはブラジルが含まれているが、WPRO地域ではないため、REMOアナリストは本トリアージを参考としつつ、地域スクリーニングプロセスに委ねることを推奨する。

article.articleHeadline: Saiba quando procurar atendimento de emergência no Hospital Regional Norte em casos de dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Know when to seek emergency care at the North Regional Hospital for dengue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Sobral, Ceará, Brazil, with the North Regional Hospital (HRN) emergency unit handling severe cases. Dengue is a viral disease transmitted by Aedes aegypti. Symptoms often appear suddenly: high fever, headache, pain behind the eyes, muscle and joint pains, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, and red spots on skin. Most cases improve with hydration and basic care, but dengue can progress to severe forms. Warning signs requiring emergency care include intense, persistent abdominal pain; ongoing vomiting; nose or gum bleeding; blood in stool or vomit; dizziness or fainting; breathing difficulty; drowsiness or irritability; decreased urine output; and marked weakness. The hospital triages and manages cases by severity. Dengue can involve increased vascular permeability, dehydration, hypotension, shock, and organ involvement (liver, heart, nervous system). Prevention remains essential: eliminate breeding sites, cover water containers, remove standing water, clean gutters and drains, and properly dispose of tires and bottles. Community cooperation is crucial year-round.

triage.headline_ja: Sobralのセアラ州にデングが発生し、北地域病院（HRN）で重症例に対応している場合の緊急受診の時期を確認する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではなく、また記事は既知のデング流行時の医療施設対応ガイダンスの提供が主体であり、新規または異常な感染症イベントのシグナルではない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが検出した発生地域にはブラジルが含まれているが、本システムの対象国（CEPR加盟WPRO地域）にはブラジルは含まれていない。記事はセアラ州Sobralのデング対応についての医療施設ガイダンスであり、新規シグナルではなく、既知の風土病への対応方法の情報提供である。

article.articleHeadline: Los CDC destinarán 107 millones de dólares en fondos para combatir el ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The CDC will allocate $107 million in funding to combat Ebola.
article.articleSummary: CDC will allocate 107 million dollars in emergency funds to bolster the U.S. and international Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths, about a month after the WHO declared an international emergency. Donors have pledged about 910 million dollars, including 80 million from African Union members, but less than 10% has been received and fewer than 90 million disbursed; the United States is the largest donor. The CDC currently has 23 staff in the field in the DRC, with more than 125 personnel deployed across DRC and Uganda. Activities include improving community acceptance of surveillance, isolation and safe burial, evaluating ports of entry, and providing diagnostic-laboratory support; authorities west of the outbreak are being strengthened to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: CDCはエボラ対策に1億700万ドルの資金を配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模アウトブレイク（確認症例875件、死亡202件）で、WHOが国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）宣言済み。DRCおよびウガンダでの発生であり、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク・多国籍対応が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダの両国での発生を述べているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当するため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言済みで、国際的枠組みでの対応が進行中。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は高リスク病原体。

article.articleHeadline: Oropouche virus infected millions more than official data shows
article.articleSummary: Oropouche virus expanded beyond the Amazon: Brazil surpassed official counts with >30,000 confirmed cases in 2023 and the first death; rapid spread to all states. Studies in Nature Medicine and Nature Health estimate from 1960 to present about 9.4 million infections in Latin America and the Caribbean, with ~5.5 million in Brazil. Disease causes fever and dengue-like symptoms and can cause meningitis, meningioencephalitis, and congenital microcephaly; about 1 in 1,000 diagnosed cases develop serious complications. Manaus, Amazonas, ~300,000 infections 2023–2024, seroprevalence up from 11.4% to 25.7%, indicating widespread transmission and heavy underreporting (≈260×). Espírito Santo had the highest cumulative rate; Southeast region accounts for 57.9% of cases. Transmission by Culicoides paraensis (gunpowder midge); rural prevalence higher; two major outbreaks (1980s and 2023). WHO issued international alert; vaccination strategies considered due to cross-protection observed across decades.

triage.headline_ja: オロポーシュウイルス、公式データより数百万人多く感染していた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の広がり、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行性）。ブラジル全域での急速な拡大、WHO国際アラート発出、深刻な過少報告の実態が明らかになった重要シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジルでのオロポーシュウイルスの大規模流行を主題としている。公式統計の260倍の過少報告が示唆され、1960年以来ラテンアメリカ全体で約940万人、ブラジル単独で約550万人の感染を推定。脳髄膜炎や先天性小頭症などの重症合併症（診断例の約1/1000）、2023年の初死亡例を報告。マナウスでの血清陽性率11.4%→25.7%への上昇は広範な伝播を示唆。WHOが国際アラート発出済み。ワクチン戦略検討中。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Οι νεκροί από την επιδημία του Έμπολα ξεπέρασαν τους 200
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: The death toll from the Ebola outbreak has surpassed 200.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with Ituri province in the northeastern region as the epicenter. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific therapy. Laboratory confirmation states 875 infections and 202 deaths as of May 15, giving a 23% case fatality rate. Death toll surpassed 200 about a month after a state of emergency was declared in the region. Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths; the outbreak there is described as under control. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids and close contact. Access is hampered by poor road networks and armed groups, complicating contact tracing; Africa CDC emergency chief Wesam Mankula cautioned about ongoing tracing challenges. Contextual note: Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past half-century.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ流行による死者が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョ株エボラウイルスの流行で875感染・202死亡（23%致死率）、ウガンダへの国際的拡大確認、ワクチン・特異的治療なし、公衆衛生インパクト甚大。スクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株エボラは承認されたワクチンや特異的治療がない。DRC Ituri州が震源地。ウガンダでも確認（19確定例、2死亡）だが、記事の主題はDRCの流行。道路網の不備と武装勢力により接触者追跡が困難。Africa CDC首脳が追跡困難を警告。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Разработват ваксини и лечения срещу епидемията от Ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vaccines and Treatments Being Developed for the Ebola Epidemic
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain of Ebola is driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with confirmed cases surpassing 875 and 202 deaths in over a month. No vaccines or treatments have been approved for this strain. Several candidates are advancing rapidly. The most promising, based on the rVSV platform, is tailored to Bundibugyo and could enter human trials in seven to nine months, though some scientists expect a shorter timeline. A faster vaccine from Oxford University and the Serum Institute using the ChAdOx1 technology may be ready sooner. Moderna is also developing an mRNA vaccine against Bundibugyo. The World Health Organization prioritizes therapeutic approaches: remdesivir (antiviral; promising in the lab but not yet tested in Bundibugyo patients), MBP134 monoclonal antibody from Mapp Biopharmaceutical, and maftivimab from Regeneron. CEPI says Phase 1 trials could start within 2–3 months. Past Ebola Zaire outbreaks took two years even with vaccine readiness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行に対するワクチンおよび治療法の開発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョ株エボラの流行により875例以上の確認患者と202人の死亡者が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大（DRC・ウガンダ両国での発生）、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（民主共和国）とウガンダでのブンディブギョ株エボラの流行が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。WHOの関与、ワクチン・治療法開発の進行状況について記載されており、国際的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: തെരുവുനായ്ക്കളുടെ ആക്രമണത്തിൽ ചത്ത കുറുനരിക്ക് പേവിഷബാധ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു. ഒരു കുട്ടിയുൾപ്പെടെ നാലുപേരെ കടിക്കുകയും ചെയ്ത കുറുനരിക്കാണ് പേവിഷബാധ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചത്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies infection confirmed in the mongoose that died in a stray dog attack. The mongoose, which had bitten four people including a child, was confirmed to have rabies.
article.articleSummary: On 18 June 2026, in Palissery, Thrissur, a mongoose that died after an attack by street dogs tested positive for rabies on post-mortem examination at a veterinary hospital. The mongoose had bitten four people, including a child. In response, local panchayat and health authorities launched emergency containment: bite victims were vaccinated, and the street dogs that attacked the mongoose were captured and placed under veterinary department surveillance; these dogs were also vaccinated. Surveillance in the area continues under the health department’s leadership. The incident highlights zoonotic rabies risk in the locality and the need for vaccination of exposed individuals and potentially exposed animals.

triage.headline_ja: 野犬の攻撃により死亡したマングースから狂犬病を確認。4人（子ども1人含む）が咬傷被害
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーララ州トリッシュールでマングースの狂犬病確認と複数咬傷事例が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度・流行しやすさ）に該当する可能性がある。ただし、地域的遮断が進行中で管理可能と判断され、国際的拡大リスクが明確でないため、続報を注視する段階が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にインドのケーララ州トリッシュールでの事例を述べており、既に地方自治体・保健当局による対応（咬傷者の予防接種、野犬の捕獲・監視・ワクチン接種、地域監視）が実施されている。マングースによる4人への咬傷（小児1人含む）という複数被害と、動物由来感染症（ズーノーシス）としての狂犬病の特性から、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度・流行しやすさ・異常性に該当する。一方、現時点では国際的拡大リスクが顕在化していないため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola precaution: Woman admitted to Kottayam MCH
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola case in Kerala: A woman from Pala, recently returning from South Sudan, was admitted to Kottayam Medical College Hospital in isolation after developing fever and vomiting. Ebola has not been confirmed; samples sent to Rajiv Gandhi Centre for Biotechnology in Thiruvananthapuram, with possible referral to Pune's National Reference Laboratory if needed. She traveled from Uganda to Kochi; authorities have directed travellers from affected African nations to report fever or symptoms. Health minister K Muraleedharan said preliminary examination was not alarming and a medical board will oversee treatment; contact list being prepared; PPE kits procured for health workers. Kerala lacks Ebola diagnosis facilities; test results awaited. Public not to panic; high-level expert team at MCH emphasizes no current cause for concern. Early Ebola symptoms include fever, sore throat, headache, fatigue, body pain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ注意報：女性がコッタヤム医科大学病院に入院
triage.triage_reason: エボラ疑い症例がインドで検出されました。国際的拡大リスク（南スーダン経由、ウガンダ渡航）、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性、予想外の発症地域の出現がWPRO基準を複数満たし、IHR基準の異常性・国際的拡大リスクを満たします。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはチャド、スーダン、ウガンダも含まれていますが、記事サマリーの主題は「インド（ケーララ州）での疑い症例検出」です。患者は南スーダン/ウガンダから帰国した人物で、インド国内での隔離・検査状況が焦点になっています。対象国リストに該当するのはインドのみであり、チャド・スーダン・ウガンダは記事の主題の発生地ではなく参照背景情報として扱われているため、verified_locationsに含めません。

article.articleHeadline: DOH reports travel-related dengue virus case in Oʻahu visitor
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-18, Hawaii DOH reports a travel-related dengue case on Oʻahu in a visiting nonresident; the statewide official count remains five. Exposure occurred abroad in a region where dengue is common; local transmission risk is low and the traveler was not infectious at departure. DOH has deployed teams for inspections, outreach, and mosquito-control in the affected area. Dengue is transmitted by mosquitoes after an infected person-to-mosquito cycle; Hawaii is not endemic and current cases are travel-associated. Dengue risk is year-round in tropical/subtropical regions including Central/South America (Brazil, Mexico), Asia (Philippines), the Caribbean (Puerto Rico), and Pacific Islands (American Samoa, FSM, Marshall Islands, Palau). To reduce risk, eliminate standing water, use EPA-registered repellent, wear long sleeves/pants, and sleep in screened or air-conditioned rooms. Travelers should avoid bites for three weeks after return and seek evaluation if symptoms develop within two weeks; call 808-586-4586.

triage.headline_ja: DOH、オアフ島の旅行者における渡航関連デング熱ウイルス患者を報告
triage.triage_reason: 海外での曝露による単一の渡航関連症例であり、ハワイでの局所感染リスクは低いと評価されている。IHR基準は2つ未満の該当、スクリーニング基準も限定的であり、現段階では情報不足のため経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事は主にハワイでの単一の渡航関連デング熱症例を報告。ハワイは対象国リストに含まれないが、記事サマリーでは危険地域としてブラジル、フィリピンなどが言及されている。症例の曝露地は海外であり、ハワイでの局所感染リスクは低いとDOHが評価。単一症例であり重症度情報は不明。渡航関連症例は異常/予想外（abnormal_unexpected）として評価されたが、その他のスクリーニング基準はいずれも該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: US CDC activates $107 million in emergency funding for Ebola response
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-18, the US CDC activated $107 million in emergency funding for the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The outbreak has 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths, raising concerns it could become the worst Ebola outbreak since the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (over 11,000 deaths). Donor pledges total about $910 million, including $80 million from African Union members, but less than $90 million has been released. The United States is the largest donor; CDC teams in the DRC aid surveillance, isolation, safe burial, entry-port assessments, and diagnostics, and help prepare western provinces to contain spread. In Uganda, border health support and airport screening are underway. U.S. risk remains low, but preparedness is maintained; the CDC coordinates with the World Cup readiness team for 11 U.S. host cities.

triage.headline_ja: 米CDC、エボラ対応に1億700万ドルの緊急資金を発動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo型エボラの大規模流行（875確定例、202死亡）で、2014-2016年西アフリカ流行以来の規模となる可能性があり、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダでの同時流行）、渡航制限リスクを示している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダも含まれているが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのBundibugyo型エボラ流行が述べられており、DRCは対象国。米国が大規模な資金投入と技術支援を実施中で、国際的な関心と対応の規模が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Acre lidera incidência de leishmaniose no Brasil, aponta novo estudo da Ufac | ContilNet Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Acre has the highest incidence of leishmaniasis in Brazil, according to a new UFAC study | ContilNet Notícias
article.articleSummary: Acre, Brazil, has the highest incidence of cutaneous leishmaniasis in the country, recording 691 cases per 100,000 inhabitants in 2023 and accounting for more than half of national notifications in the North Region. A UFAC–Fiocruz–Fundhacre study conducted in Sena Madureira (an endemically affected area) surveyed 50 patients with suspected disease and 51 health agents between 2022–2023. Findings reveal major knowledge gaps: 96% of patients had insufficient understanding of leishmaniasis; only 6% correctly identified the sandfly vector and 8% mentioned prevention. About 40% linked skin lesions to the disease; 36% knew treatment is provided free by the SUS. Treatment centers on antiparasitics such as meglumine antimoniate (Glucantime). Some 36% of participants used home remedies (mastruz, copaíba, latexes). In 2025, five Acre municipalities—Xapuri, Marechal Thaumaturgo, Assis Brasil, Sena Madureira, Brasileia—were flagged as intense transmission risk, underscoring the need for enhanced health access, education, and ongoing professional training in the Amazon.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのアクレ州がリーシュマニア症の最高発生率を記録、UFACの新研究が指摘
triage.triage_reason: 流行性疾患（皮膚リーシュマニア症）の地域的な高い発生率が報告されているが、新規感染症の出現やアウトブレイクではなく、既知の風土病の発生状況調査であり、記事は学術研究の知見報告。国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生への深刻な影響の明確な証拠は限定的。
triage.notes: 記事はアクレ州での皮膚リーシュマニア症の風土病的高発生を学術研究に基づいて報告している。既知の流行性疾患であり、新規アウトブレイクではない。ただし高度に流行しやすい（ベクター媒介、知識不足、予防対策不十分）かつ長期曝露リスクがあるため、WPRO基準では2つ該当する。しかし社会的・政治的関心や国際的拡大の危険性が不明確であるため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: CDC usa US$107 milhões em verba emergencial para Ebola na RDC e Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CDC uses US$107 million in emergency funding for Ebola in the DRC and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda Ebola response funded with US$107 million by the CDC. Bundibugyo ebolavirus disease outbreak is the third-largest on record. Nearly 1,000 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases across 31 health zones in the DRC, plus 31 cases in Kampala, Uganda. Global risk remains low. The CDC deploys 23 field staff and 125 other personnel across DRC and Uganda; biweekly briefings with World Cup host cities are underway. The outbreak began about a month ago near the western DRC–eastern Uganda border. Transmission is via direct contact with blood, bodily fluids, and contaminated surfaces. Containment faces challenges: distrust, PPE shortages, and inadequate transport for bodies; international travel restrictions hinder response. Past outbreaks killed over 11,000 people (2014–2016). About US$910 million had already been pledged; donor funding remains insufficient. Emphasis on local containment and domestic preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: CDCがエボラ対策でコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダに1億700万米ドルの緊急資金を使用
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus disease（致命的な公衆衛生脅威）の発生、約1,000例の確認患者、国境を越えた急速な拡大、国際的な感染制限実施、重大な社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダ両国での発生を言及しているが、Bluedot APIで提供されたGeoNames IDリストにはウガンダ(226074)が含まれておらず、対象国リスト内にもウガンダは存在しないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。Bundibugyo ebolavirus diseaseは過去のエボラアウトブレイク（2014-2016年）で11,000人以上の死亡実績があり、重大なリスク。

article.articleHeadline: 22 students fall ill, ayurveda college hostel shut | Kochi News
article.articleSummary: 22 students at Govt Ayurveda Medical College hostel, Puthiyakavu, Tripunithura, Kochi, Ernakulam district, fell ill with diarrhoea, prompting closure of the hostel and mess and suspension of classes. Illnesses were first reported on June 12; by June 18, health officials confirmed a waterborne transmission, with traces of E. coli bacteria detected in water samples from the hostel's storage tanks. Investigators cited sources near a drainage channel and swampy land as suspected contamination. In response, chlorination began in about a dozen drinking-water tanks serving the hostel, mess, and college hospital. A medical team will retest water samples on June 22; if samples test free of E. coli, classes may resume; if contamination persists, the college will move to online classes as exams approach. Most affected students have relocated to relatives' or nearby lodgings as treatment continued.

triage.headline_ja: 22人の学生が病気に、アーユルヴェーダ大学の寮が閉鎖 | コーチンニュース
triage.triage_reason: 水系感染症イベント（E. coli）による複数患者の集団発生。異常な状況（寮の集団下痢）、複数死傷者ではなく軽症だが、水道水の汚染という環境的脅威があり、潜在的な国際的懸念（水質管理）を有する。
triage.notes: イベントはインド・ケーララ州コーチンのアーユルヴェーダ医学大学の寮で発生。水道水汚染によるE. coli感染が確認されており、環境要因（排水路と沼地）が汚染源と指摘されている。現在クロリン処理が進行中で、6月22日に再検査予定。患者数は22名で、ほぼ全員が軽症の下痢症状（死亡例なし）。公的関心は高く（当局が対応中）、プラス社会的関心も存在（Times of India報道）。WPROスクリーニング基準4つ該当により PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola escancara a injustiça global na saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak exposes the global injustice in health.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo exposes global health injustice, with disparities between European hospitals and East African facilities highlighted by the evacuation of American doctor Peter Stafford to Germany for experimental MBP-134 therapy after infection in the DRC, where Bundibugyo ebolavirus is circulating. Stafford, treated at Charité in Berlin after mid-May evacuation from the DRC, received MBP-134—a combination of two monoclonal antibodies derived from a West Africa survivor—despite the therapy still in clinical trials. On May 15, 2026, WHO and Africa CDC prioritized MBP-134 and remdesivir for use against Ebola in DRC. Access to monoclonal antibodies remains limited in Africa, while resources can be mobilized for a single patient in Europe. Cronen and Gertler argue the broader inequity extends beyond Ebola, requiring robust clinical care and infrastructure. The piece also notes potential US aid cuts under new rules that could hinder regional response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が世界保健の不公正を露呈
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱はカテゴリーAの重大感染症であり、DRCでの流行と欧州への患者輸送はフルRRAが必要な高優先度シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱流行の報告。ドイツ（ベルリンのCharité病院）への患者輸送は治療事例の説明であり、流行の主発生地はDRCのみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス属の異なる種）の流行、新規単核球形成抗体療法（MBP-134）の投与、医療格差の国際的課題を指摘。2026年5月15日のWHO/Africa CDCの公式推奨も記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Cases Are Increasing Faster Than Response Efforts, Health Experts Warn -- What Travelers Should Know
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to Uganda, with South Sudan at high risk. As of June 15, 72 new cases were reported in 24 hours, bringing confirmed cases to 782 and deaths to 181. The outbreak was officially confirmed May 15 and declared a WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, caused by the Bundibugyo virus. Over 90% of cases are in Ituri province; cross-border transmission complicates containment, and officials caution the true scale may be higher than official counts. Under-testing for Bundibugyo and community resistance, plus miners moving through the region, hinder contact tracing. WHO is supplying testing and treatment; CDC has ordered travel screening for anyone who has been in Uganda, DRC, or South Sudan in the past 21 days, rerouting them through designated US airports. No US cases; overall risk to travelers remains low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者数が対応努力より速く増加、保健専門家が警告 -- 旅行者が知るべきこと
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な二次感染（ウガンダへの越境感染）、WHO PHEICの宣言、複数国での対応困難性が確認され、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。国際的公衆衛生上の重大な脅威。
triage.notes: WHO PHEICの宣言（2026年5月17日）、24時間当たり72新規症例、越境感染（ウガンダ）、米国の旅行スクリーニング実施等、複数の重大指標が該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な株）による大規模流行。ウガンダはDRCと同様にアフリカ地域であるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。南スーダンも対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: Death toll from Ebola surpasses 200 in DR Congo as officials assess response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) surges to 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality ~23%) since declared May 15; Ituri accounts for ~95% of cases. Uganda reports 19 cases, including two deaths. Africa CDC notes expanded testing capacity and digital surveillance to close the detection gap. Congolese Health Minister Roger Kamba visited Bunia to assess progress and strategies. The strain is Ebola Bundibugyo from a new wildlife spillover, not linked to an old, undetected outbreak. If transmission remains uncontrolled, Africa CDC Director General Jean Kaseya warned the outbreak could be worse than the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic. Timeframe: as of June 18, 2026. Imported/exported cases: cross-border spread to Uganda reported. Public health measures and surveillance efforts highlighted.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が200人を超える、当局が対応を評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス感染症の大規模流行として国際的な懸念レベルが極めて高い。ウガンダへの越境感染確認、死亡率23%、2014-2016西アフリカ流行を上回る可能性の警告により、シグナルとして認定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは明確にDRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）での発生が主題。ウガンダへの越境感染19例（死亡2例）が報告されているが、発生地域の主体はDRCである。発生地域フィールドに含まれるAngola、South Africa等は記事サマリー上で言及されていないため、verified_locationsには含めない。2026年6月18日現在、Ebola Bundibugyoによる新規のスピルオーバーイベントとして評価。

article.articleHeadline: Il ritorno del virus Ebola: il viaggio tra i contagiati della RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The return of the Ebola virus: the journey among the infected in the DRC
article.articleSummary: On 18 June 2026, Ebola virus disease resurges in Mongwalu, a mining town in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the epicenter of the 17th outbreak. Official counts exceed 700 confirmed cases and 180 deaths, though authorities warn numbers are likely underestimates. Doctors Without Borders notes many patients delay hospital care due to fear and superstition. Initial cases were mistaken for malaria; the virus strain was later identified as Bundibugyo. Two funerals occurred at the same cemetery, with hundreds of graves, underscoring the outbreak’s gravity. Survivors exist, such as Florence, discharged after recovery along with a child, illustrating the importance of timely treatment. The report stresses early care to improve survival and curb transmission, amid widespread fear and ongoing transmission in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの回帰：コンゴ民主共和国の感染者の中での旅
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する重大なエボラ症例集団発生。確認例700例以上、死亡180例以上の深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、医療体制の限界が明確である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提供した「発生地域」はIturi州とDRC両方を含む。記事サマリーはDRC内イトゥリ州モングワル鉱山町での発生を明確に述べており、DRC（203312）のみを verified_locations に含める。エボラとマラリアの両疾患がタグ付けされているが、主要な懸念はエボラ。当初症例がマラリアと誤認されたこと、死亡率の高さ、医療へのアクセス困難、地域の恐怖と迷信が感染拡大を助長している点が特筆される。2026年の日付は将来のシミュレーションデータと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Εκτεταμένη εξάπλωση του ιού Oropouche στην Λατινική Αμερική " OnCamera.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Extensive spread of the Oropouche virus in Latin America.
article.articleSummary: Extensive spread of the Oropouche virus in Latin America. Since 2023, Brazil reports over 30,000 cases with the first death; the outbreak is expanding across all Brazilian states, surpassing the Amazon region. WHO warns about rapid spread and urges rapid prevention and control tools. Studies in Nature Medicine and Nature Health estimate that, since 1960, roughly 9.4 million people have been infected in Latin America and the Caribbean, including 5.5 million in Brazil. Symptoms resemble dengue: fever, but can cause neurological complications, meningitis, and congenital microcephaly. About 1,000 patients may develop severe outcomes. In 2023–2024, ~300,000 Manaus residents were infected, about 260 times more than confirmed. Antibody prevalence rose from 11.4% in Nov 2023 to 25.7% in Nov 2024, signaling ongoing transmission. Remote Amazonas areas face ~24 hours travel to care, hindering diagnosis; two major Manaus surges occurred in the 1980s and in 2023, each >12% of the population.

triage.headline_ja: ラテンアメリカにおけるオロポーシェウイルスの広範な拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全該当。ブラジルでの30,000例超、死亡例、神経学的合併症、先天性小頭症の報告、全州への拡大、WHOの警告があり、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: ブラジルがラテンアメリカにおける主要な発生地であり、Amazonas州およびPará州での集中的な流行が報告されている。Manausでの大規模な流行（2023年に人口の12%以上が感染推定）、抗体陽性率の急速な上昇（11.4%→25.7%）、神経学的合併症と先天性小頭症の発生、医療アクセスの困難性が管理可能性を低下させている。WHOの公式警告と国際的な懸念の表明があり、緊急対応の優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: CDC to tap $107m in emergency funding for Ebola response in the DRC and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo viral disease (BVD), a rare Ebola-related hemorrhagic fever, is driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of 15 June, 837 confirmed BVD cases in the DRC and 19 in Uganda were reported, with 198 deaths across both countries. The outbreak now totals about 1,000 confirmed cases across 31 health zones in the DRC and 31 cases in Kampala, Uganda, making it the third-largest Ebola-related outbreak on record and potentially taking about a year to contain at current rates. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, bodily secretions, and contaminated surfaces; BVD is not airborne. The worst Ebola outbreak (2014–2016) infected over 28,000 and killed 11,000 in West Africa and the eastern DRC. Global risk is low, though local risk remains high. The CDC is allocating $107 million in emergency funding, with roughly $910 million pledged overall and less than 10% received; 23 field staff and 125 total CDC personnel are deployed in DRC/Uganda for outbreak control and domestic readiness.

triage.headline_ja: CDCがコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ対応のため1億700万ドルの緊急資金を確保
triage.triage_reason: エボラ関連の出血熱（ブンディブギョウウイルス病）が複数国で発生し、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。深刻な公衆衛生影響（837確定例、198死亡）、異常・予想外の事象、複数国への国際的拡大、大規模な国際的資金投入が必要とされている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（226074）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは31例のみで主要な発生地域はDRCであり、記事の主題はDRCの大規模流行である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。この判定はサマリーの明確な記述に基づく。第3位規模のエボラ関連流行、計画的な国際対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak hits 894 cases in one month
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak across Uganda and the DRC has reached 894 confirmed cases and 204 deaths, with 74 recoveries in the first month since the May 15, 2026 declaration. Uganda reports 19 cases, two deaths (case fatality 10.5%), seven recoveries, and 100% contact tracing confined to one Kampala health zone. The DRC, led by Ituri as epicenter with 91 cases and 78% of deaths, faces North Kivu insecurity that limits access; 32 health zones are affected across both countries, up from 3 in week 1 to 32 by week 4 (38% weekly rise). Contact tracing remains weak: about 6,000 listed of an expected 17,000–35,000 daily contacts, with ~4,000 actively followed. No licensed vaccines or therapeutics for the Sudan strain; safe burial capacity is severely lacking (7 of 49 teams, 7 of 98 vehicles). Africa CDC declared a public health emergency May 18 and launched an 11-pillar response with $517 million, plus 24-hour testing (21,000 tests delivered).

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、1ヶ月で894症例に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急速拡大、複数国への国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべても該当。緊急性の高いシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ出血熱（Sudan株）がウガンダとDRCで発生しており、1ヶ月間で894確定症例、204死亡が報告されている。Ituri州（DRC）が震源地。接触者追跡の不十分さ（期待値17,000-35,000人のうち約6,000人のみリスト化）、安全埋葬能力の極度の不足、スーダン株の治療薬・ワクチン未承認など、対応能力の制約が明らかである。Africa CDCが5月18日に公衆衛生緊急事態を宣言し、5億1,700万ドルの対応予算を計上。ウガンダは接触者追跡が100%で限定的（1つのカンパラ保健地域）であるが、DRCは32の保健地域に拡大し、週4までに38%の週次上昇率を示している。Bluedot発生地域にはUgandaも含まれているが、verified_locationsはサマリー上で実際のエボラ患者発生が記述されている対象国のみを列挙した。

article.articleHeadline: الأمم المتحدة تعيّن منسقًا رئيسًا لمكافحة تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United Nations appoints a Chief Coordinator to combat an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: UN OCHA, in consultation with WHO, appointed Julian Harnis as Chief Coordinator for the Ebola outbreak response, based in Bunia, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. He will work with the Inter-Agency Standing Committee and UN agencies to boost field response coordination, address operational challenges, and ensure rapid delivery of aid and health services to the most affected populations. Recently, UN and partners delivered 16.5 tons of medical supplies to affected areas and established new health screening facilities to support outbreak containment. OCHA allocated $4 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund to Uganda to support Ebola response, as part of a package potentially totaling up to $60 million announced by end-May to bolster outbreak response. The UN continues supporting national authorities and health and humanitarian partners to curb transmission and strengthen response capacity in affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: 国連がエボラ出血熱流行対策の最高調整官を任命
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR Annex2基準を複数満たす（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）。複数国での発生が確認され、国連による大規模な対応・資金配分が行われており、シグナル性が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRC（Bunia）が主たる発生地であり、Ugandaへの資金配分は対応支援の一環として言及されている。対象国リストではDRCのみ確認されているため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。エボラ出血熱の深刻性、複数国への拡大リスク、国連による大規模な対応体制構築が確認され、すべてのWPRO基準を満たす高リスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de ebola escancara a injustiça global na saúde
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak exposes global health injustice.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (2026) highlighted global health inequities. A U.S. doctor, Peter Stafford, contracted Ebola during a humanitarian mission in the DRC and, after evacuation, was hospitalized at Charité University Hospital in Berlin for treatment with MBP-134, an experimental monoclonal antibody therapy not yet approved for human use. Ahead of Stafford’s evacuation in mid-May 2026, a WHO/Africa CDC emergency meeting on May 15 prioritized MBP-134 and remdesivir for Ebola patients in the DRC. MBP-134 combines two synthetic antibodies derived from a survivor of the 2013 West Africa outbreak; preclinical work showed protection in ferrets and cynomolgus macaques against ebolaviruses including Bundibugyo, and limited human use has occurred. Critics note stark disparities in access to antibody therapies and essential care between Europe and East Africa, even among neighboring countries; calls emphasize care infrastructure and nonpharmacological measures alongside drugs, and question waning US foreign aid.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が世界的な医療格差を露呈させる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（異常性・国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行で死亡者を伴う重症事例が報告され、米国への国際的な患者移送が発生している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはドイツ（Berlin）や米国も含まれているが、サマリーによれば流行の中心はコンゴ民主共和国であり、ベルリンは治療施設（Charité University Hospital）の所在地、米国は患者受け入れ国として記載されている。したがって verified_locations は DRC のみとした。エボラウイルス病は高い死亡率と国際的な懸念を伴う重大感染症であり、フルRRA実施が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് പൾസ് പോളിയോ ഇമ്മ്യൂണൈസേഷൻ ജൂൺ 28ന്; അഞ്ച് വയസുവരെയുള്ള 19.8 ലക്ഷം കുഞ്ഞുങ്ങൾക്ക് പോളിയോ തുള്ളിമരുന്നു നൽകും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pulse Polio Immunisation in the State on June 28; 1.98 million children up to five years old will be given polio drops.
article.articleSummary: Pulse Polio immunisation will be conducted in Kerala on June 28, targeting 1,980,224 children under five for polio drops. The state will deploy 22,288 booths and 46,663 trained volunteers at health centers, Anganwadis, private hospitals, libraries, schools, and NGO premises. Additionally, 539 transit booths, 283 mobile booths, and 9 festival/fair booths will operate, with transit booths at railway stations, bus stands, and boat jetties; mobile booths will visit migrant workers’ settlements, border areas, and festival venues. If any child misses the booth, home vaccination will occur on June 29-30. India has been polio-free for 15 years as of January 13, 2026, though neighboring countries still report cases. Campaign is led by Health, Rural Development, Women and Child Development, Education, Kudumbashree Mission, Literacy Mission, and Rotary International.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州でパルスポリオ予防接種を6月28日に実施；5歳以下の198万人の子どもにポリオドロップを投与
triage.triage_reason: ポリオ定期予防接種キャンペーンの実施報道。インドは15年間ポリオ無発症国であり、本件は病原体検出や症例報告ではなく、計画的な公衆衛生予防活動である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本件は予防接種キャンペーンの実施告知であり、ポリオ感染症事例ではない。インドは2011年以降ポリオ根絶状態を維持している。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Οι νεκροί από από τον Έμπολα στο Κονγκό ξεπέρασαν τους 200
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in Congo surpassed 200.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 200 deaths, with Africa CDC confirming 875 laboratory-confirmed infections and 202 fatalities since May 15, yielding a 23% case fatality rate. The northeast Ituri province is the epicenter, where poor road access and armed group activity hinder containment and contact tracing. About a month after emergency was declared, Congo reports over 200 deaths; neighboring Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, with officials saying the outbreak there is under control. The virus strain is Bundibugyo, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs via bodily fluids and close contact. Africa CDC’s outbreak lead expressed concern that contact tracing in DRC remains inadequate due to security and access challenges, underscoring ongoing cross-border risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱による死者が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの多国間発生（DRC及びウガンダ）、23%の高い致命率、国境を越えたリスク、ワクチンなし、接触者追跡困難等により公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの発生を主題としており、ウガンダの言及は二次的である。DRCはWHO西太平洋地域外（東部アフリカ）だが、エボラウイルス感染症の多国間発生、高い致命率（23%）、貧弱な接触者追跡、武装勢力による安全保障上の課題、ワクチン非利用、国境を越えたリスクが全IHR基準とすべてのWPRO基準に該当する極めて重大なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Ebola aumentam quase 40% em uma semana e surto é o pior já registrado, aponta CDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases rise nearly 40% in one week, and the outbreak is the worst on record, according to the CDC.
article.articleSummary: As of June 18, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in Congo's Ituri province, with cases in North and South Kivu and spread to Uganda, has killed over 200 in its first month and is the worst on record, with up to 35,000 contacts identified. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccines or treatments exist; Zaire ebolavirus—the more common type—has vaccines and has driven most of Congo’s 16 prior outbreaks. Transmission in Ituri (over 90% of cases); Uganda has 19 confirmed cases and two deaths. Contact tracing is hampered by insecurity and displacement (one million displaced in Ituri), dense forests, poor roads, and villages. For 800 confirmed cases, 17,000–35,000 contacts should be on file, but only about 4,000 are being traced. Of more than $900 million pledged, about $90 million has been released; Africa CDC says 540 responders are needed but only 84 are available.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者が1週間で約40%増加、記録史上最悪の流行とCDCが指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。記録史上最悪のエボラ流行で深刻な公衆衛生への影響、高い国際拡大リスク、国際支援の緊急性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州でのエボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダへの国際的拡大も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。CDCが「記録史上最悪」と評価し、ワクチン・治療法なしのBundibugyo ebolavirus、接触者追跡の深刻な不足（4,000/17,000-35,000）、資金不足、治安悪化による対応困難が特徴。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Οι νεκροί από την επιδημία του Έμπολα ξεπέρασαν τους 200
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Deaths from the Ebola outbreak surpassed 200.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, northeastern DRC) has surpassed 200 deaths, with 875 laboratory-confirmed infections and 202 deaths (case fatality ~23%) as of May 15. The outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, has no vaccine or specific cure. The epicenter is Ituri; access is limited by poor roads and armed-group activity, hindering contact tracing. Africa CDC Africa’s emergency lead expressed concern over surveillance due to security and safety constraints, while Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths, and the outbreak there is described as under control. The Ebola virus transmits via bodily fluids and close contact; the broader African toll from Ebola in the last 50 years exceeds 15,000 deaths. The emergency status was declared about a month ago, with ongoing monitoring by health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルス流行による死者が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な流行、複数国への国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性）。WPRO基準でも複数項目該当し、政府・国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて致命率の高い感染症（23%）であり、アフリカCDCの懸念表明、ウガンダへの波及（19確認例、2死亡）、セキュリティ制約による接触追跡困難など、複数のリスク要因が認められる。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。緊急宣言は約1ヶ月前に発令されており、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola mató a más de 200 personas en el este congoleño - Salud - Ansa.it
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola killed more than 200 people in eastern Congo - Health - Ansa.it.
article.articleSummary: More than a month after the outbreak was declared on May 15, Ebola has caused 202 deaths among 875 laboratory-confirmed infections in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with an overall case-fatality rate of 23%, Africa CDC reports citing Congolese health authorities. The Bundibugyo virus is responsible for this outbreak, the seventeenth Ebola event in the DRC, with the epicenter in Ituri province, an area difficult to access due to poor roads and armed-group-driven insecurity. Neighboring Uganda has recorded 19 cases, including two deaths. Africa CDC Emergency Response Chief Wessam Mankoula warned of a low contact-tracing rate in the DRC, linked to security and accessibility issues. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部でエボラが200人以上を殺害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の確認事例による大規模流行であり、複数国への拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで報告されている発生国はDRCのみ。ウガンダについては隣国での症例記載であり、主な発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州。確認症例875件、死亡202件、23%の致死率。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる第17番目の流行。ワクチンや特定治療薬が存在しないため、管理可能性に懸念あり。セキュリティ問題や地理的アクセスの困難さが対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Главные новости дня | четверг: Иран, Эбола, Судан, Эль-Ниньо
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Top News of the Day | Thursday: Iran, Ebola, Sudan, El Niño
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the United Nations appointing Julien Harnais—formerly head of humanitarian operations in Yemen—as the new senior Ebola coordinator. Based in Bunia, Harnais will oversee coordination among UN agencies and partner NGOs to respond to the outbreak in eastern DRC. The announcement followed consultations with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The article does not provide current case or death figures. This leadership shift aims to bolster operational response and ensure alignment across agencies to protect affected communities and health workers. No details on laboratory confirmation, transmission chains, or imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: トップニュース | 木曜日：イラン、エボラ、スーダン、エルニーニョ
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイク継続が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）が複数該当する。UN事務局による新たなコーディネーター任命という組織的対応の強化が示唆されており、シグナルピックアップの基準を満たす。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはYemen(69543)を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーではYemenはコーディネーター人事の背景情報としてのみ言及されており、実際のエボラ発生地はDRC東部（Bunia）である。verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定した。事例数や死亡数の具体的データが記事に含まれていないため、重症度評価は不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: La Cellule nationale d'urgence tient sa troisième réunion de suivi de l'évolution de l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The National Emergency Cell Holds Its Third Meeting to Monitor the Evolution of the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 18 June 2026, Mauritania's National Emergency Cell held its third meeting to monitor the Ebola outbreak evolving in several African countries, as part of national preparedness. The meeting reviewed international efforts, including WHO–Africa CDC exchanges and a high-level African Ebola summit to boost early warning, surveillance, risk communication, and rapid response capacities. Mauritania has intensified outreach to citizens abroad, public education campaigns, and continuous situational monitoring. Health authorities outlined preventive measures: circulars to sharpen vigilance in health facilities and communities, staff training on suspected-case protocols, and distribution of information brochures; PPE and essential equipment were supplied to regions, with reinforced border and airport surveillance. Ebola activity remains primarily in the Democratic Republic of Congo, while Uganda reports no new cases for eleven days. Mauritania remains at low risk but maintains vigilant cross-sector coordination, including transport links via ASKY.

triage.headline_ja: 国家緊急対応委員会、エボラ流行の進化を監視するための第3回会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の多国間での流行報告であり、IHR基準を複数満たす潜在的シグナルであるが、モーリタニアは低リスク状態で直接的な患者報告や国際的拡大の切迫性が明確でないため、継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、エボラ活動は主にコンゴ民主共和国に集中しており、ウガンダでは11日間新規患者報告なし、モーリタニアは低リスク状態。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ただしエボラ流行の多国間での警戒態勢と国際的な対応調整が進行中のため、IHR基準3つ該当でありWPRO基準5つ全て該当するが、現在の実際の流行規模や国際的拡大の切迫性については情報が限定的。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊拉波疫情釀逾200死　恐需一年才能控制下來│TVBS新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Irabo outbreak has killed more than 200 people and may take up to a year to bring under control.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 200 people, with Africa CDC reporting 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality rate about 23%) as of 2026-06-19. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain driving the outbreak has no approved vaccine or treatment. Security challenges and restricted access hinder epidemiological investigations, and contact tracing remains limited. The northeast provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, areas with long-running conflict and mass displacement, are most affected. The Red Cross warns the outbreak is not yet at its peak and could take up to a year to bring under control. The outbreak has spilled over into neighboring Uganda, which has 19 cases and 2 deaths, mostly among travelers from the DRC. Cross-border surveillance and coordinated response are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国のエボラ感染症が200人以上の死亡者を出し、抑制に1年要する可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響（200人以上の死亡）、国際的な拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、異常性（Bundibugyo株による大規模流行）が確認され、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度が高く、複数国への感染が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの波及が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCは対象国(203312)に含まれ、南キブ州およびイトゥリ州での確認が記述されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株はワクチンが未承認であり、セキュリティ上の制約が対応を困難にしている点は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala's health machinery goes all out to keep Nipah in check
article.articleSummary: Nipah outbreak in Kozhikode, Kerala: a 43-year-old resident is on ventilator at Government Medical College Hospital since June 10; close contacts are under home quarantine and all tests have so far been negative. In Ramanattukara, a preliminary survey of ~300 houses is complete; fever surveillance and One Health coordination with Animal Husbandry and Forest are in progress, with an ICMR visit. Nipah virus, with mortality up to 75%, transmits from fruit bats (Pteropus) and can spread between people. Kerala has recorded 10 Nipah episodes up to 2025, totaling 38 cases and 28 deaths; districts include Malappuram, Palakkad, Ernakulam, and others, with Kozhikode as a recurring hotspot since 2018. Patterns show activity Apr–Sep, aligning with bat fruiting/roosting; Perinthalmanna and Kozhikode city are notable hubs. NIV Pune found Nipah antibodies in fruit bats across nine states, including Kerala; spillover via fruits remains possible but unconfirmed. The virus is on WHO's R&D Blueprint list.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルスを抑制するためにケーラ州の保健機構が総力を挙げる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡率75%、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も全て該当。既知の高リスク病原体で、ケーラ州は反復的な流行地域。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはWHO R&D Blueprint対象で死亡率75%の高リスク病原体。ケーラ州での2026年新規流行。2018年以降の反復的発生パターン。動物-人間の連鎖感染リスク。ICMR介入および複数部局間連携が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Deaths from DRC Ebola outbreak top 200: officials
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has topped 200 deaths as of June 18, 2026. Confirmed cases reach 875 since the outbreak was declared on May 15, with 202 deaths (mortality rate 23%). The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with Ituri accounting for nearly 95 percent of infections. The virus has crossed the border into Uganda, where 19 cases and two deaths have been recorded. Africa CDC reports strengthened testing capacity and digital surveillance systems to improve case detection and curb transmission as authorities race to contain the fast-growing outbreak across multiple provinces.

triage.headline_ja: DRC(コンゴ民主共和国)のエボラアウトブレイク、死者数が200人を超える：当局発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認患者875人、死者202人（致死率23%）という深刻な公衆衛生への影響を示す。国境を越えてウガンダへの国際的拡大が既に確認され、IHR基準3つ以上に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当するため、フルRRA進行対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの国際的拡大（19例、2死亡）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは対象国であり、記事の主題の発生地である。2026年6月18日現在、Ituri州が感染の95%を占め、急速に増殖するアウトブレイク状況。Africa CDCの検査能力強化と監視システムの導入が報告されており、対応体制が構築されつつある。

article.articleHeadline: Ιός Έμπολα: Ξεπέρασαν τους 200 οι νεκροί στη ΛΔ του Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: Death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 200.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 200 deaths, with 875 laboratory-confirmed infections and 202 fatalities since 15 May, reported by Africa CDC and the African Union health service on 18 June 2026. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and centers in Ituri province, northeastern DRC, where access is hindered by poor road networks and armed-group activity. The case fatality rate is about 23%, and there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this strain. In neighboring Uganda, 19 confirmed cases and two deaths have been recorded. Roughly one month after emergency measures were declared in the northeast, authorities continue surveillance and containment efforts in the hard-to-reach Ituri region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：コンゴ民主共和国の死者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認感染875例、死亡202例という深刻な公衆衛生影響、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（希少株）による予想外の流行、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、および国際対応の必要性が認められる。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）での確認事例（19例、死亡2例）も報告されているが、主要な流行地はDRC Ituri州であり、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株はZaire株より希少で、ワクチン・特異的治療なしという重大な課題。武装勢力活動による介入困難性が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα / Ξεπέρασαν τους 200 οι νεκροί στο Κονγκό - Ανησυχία για την εξάπλωση της επιδημίας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola / Death toll in Congo surpasses 200 - Concern over the spread of the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: As of June 18, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province, northeast) have surpassed 200 deaths, with 875 laboratory-confirmed cases reported since May 15 and 202 deaths, a case fatality rate of 23%. Uganda has recorded 19 infections and 2 deaths, with the outbreak there described as more controlled. The resurgence is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. Access is hampered by damaged roads and armed-group activity, limiting case finding and contact tracing, according to Africa CDC leadership. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids of infected individuals or through close human contact. Since its emergence about five decades ago, Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths in Africa across multiple countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ / コンゴでの死者が200人を超える - 流行拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスは致死率23%の深刻な感染症であり、DRCで200人以上の死者、ウガンダへの国際的な拡大があり、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダも感染例・死亡例があるが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要な流行地であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株であり、ワクチン・治療法が利用できない状況で、アクセス困難によるコンタクトトレーシング不足が管理可能性を低下させている。フルRRA進行を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Minsal alerta alza de virus respiratorios: influenza alcanza su peak y preocupa la tipo B
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health warns of a rise in respiratory viruses: influenza reaches its peak and influenza B is a concern.
article.articleSummary: Chile’s Ministry of Health reports in epidemiological week 23 (June 7–13) a 52% positivity rate among ISP-tested samples, up from the prior week. Influenza A remains the dominant virus at 29.9% positivity, representing the largest number of positive cases this season and mainly affecting children aged 5–14. Influenza B reaches 19.2%, with unusual mid-winter activity for this virus, a pattern also seen in Argentina and Brazil. Rhinovirus is 23.4%, and RSV accounts for 7.9% of positives. The vaccine protects against both influenza A and B; national coverage stands at 74.5% with over 7.7 million doses administered. Tarapacá leads regional coverage at 81.8%; Coquimbo and Magallanes are below the national average. Vaccination remains the best protection as the influenza season continues, with RSV monoclonal antibody doses exceeding 102,000 (96.5% protection); over 533,000 COVID-19 vaccine doses have been administered.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が呼吸器ウイルスの増加を警告：インフルエンザがピークに達しインフルエンザBが懸念
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザA・B、RSV、COVID-19）の同時流行を報告しており、インフルエンザBの異常な冬季活動とアルゼンチンおよびブラジルでの類似パターンが注目される。ただし、現時点では死亡や重症化の明確な報告がなく、ワクチン接種率も74.5%と高く、管理可能性が一定程度あるため、続報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、チリの状況が主題であり、アルゼンチンとブラジルは比較参考として言及されている。対象国リストではブラジル（GeoNames ID 3469034）のみが対象国に該当するため verified_locations に含めた。チリはラテンアメリカの対象国リストに含まれていない。IHR基準で2つ以上該当（unusual_unexpected、international_spread）しており、WPRO基準でも3つ以上該当しているが、重症度に関する明確な情報がなく、公開情報に基づくと管理可能性が認識されているため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Vaccines and treatments being developed for Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has surpassed 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths in just over a month, with true numbers likely higher in remote, conflict-affected areas. No vaccines or treatments are approved for this Bundibugyo strain. The WHO and AU health agency are pursuing rapid development: the leading vaccine candidate uses an rVSV platform adapted for Bundibugyo, with human trials in 7–9 months; a faster option is a ChAdOx1-based vaccine from Oxford and Serum Institute, with phase 1 in 2–3 months per CEPI; Moderna is also developing an mRNA vaccine, with phase 1 in 2–3 months. Remdesivir has shown promising laboratory results but has not yet been tested in Bundibugyo-infected humans. The WHO has prioritized three therapeutic approaches for trials: MBP134 (monoclonal antibody by Mapp Biopharmaceutical), maftivimab (Regeneron), and the antiviral remdesivir. Trials will proceed in affected countries; timelines may shorten, but no approach is yet proven. The Zaire outbreak previously lasted about two years even with vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症の流行に対するワクチンと治療法が開発中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、異常性）。1ヶ月で875例確認、202名死亡のBundibugyo型エボラ流行であり、承認済み治療法がない状況での重篤な感染症アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo型エボラの流行がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダで発生していることを明記しているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。1ヶ月で875確認例・202死亡、遠隔地での実際の症例数はさらに多い可能性がある。承認済み治療法がない状況での重症度の高いアウトブレイク。複数のワクチン・治療開発が並行進行中だが、人間での有効性は未証明。

article.articleHeadline: "Ya estoy herido. Tan solo pensar en el ébola me parece intolerable". En los Kivu se enfrenta una doble crisis: conflictos armados y una epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "I'm already injured. Just thinking about Ebola seems intolerable to me." In the Kivus, a double crisis looms: armed conflicts and an epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Between May 15 and June 15, 2026, five hospitals in North Kivu and South Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, supported by the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC), logged 303 casualties, up 30% from April 15–May 14. The Ebola outbreak — the seventeenth in DRC to date — exacerbates vulnerability amid ongoing armed conflict, violence, displacement, and limited essential services. In Hauts Plateaux, Bukavu, Uvira, and Fizi, 170 casualties were admitted (56% of the CICR-supported total). Personal accounts underscore the crisis: Nzigire, wounded in fighting, and Pascal at Beni’s General Referral Hospital describe fear, confusion, and distress compounded by Ebola. Explosive weapons in populated areas account for over 16% of CICR hospital patients. François Moreillon, head of the ICRC delegation in DRC, calls for responsible parties to ensure safe access and rapid, unimpeded humanitarian action to deliver care to the injured and ill.

triage.headline_ja: 「もう既に傷を負っている。エボラウイルスのことを考えるだけで耐え難い。」キブ地域では二重の危機に直面：武力紛争と疫病流行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全てが該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスは最高危険度病原体であり、DRCにおける17番目の集団発生、死亡者増加、武力紛争との複合危機が認められる。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはFiji（2205218）も含まれているが、記事サマリー本文ではエボラの実際の発生地はDRC（North Kivu、South Kivu）のみであり、Fijiは対象国外であるため除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれており、verified_locationsに含める。エボラウイルス疾患は根拠性、深刻度、感染性の全てで最高リスク。武力紛争による混乱と医療施設への被害が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Πάνω από 200 νεκροί από τον Έμπολα σε ένα μήνα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: More than 200 dead from Ebola in a month.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 200 deaths about a month after an emergency was declared in the northeast. Laboratory-confirmed data show 875 infections since May 15 and 202 deaths, a case-fatality rate of about 23%. In Uganda, 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths have been reported. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or targeted therapy. The main transmission occurs in Ituri province, in the northeast, where response efforts are hampered by weak infrastructure and armed groups. Africa CDC's emergency management head warned that contact tracing effectiveness is limited due to security and access challenges, posing obstacles to interventions. By contrast, Uganda's situation is described as manageable and the spread currently contained. Ebola is transmitted through bodily fluids and close contact, and has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：1か月でエボラで200人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な影響、予想外の大規模発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確認された大規模集団発生であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの19確認例2死亡も報告されているが、記事の主要な焦点はDRCのIturi州での発生である。Bundibugyo株に対して承認されたワクチンが存在せず、セキュリティ上の課題が対応を制限している。死亡者数が急速に増加（約200人/1か月）し、感染確認例875例、致命率約23%で極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: ΛΔ Κονγκό: Ο αριθμός των νεκρών από τον Έμπολα ξεπέρασε τους 200 - Τι ανησυχίες εκφράζουν οι αρχές
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: The Ebola death toll has surpassed 200 as authorities express concerns.
article.articleSummary: Ituri Province in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the epicenter of a Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak that has killed more than 200 people. Africa CDC, part of the African Union's health service, reports 875 laboratory-confirmed cases and 202 fatalities since May 15, yielding a case fatality rate around 23%. In neighboring Uganda, 19 confirmed infections and two deaths have been recorded. The outbreak was declared a regional emergency about a month ago. Ebola virus disease spreads through bodily fluids and close contact, and there is no licensed vaccine or targeted therapy for Bundibugyo yet.
