Officials warn that contact tracing in the DRC is hindered by insecurity and limited access due to damaged roads and armed groups; Uganda’s situation is described as under control. The article underscores the ongoing risk and need for intensified public health measures to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルスの死亡者数が200人を超える - 当局が懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株エボラの大規模アウトブレイク（202死亡、875確認症例、CFR 23%）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の多数死亡、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、国際支援必要性が明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの重大なアウトブレイク。DRCでのコンタクトトレーシング困難（不安定情勢・アクセス制限）、ウガンダへの越境例報告あり。ワクチン・治療法なし。地域的緊急事態宣言済。フルRRA必須。

article.articleHeadline: Παγκόσμιος συναγερμός: Ξεπέρασαν τους 200 οι νεκροί από τον Έμπολα στο Κονγκό | ΕΙΔΗΣΕΙΣ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global alert: Ebola death toll in Congo surpasses 200 | News
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak in the northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 200 deaths, about a month after the region was placed under emergency measures. Africa CDC reports 875 laboratory-confirmed cases and 202 fatalities as of May 15, yielding a case-fatality rate around 23%. The virus has crossed into Uganda, with 19 confirmed cases and two deaths. The responsible strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus; unlike other Ebola variants, there is no approved vaccine and no targeted therapy. Ongoing surveillance and cross-border coordination are required to contain spread and protect neighboring populations. Authorities emphasize rapid diagnostics and border-health measures in both countries.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的警報: コンゴのエボラ死者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目全てに該当。エボラ出血熱の多国間拡大、高い致死率、ワクチン未開発株による大規模アウトブレイクである。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの国境越えによる拡大が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。Bundibugyo ebolavirus はワクチン未開発で、致死率約23%、死者202名、確認症例875名という深刻な状況。複数国間の調整と国境保健措置の強化が急務である。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Πάνω από 200 πλέον οι νεκροί από τον Έμπολα - 20% θνησιμότητα μεταξύ των κρουσμάτων
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Over 200 dead from Ebola now - 20% case fatality rate among cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, northeastern DRC) has killed over 200 people, with 875 laboratory-confirmed infections and 202 deaths since May 15, yielding a case fatality rate of about 23%. Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and two deaths. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. Ituri remains the epicenter, with access hampered by poor road networks and armed-group activity, complicating case investigation and contact tracing. A CDC Africa emergency official warned that contact tracing in DRC remains insufficient due to security and access constraints; Uganda’s outbreak is described as under control. Ebola transmits through bodily fluids and close contact; the disease has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラで200人以上が死亡 - 患者間の致死率20%
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は国際的懸念感染症であり、複数国への拡大と高い致死率により緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行。DRC Ituri州での875確定例・202死亡、ウガンダでの19確定例・2死亡が報告されている。セキュリティと地理的アクセスの制約により接触者追跡が不十分であること、ワクチンと特異的治療法が存在しないこと、致死率が約23%と高いことが懸念材料。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo: African Union mobilizes $910m
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompts the African Union to mobilize $910 million in funding pledges, with $80 million committed by African member states. Immediate needs under the Joint Continental Preparedness and Response Plan are pegged at $518 million for the next four weeks. The summit chaired by AU rotating chair Burundian President Évariste Ndayishimiye urged swift disbursement to support frontline response. Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya called for every pledge to become funding, supplies, personnel and on-ground support, while WHO reaffirmed support for surveillance, contact tracing, laboratory capacity and case management. A 90-95% contact tracing target is set for the 21-day incubation period; Africa CDC warned funds could rise to $1.5 billion if transmission is not controlled. Weekly monitoring will track pledges, disbursements, and field operations, with a broad call to governments, partners, and private sector to deliver for DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ：アフリカ連合が9億1000万ドルを動員
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的流行（DRC・ウガンダ）であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当。重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク、アフリカ連合による大規模資金動員など国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、主要な発生国はDRCとウガンダ。Bluedot APIが付与したBurundiはサマリー上では会議開催国として言及されているが、実際の発生地ではないため除外。UgandaはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため、検証済みロケーションはDRCのみとなる。ただし、ウガンダも深刻な発生地として記載されているため、国際的な感染症流行イベントとして極めて重大。

article.articleHeadline: 民主刚果伊拉波疫情　已酿逾200死
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 200 people.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-18, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 875 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 202 deaths (case fatality rate 23%), more than a month after the outbreak was declared. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no approved vaccine or specific therapy. Red Cross warns the outbreak has not peaked and containment could take up to a year. The northeast provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu are affected, with ongoing conflict and large displacements complicating response. Africa CDC physician Wessam Mankoula says security and access challenges hinder case finding and contact tracing remains low. The outbreak has spread to neighboring Uganda, which has 19 cases and 2 deaths, mostly among travelers from DRC. No infection source is detailed in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 民主刚果のエボラ出血熱流行、既に200人以上の死亡者が発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、既に複数国に拡大、Bundibugyo株はワクチン未承認である。WPRO基準でも異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理困難性が明確。国際的支援と関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC での大規模エボラ流行（875確認症例、202死亡、致命率23%）が主題。ウガンダへの拡大も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus 株はワクチン未承認で高リスク。紛争地域での対応困難が明記されており、管理可能性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: Evalúan situación en provincia epicentro de epidemia de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Assessing the situation in the province that is the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC
article.articleSummary: Bunia, Ituri Province, is the epicenter of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, as Kinshasa health officials arrive to assess progress and reinforce coordination. Since May 15, Ituri accounts for more than 90% of cases, with over 840 confirmed infections and about 200 deaths; around 50 patients have recovered. About 400 people are in isolation or hospitalized. The Health Ministry says the second visit aims to adjust strategies to meet on-the-ground challenges and strengthen coordination among actors. A MONUSCO subcontractor who worked in Bunia died after testing positive for Ebola, with authorities maintaining preventive measures. Separately, two patients who recently tested positive disappeared from Wanamahika Adventist Hospital in Mutiri, Butembo, after an armed attack on the facility. Attacks on health centers continued, including a May fire at a Katwa Ebola Treatment Center and other assaults in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のエボラ流行の震源地である州の状況を評価
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国内流行（840件以上の確定症例、約200人の死亡）、複数の州への拡大、医療施設への攻撃による対応の複雑化など、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。またWPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際保健上の最優先事項。DRC内での地理的拡大（イトゥリ州とキンシャサ、ブテンボなど複数地域）、医療体制の脅威（武装攻撃による医療施設被害、患者の逃亡）、国際支援の必要性が明確。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への即時エスカレーションが必須。

article.articleHeadline: Nariz entupido no frio? Saiba como diferenciar se é rinite, sinusite, gripe, resfriado ou covid-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Stuffy nose in the cold? Learn how to tell whether it's rhinitis, sinusitis, flu, the common cold, or COVID-19.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian winter brings nasal congestion, with rhinitis affecting about 30% of the population (~84 million). Fiocruz InfoGripe reports 82,544 Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases in 2026, with 3,591 deaths, and about half of SRAG cases testing positive for a respiratory virus. Distinguishing rhinitis, sinusitis, the common cold, influenza, and COVID-19 relies on patterns: rhinitis—nasal itching, sneezing, clear rhinorrhea; sinusitis—heavy congestion, facial pressure, reduced smell; common cold—mild congestion with clear, then thicker discharge; influenza—abrupt high fever with myalgias and prostration; COVID-19—congestion may occur, but sudden loss of smell is a key signal even without obstruction. Cold wind does not cause flu; viruses do, while dry winter air can dry nasal mucosa and indoor transmission rises. Warning signs: dyspnea, persistent high fever, or worsening condition. Prevention includes daily saline irrigation, ventilation, washing bed linens with hot water, and vaccines (influenza, COVID-19, pneumonia) available through Brazil’s public system; Curitiba-based physicians emphasize timely care.

triage.headline_ja: 冬の鼻づまり？鼻炎、副鼻腔炎、インフルエンザ、風邪、COVID-19の見分け方を学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は呼吸器感染症の症状鑑別に関する教育的・啓発記事であり、具体的な疾病クラスター、異常な増加、または緊急のアウトブレイク情報を含まない。SRAG統計は報告されているが、2026年の累積数であり、新規の異常事象を示す記事ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は医学的・教育的なコンテンツ（鼻炎、副鼻腔炎、風邪、インフルエンザ、COVID-19の症状鑑別ガイド）であり、新規アウトブレイク、クラスター、または異常事象の報告ではない。言及されているSRAG統計も季節性の範囲内であり、緊急対応トリアージの対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en Congo deja 202 muertos y se convierte en tercer peor brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo kills 202 people and becomes the third-worst outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths, with 67 recoveries, since its May 15 declaration in the eastern country. Ituri Province remains the epicenter, with about 91% of cases and 78% of deaths, while North Kivu and South Kivu report transmissions amid armed conflict that hinders health teams. The case fatality rate is 23%. Africa CDC ranks this outbreak as the third-worst in Ebola history, behind 2014–2016 West Africa and 2018–2020 eastern Congo outbreaks. It has crossed into Uganda, reporting 19 cases (14 imported from DRC) and 2 deaths. The WHO maintains an international alert for a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and Brazil is monitoring two suspected cases. Ongoing security challenges complicate contact tracing and containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ熱が202人の死者を出し、過去3番目の大規模流行に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ熱の大規模流行で死亡率23%、国際的に拡大（ウガンダ、ブラジルでも検出）、WHO PHEICとして既に国際警報発令中。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラ熱のDRC（South Kivu、Ituri州）での流行が主題であり、ウガンダへの越境感染（19例）、ブラジルでの疑似症例監視についても記載されている。DRCと対象国リストのBrazilのみ verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。既にWHO PHEICとして認識されており、Africa CDCが過去3番目の規模と分類している点から公式な認知度も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Belmiro Braga reforça ações de combate à dengue com novo equipamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Belmiro Braga reinforces efforts to combat dengue with new equipment.
article.articleSummary: Belmiro Braga's Vigilância em Saúde received a motorized backpack sprayer to aid Aedes aegypti prevention and control. Donated by the Government of Minas Gerais, the device enables faster, more efficient insecticide application in areas with suspected or confirmed dengue cases, contributing to eliminating adult mosquitoes and blocking transmission of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. The equipment expands the municipality’s response capacity, reinforcing strategies to protect residents and reduce vector-borne disease risks. Community participation remains essential, including removing water-holding containers, yard cleaning, and cooperation with endemic agents. The initiative demonstrates the municipality’s commitment to public health and preventive actions for population safety.

triage.headline_ja: ベルミロ・ブラガ市、新機器でデング熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の流行を背景とした予防管理強化の報道。具体的な新規患者数や重症度の増加を示す情報は記事に含まれておらず、むしろ既存対策の拡充についての内容であるため、現在のシグナル基準には明確には該当しない。ただし対象国・複数の媒介昆虫感染症が関連しているため、継続的な監視を推奨。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの地方自治体（Belmiro Braga市）による媒介蚊対策強化の施策報告。現時点では流行の規模・新規患者数・重症度等の具体的な疫学的情報が不足している。デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱は長期的・季節的に発生するブラジルの風土病であり、今回は既存対策の拡充という文脈。フルRRAへの進展には、患者数増加や重症化の傾向等、より詳細な疫学情報の入手が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Más de 200 muertos por ébola en RD Congo casi un mes después del inicio de la epidemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 200 people have died from Ebola in DR Congo nearly a month after the outbreak began
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 200 deaths, with Africa CDC reporting 202 fatalities among 875 confirmed cases (case fatality rate ~23%). Declared about one month ago on May 15, the outbreak affects the northeastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Limited contact tracing due to security challenges, restricted access to conflict-affected areas, and mass displacement hinder containment. The Red Cross warns the outbreak may not have peaked and could last up to a year. There is currently no vaccine or approved treatment for the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain driving this outbreak, complicating response in a country already plagued by armed conflict and displacement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱により200人以上が死亡、流行開始から約1ヶ月後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確定患者875人、死亡202人という重大な公衆衛生上の影響と、国際的な拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 確定患者数875人、死亡202人（致命率約23%）の大規模エボラ出血熱流行。武装勢力による紛争、接触者追跡の困難性、ワクチン・承認治療法がないBundibugyo株による流行という重大なリスク要因あり。Red Crossは流行が最高潮に達していない可能性と1年継続の警告を発出。国際的な支援体制確立が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Αφρική: Ξεπέρασαν τους 200 οι νεκροί από Έμπολα - Χωρίς εμβόλιο το στέλεχος Μπουντιμπούγκιο
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: Ebola deaths exceeded 200 - there is no vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) exceeds 200, with 875 laboratory-confirmed infections and 202 deaths since May 15, yielding a 23% case fatality rate. The outbreak's epicenter is Ituri province in northeast DRC, where security issues and poor roads hinder access and contact tracing. In neighboring Uganda, 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths have been reported, though officials say the outbreak there is under control. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific therapy. Transmission is through bodily fluids and close contact. Africa CDC warns that case-tracing remains challenged by security and access constraints in parts of the DRC. Ebola has killed over 15,000 people in Africa over roughly five decades.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ: エボラ死者が200人を超過 - ブンディブギョ株にはワクチンなし
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当する。エボラの大規模流行で国際的拡大リスク、死亡数増加、管理困難性が明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告も記載されているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ブンディブギョ株はワクチン未開発で、セキュリティ上の制約により接触追跡が困難な状況が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: نيابةً عن رئيس الدولة.. شخبوط بن نهيان يشارك في القمة الافتراضية الطارئة بشأن تفشي فيروس إيبولا ويؤكد دعم الإمارات لجهود الاستجابة في إفريقيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Representing the Head of State, Shakhbout bin Nahyan participates in the emergency virtual summit on the Ebola virus outbreak and reaffirms the UAE's support for Africa's response efforts.
article.articleSummary: On 18 June 2026, representing the Head of State, Shakhbout bin Nahyan Al Nahyan, Minister of State, participated in an emergency virtual summit on the Ebola virus outbreak in Africa. He stated that, per President Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan's directions, the UAE has supported WHO-led containment efforts through the UAE International Aid Agency. He reaffirmed UAE solidarity with affected communities, notably the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the Republic of Uganda, and commended the work of the World Health Organization, Africa CDC, and national health authorities in leading the response. He underscored UAE's commitment to an immediate, coordinated response to health crises consistent with its humanitarian mission to protect human life, in partnership with governments and international organizations. The UAE will continue to work with partners in Africa and the international community to strengthen response effectiveness and health-emergency preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 国家首脳代理として、シャハブ・ビン・ナヒヤンがエボラウイルスの流行に関する緊急仮想サミットに参加し、アフリカの対応努力に対するUAEの支援を再確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的なアウトブレイク（DRC、ウガンダで確認）であり、IHR基準で重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが全て該当。WHOおよび複数国による国際的な対応体制が確立されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラ出血熱の実際の発生地はDRC（民主共和国コンゴ）とウガンダで確認されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。UAEはアフリカでの対応支援国であり、発生地ではない。WHO、Africa CDC、国家保健機関による国際的な対応体制が確立されている。エボラ出血熱は極めて高リスク疾患であり、全てのIHR基準に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo DR Ebola jau pareikalavo per 200 gyvybių
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has already claimed over 200 lives.
article.articleSummary: As of June 18, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed 204 lives, with 894 confirmed cases (875 in Congo) and 74 recoveries, alongside two deaths in neighboring Uganda. The outbreak’s first month counts are the highest on the continent, about three times larger than the second-largest outbreak, per Wessam Mankoula. Contact tracing remains weak, with 4,112 contacts of confirmed cases identified, while estimates suggest roughly 35,000 contacts exist. Health officials warn the situation is far from under control. Ebola is a life-threatening disease transmitted through physical contact and bodily fluids. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain currently has no vaccine or specific treatment, complicating containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱、既に200人以上の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響を持ち、高い致死率、複数国への波及、コンタクトトレーシングの不十分さから国際的拡大リスクが高い。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCでの発生が主題。Bundibugyo株はワクチン未開発で治療法も限定的。コンタクトトレーシング不十分（4,112/35,000）により制御困難な状況にある。6月の1ヶ月間の発症数が大陸の記録的規模（第2位の3倍）であることが極めて懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 누적사망자 200명 넘어
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cumulative deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 200.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports Ebola deaths surpassing 200, with 875 cumulative cases and 202 deaths (case fatality rate 23%). In neighboring Uganda, 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. Africa CDC notes active tracing among cases and contacts totals 4,112, with about 35,000 estimated contacts—roughly 12% currently followed—versus the DRC government’s claim of 50–60% contact tracing. The AU’s Africa CDC says international donors pledged $910 million to support Ebola response in DRC and Uganda. AU’s Africa CDC coordinates cross-border surveillance and funding mobilization to back these efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ累積死者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も全5項目で該当。アクティブなエボラウイルス疾患の流行で、対象国であるDRCで確認。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患は最高レベルのリスク疾患。DRCでの累積症例875例、死亡202例（CFR 23%）、ウガンダでの国際的拡大（確認例19例、死亡2例）を確認。アフリカCDCが国際的な監視・資金確保を主導し、910百万米ドルの国際的支援誓約あり。接触者追跡（約35,000人中約4,112人）の進捗に課題あり。ウガンダ（対象国外）での発生も記載されているが、記事の主題はDRCのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: ZABORAVITE NA EBOLU, STIGLA JE KOLERA! UN: U epidemiji najmanje 90 mrtvih i 12.000 zaraženih! (FOTO)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Forget Ebola, cholera has arrived! UN: In the outbreak, at least 90 dead and 12,000 infected! (PHOTO)
article.articleSummary: Cholera outbreak in Borno State, northeastern Nigeria, has killed at least 90 people and infected more than 12,000 since emerging in early May. The UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), cited by Reuters, reports that humanitarian partners are expanding treatment, surveillance, and access to clean water to help Nigerian authorities halt transmission. An additional $4 million from OCHA-administered funds has been earmarked to strengthen the emergency response, though new funding is needed to boost prevention and care. Borno’s protracted conflict and humanitarian crisis complicate disease control and healthcare access. Separately, in eastern Congo, an Ebola outbreak continues with over 800 cases and at least 192 deaths attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no proven treatment or vaccine, and officials say the outbreak could last up to a year.

triage.headline_ja: エボラを忘れよ、コレラが来た！国連：感染症の流行で少なくとも90人が死亡し、12,000人が感染（写真）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、複数の高リスク疾患（コレラ・エボラ）による同時流行で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な関心、医療支援の緊急ニーズが確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではナイジェリア（Borno State）のコレラ流行とコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が述べられているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ナイジェリアは対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ただし、IHR基準と WPRO基準の全項目に該当し、複数国での同時流行が国際的な懸念となっているため PICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : On a dépassé les 200 décès, un taux de mortalité de 23% - Tunisie Numerique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: We have surpassed 200 deaths, a mortality rate of 23% - Tunisie Numerique.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in North-East Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 200 deaths, with 875 infections and a 23% case-fatality rate, according to Africa CDC on June 18, 2026. The outbreak was declared May 15 in the North-East DRC region; laboratory tests confirmed 875 infections and 202 deaths in the DRC. The mortality rate stands at 23%. In neighbouring Uganda, 19 cases have been confirmed, including 2 deaths. The data come from Africa CDC's official tallies, reflecting ongoing outbreak activity in the DRC and Uganda's reported cases as of the publication date. Laboratory confirmation underscores ongoing transmission; no infection source details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱in DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）：死亡数が200人を超えた、致死率23%
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：200人超の死亡、23%の高い致死率、異常/予想外な多数の症例、ウガンダでの国際的拡大確認、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラはレベル1の脅威疾患。フルRRA進行必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリー上ではウガンダは隣接国として言及され、症例報告（19例、2死亡）はDRCの主流行に対する国境を越えた拡大として記載されている。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラは極めて高リスク疾患であり、200人超の死亡、23%の致死率、確認された国際拡大により、即座のフルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak zone cases up almost 40 percent in a week
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo’s eastern provinces has 894 confirmed cases and more than 200 deaths in its first month, making it the worst known outbreak in Africa at this stage. Cases rose 38% in a week and span 32 health zones, with Ituri province accounting for over 90% of infections; cases have reached North Kivu and South Kivu and spilled into Uganda (19 confirmed cases, 2 deaths). Contact tracing is hampered by remoteness, funding and staffing shortages, and displacement; Ituri alone has displaced nearly one million. About 4,000 contacts have been identified; 800 confirmed cases would entail 17,000–35,000 contacts. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments; experimental monoclonal therapies are in development. Africa CDC says 84 of 540 needed personnel are deployed, and only $90 million of $900 million pledged has been released.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発生地域での症例数が1週間で約40%増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。大規模で急速に増加するエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクであり、国境を越えた感染確認、国際的支援の必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの19確認症例は記事サマリーでDRC領域からの流出として言及されているため、主要発生地はDRCとして評価。ただしUgandaは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo strain という特定の毒性株による、アフリカ最悪の初期段階アウトブレイク。38%の週間増加率、200名以上の死亡、32保健ゾーンでの拡大、ワクチン・治療の欠如、国際支援資金の逼迫など複数の重大懸念が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Μελέτη αποκαλύπτει χαμηλό κίνδυνο διεθνούς μετάδοσης του ιού Έμπολα " OnCamera.gr
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A study reveals a low risk of international transmission of the Ebola virus
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus international transmission risk is low, based on a study by van Zandvoort and colleagues analyzing cases outside Africa. The analysis covers confirmed Ebola infections exported from Africa from 1976 to May 2026, including Bundibugyo, Ebola, and Sudan viruses, and assesses implications for border controls and travel policies. Among 28 Ebola cases documented outside Africa, 25 were primary imports and 3 were secondary with infections in the United States or Europe. The dataset distinguishes two newer categories: medical transports and latent cases. The authors report an overall risk of Ebola occurring outside Africa since 2000 of 0.17 cases per 1,000, suggesting that robust outbreak response at the source, plus strengthened entry screening of workers, can markedly reduce export risk. They emphasize international responsibility to prevent importation and the importance of local screening capacity at exit and entry points in affected regions such as the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 研究によりエボラウイルスの国際的伝播リスクが低いことが明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学術研究の報告であり、新規の感染症イベント（発生確認）ではなく、過去のエボラ症例データ分析に基づくリスク評価論文である。2026年5月までの歴史的データ分析であり、現在進行中の流行や異常発生の報告ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラウイルスの過去データ（1976年〜2026年5月）に基づく学術分析であり、新規の感染症イベント検知（シグナル検出）ではない。DRCが言及されているが、これは分析対象地域としての参照であり、現在進行中の発生ではない。学術論文の紹介記事として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo says number of confirmed Ebola cases rises to 896
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has risen to 896 confirmed cases with 232 deaths as of the situation report published 2026-06-18. The figure reflects confirmations as of Wednesday, with 21 new cases and six new deaths in the prior 24 hours. Health officials report a week-on-week increase, indicating ongoing community transmission and a risk of rapid spread to new areas without prompt public health measures. The article provides no details on lab confirmation methods or infection sources. Emphasizes need for strengthened surveillance and containment across affected provinces to prevent escalation as of mid-June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ確認症例数が896件に増加したと発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。確認症例896件、死亡232件の大規模エボラ流行であり、継続的な社会感染と国際的拡大リスクが明白。
triage.notes: 大規模エボラ流行。確認症例896件、死亡232件、週間増加傾向。継続的社会感染と新規地域への拡大リスクが報告されている。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 사망자 200명 넘었다... 치명률은 23%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 200; fatality rate is 23%.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda. DRC reports 875 cumulative cases with 202 deaths (case fatality rate 23%). Uganda has 19 cases and 2 deaths. Active contact tracing is 4,112 individuals out of an estimated 35,000 contacts (~12%), contrasting with the DRC government’s 50–60% tracing claim. International response includes donor pledges totaling about $910 million for Ebola relief, with $80 million to be provided by AU member states; this is nearly double the previously announced $518 million plan. Funds cover outbreak coordination, surveillance, diagnostics, infection prevention and control, clinical care, research, logistics, and health services through November. Disbursement to date remains below 20%, and authorities warn total needs could rise to $1.5 billion if spread isn’t quickly contained. Donors are urged to mobilize the full $518 million within four weeks.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ死者が200名を超えた…致命率は23%
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事サマリーで言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの症例数875件、死亡者202名、致命率23%という深刻な状況。国際的資金援助（$910百万）が動員されており、政治的関心も極めて高い。フルRRA進行を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Bahrain sends emergency Nipah antivirals to Kerala
article.articleSummary: Kerala reported its first Nipah virus confirmation of the year in Kozhikode; a 43-year-old man tested positive last week. Bahrain supplied emergency antivirals Remdesivir and Ribavirin after a local shortage hindered treatment. The drugs have been distributed across affected districts and are intended for immediate use if new cases arise. Kerala Chief Minister V D Satheesan and Health Minister K Muraleedharan said emergency stocks were replenished; the first batch of 50 Remdesivir vials arrived and was sent to Kozhikode, where the index patient remains critically ill. To date, no additional infections have been detected; 11 symptomatic contacts tested negative, 30 tests in total with 29 negative. About 100 people are on the contact list (four highest risk, 14 high, 82 low), including 44 healthcare workers. Nipah is carried by fruit bats and Kerala outbreaks typically occur April–September during humid monsoon conditions; fatality rate is 40–70%, making early treatment crucial.

triage.headline_ja: バーレーン、ケーラ州へニパーウイルス治療薬を緊急供給
triage.triage_reason: ニパーウイルスの確定症例が報告され、高い致死率（40-70%）と国際的な医療支援の必要性が示唆されている。IHR基準3項目該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にバーレーン（290291）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではバーレーンは治療薬の供給国であり、ニパーウイルスの発生地ではない。ケーラ州（Kozhikode）の発生が主題であるため、verified_locationsはIndiaのみ。患者数は現在1名（指標患者）だが、接触者100名を追跡中で継続感染リスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola deaths top 200 as Africa CDC warns outbreak far from under control
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 200 deaths, with 875 confirmed cases and 202 fatalities (case fatality rate 23.1%), 67 recoveries, and 379 patients in isolation or hospital. Forty new confirmed cases, including four deaths, were reported in Ituri and North Kivu, with Fataki in Ituri and Musienene in North Kivu newly affected, bringing the total affected health zones to 33 across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Ituri remains the epicenter with 799 confirmed cases (91.3%) and 158 deaths; North Kivu has 73 cases and 43 deaths; South Kivu 3 cases and 1 death. Africa CDC warns the outbreak is far from under control, noting only about 12% of expected contacts are under active follow-up (roughly 6,500 of 35,000). There is no vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; response requires 90–95% contact follow-up, but a $21.5 million funding gap and other challenges persist. Declared May 15; as of 18 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ死者数が200人を超える、アフリカCDCは流行が制御下にないと警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo株）の確認されたアウトブレイク。死亡数200人超、確認症例875件、複数の健康地域への拡大、接触者追跡の大幅な不足、資金ギャップなど、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数に該当。公衆衛生面での深刻な影響と国際的懸念が明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola株による継続中のアウトブレイク。死亡率23.1%、33の健康地域に拡大、主にIturi（799例、91.3%）。接触者追跡能力の著しい不足（12%のみ）と$21.5M の資金ギャップが対応能力を制限。Africa CDCが制御下にないと公式に警告。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: World Cup puts Ebola outbreak and pandemic lessons to the test
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, the World Cup in the United States coincides with the spread of the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, exposing vulnerabilities in global health defenses. Experts warn that slow responses, aid cuts, and misinformation undermine Covid-era lessons and widen gaps in outbreak prevention and response. The piece points to China’s and the world's delayed reactions, and the corrosive effect of denialism. It also highlights political factors, including U.S. aid reductions under the Trump administration and scapegoating of African nations, which can hinder effective outbreak control and international cooperation. The authors argue that major events like the World Cup magnify outbreak risks unless surveillance, risk communication, and rapid-response capacity are strengthened. They urge translating pandemic lessons into timely action to protect populations and prevent international spread.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップがエボラ感染症アウトブレイクとパンデミック教訓を試す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラの新規アウトブレイク、国際的な大規模イベントでの感染リスク拡大、グローバルヘルス対応の脆弱性が指摘されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題は米国でのワールドカップ開催中のエボラアウトブレイク。発生地域に「Africa」が含まれているが、具体的な対象国の記載がないため、対象国リストから確実に該当するのはChina（遅延対応の具体例として言及）のみ。米国はエボラの発生地ではなく、対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo Ebola株の流行、政治的要因による対応遅延、パンデミック後の脆弱性が浮き彫りにされており、シグナルとしての重要性は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Roger Kamba et Patrick Muyaya à Bunia pour évaluer la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Roger Kamba and Patrick Muyaya in Bunia to assess the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Bunia since May 15, 2026. Health Minister Dr. Roger Kamba and Minister of Communications, Patrick Muyaya, arrived in Bunia on June 18, 2026 to assess the response, meet provincial authorities and healthcare teams, and identify challenges to adapt the response. The visit aims to strengthen coordination among health authorities, technical and financial partners, and local communities. Humanitarian Affairs Minister Eve Bazaiba also visited Ituri on the same day. Ongoing activities include surveillance, contact tracing, patient care, and community sensitization in the affected zones. Ituri remains the outbreak’s main hotspot, with substantial resources mobilized to contain spread and protect populations exposed to Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ロジェ・カンバとパトリック・ムヤヤがブニアに派遣され対応を評価
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認事例がDRC(イトゥリ州)で報告されており、IHR基準4つすべてに該当する可能性が高く、WPRO基準も複数該当する。公衆衛生への重大な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日からイトゥリ州ブニアを中心にエボラ出血熱の流行が発生。複数の政府閣僚（保健大臣、通信大臣、人道問題大臣）の現地視察が実施され、政府の高レベル対応が確認されている。接触者追跡、患者ケア、コミュニティ啓発など継続的な対応活動が報告されており、管理体制が構築されている。エボラはPIKUP判定の最重要感染症。

article.articleHeadline: 【茨城新聞】エボラ熱支援額９割未着
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ibaraki Shimbun: 90% of Ebola relief funds have not arrived.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province. As of June 18, the Congo Health Ministry reports 875 infections and 202 deaths. Africa CDC said donor nations have pledged at least $910 million to the response, but more than 90% has not yet been delivered, underscoring a need for rapid disbursement to expand treatment capacity and surveillance. Congo hosts nine treatment facilities with about 430 beds, of which 86% are in use. Contact tracing targets up to 35,000 contacts, but only around 4,000 are currently being tracked. The report notes the outbreak's expansion pace within a month of confirmation is faster than past large outbreaks, highlighting urgent funding and operational scale-up for prevention, case management, and epidemiological surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 【茨城新聞】エボラ熱支援額９割未着
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の急速な感染拡大、高い死亡率、国際的な支援体制の必要性、国際的な対応が求められるイベント。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク。875例の感染、202例の死亡が報告されている。過去の大規模アウトブレイクと比較して拡大速度が速く、国際的な資金援助の遅滞が報告されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: EU Commits $580 Million As G7 Leaders Demand Coordinated Response To DRC Ebola Crisis
article.articleSummary: Ituri province, eastern DRC near the Uganda border, is facing an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The DRC government reports 837 cases and 196 deaths, with 29 new cases in the last 24 hours. WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. The outbreak is complicated by conflict and mining activity, hindering containment. The G7 calls for a strong, coordinated response and urges broader international support; vaccines, diagnostics, and therapies are not fully effective against this rare strain. The EU Commission commits about €493 million (~$580 million) to frontline medical care, humanitarian aid in the Great Lakes region and Uganda, vaccine research, and health-systems strengthening. Uganda seeks reversal of travel restrictions; Red Cross warns the outbreak may not have peaked. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC; the deadliest occurred 2018–2020.

triage.headline_ja: EUが5億8000万ドルを拠出、G7指導者がDRCエボラ危機への協調対応を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した大規模なエボラアウトブレイク（837例、196死亡）であり、国際的な対応と支援が必要な明らかなシグナル。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが検出した発生地域にAustralia（New South Wales）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではオーストラリアでの実際の症例発生は報告されていない。同国はエボラ危機への国際的な対応・支援文脈での言及にとどまるため、verified_locationsから除外。ウガンダも記事に言及されているが、主たる発生地域はDRCのイトゥリ州であり、ウガンダは地理的隣接国・支援対象地域として記載されているため除外。本シグナルはPICKUPして直ちにフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nem tudo é gripe: saiba a importância de identificar as viroses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not everything is the flu: understand the importance of identifying viral infections.
article.articleSummary: Brazil sees rising severe acute respiratory illness (SARI) activity in May 2026, with influenza A, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), rhinovirus, and SARS-CoV-2 among the leading pathogens across regions, as reported by InfoGripe (Fiocruz). In Minas Gerais, clinician Guenael Freire notes that simultaneous circulation of these viruses complicates diagnosis based on symptoms alone during autumn-winter periods. Molecular respiratory panels on nasal swabs can simultaneously detect multiple circulating viruses and, depending on methodology, some bacterial pathogens, guiding clinical decisions and enabling closer monitoring of high-risk groups (children, elderly, chronic conditions). Prevention emphasizes vaccination against influenza and COVID-19, RSV vaccines, and infant nirsevimabe; an elderly-targeted influenza vaccine is also available. Brazil-wide emphasis on coordinated prevention and diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: すべてが流感ではない：ウイルス感染症を特定することの重要性を理解する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザA、RSV、SARS-CoV-2）の同時流行が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）に該当する可能性があるが、詳細な症例数、入院率、死亡データが記事に明記されておらず、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が完全には確認できないため。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月のブラジルにおける呼吸器ウイルス活動の増加を報告。複数のウイルスの同時流行（インフルエンザA、RSV、SARS-CoV-2、ライノウイルス）が秋冬期に診断を複雑化させている。Fiocruz（ブラジルの主要公衆衛生機関）が監視を実施中。具体的な症例数、入院数、死亡数の記載がないため、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」の評価が困難。医療プロバイダーの関心と予防強化の取り組みが確認できるが、フルRRAに必要な詳細データが不足しているため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱支援額９割未着　ＡＵ、各国に拠出訴え | 上毛新聞電子版｜群馬県のニュース・スポーツ情報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 90 percent of Ebola relief funding has not yet been received; African Union appeals to countries to contribute.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province, with 875 confirmed infections and 202 deaths. As of 18 June 2026, the African Union's Africa CDC said at least $910 million in pledges have been made by countries, but more than 90% has not been received, hampering outbreak response. The AU/CDC warns that scaling up treatment facilities and surveillance is urgently needed, given a faster-than-usual month-long growth in cases compared with prior outbreaks. Congo currently hosts nine Ebola treatment facilities with about 430 beds, of which 86% are occupied. Contact tracing potentially involves up to 35,000 individuals, but only around 4,000 are being tracked currently.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱支援額９割未着　ＡＵ、各国に拠出訴え
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響（875確定例、202死亡）、国際的な拡大リスク、異常性（例年より急速な増加）が認められ、2つ以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行可能性・管理可能性に該当し、国際支援が緊急に必要な状況。
triage.notes: Ituri Province東部でのエボラウイルス疾患の拡大が記事の主題。875確定例、202死亡、月単位での増加速度が例年より速い。資金調達の遅滞により対応が阻害されている状況が強調されている。接触者追跡対象が35,000人に上る可能性があるが、現在4,000人のみ追跡中という管理上の懸念が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: Campinas tem 32 bairros com alto risco de transmissão - ACidade ON Campinas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Campinas has 32 neighborhoods with a high risk of transmission - ACidade ON Campinas.
article.articleSummary: 32 neighborhoods of the Campinas metropolitan area are at high risk of dengue transmission as of June 18, 2026, per the Campinas Health Secretariat's 25th Arboviruses Alert for 2026. From January 1 to June 18, 2026, Campinas confirmed 3,115 dengue cases, with diagnoses declining weekly since May 3. The city logged 749,399 home visits to eliminate breeding sites and 49,909 fogging visits; 80% of breeding sites are inside residences. High-risk areas span East, Northwest, North, South, and Southeast Campinas, including examples such as Vila Costa e Silva, Vila Castelo Branco, Parque Maria Helena, Parque da Figueira, Jardim São Vicente. Preventive measures include removing standing water, refreshing plant-water every two days, washing plant saucers weekly, sealing water tanks, and keeping unused toilets closed. The alert aims to intensify household inspections and vector control citywide, guiding actions by incidence, new transmission, population density, and access.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：カンピーナス市内32地区が高い感染リスク - ACidade ON カンピーナス
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の都市部（カンピーナス）でデング熱が既知の流行状況であるが、新規な異常な株や変異による懸念、国際的拡大リスク、または深刻な死亡率の報告がないため、現時点では情報不足。継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、通常のWPRO評価規準の適用外。しかし、デング熱は既知の季節性流行で、カンピーナス市で6月18日時点で3,115確定症例、複数地区での高リスク警報が発出されている。死亡率や重症度についての記載がないため、深刻度は不明。記事は地域保健当局による予防措置強化と家庭検査の意向を示しており、管理可能性があると考えられる。継続的な疫学監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Γιατρός που βοήθησε την έρευνα για Covid συνελήφθη για μεταφορά του ιού Mpox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctor who helped with Covid research was arrested for transporting the Mpox virus.
article.articleSummary: Dutch virologist Dr. Vincent Munster, recognized for contributions to COVID-19 vaccine development, was arrested by US federal investigators for conspiring to import vials containing inactivated mpox (monkeypox) virus and other biological materials into the United States. Co-traveler Claude Kwe was stopped with him at Detroit Metropolitan Airport; both had worked in the Democratic Republic of Congo during the mpox outbreak. Activist Laura Loomer and the White Coat Waste Project portray Munster as a national-security threat. Munster’s research centers on how animal reservoirs, notably bats, relate to viral transmission to humans, including studies touching on Ebola. Investigators say a plastic case, labeled as diagnostic tools, actually contained over 100 vials of inactivated mpox. Inactivated materials must be declared and certified non-infectious by federal rules. If convicted, he faces at least five years in prison.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19研究を支援した医師がMpoxウイルス運搬で逮捕
triage.triage_reason: 米国での生物学的物質の不正輸入・運搬事件であり、複数の高病原性病原体（Mpox、Ebola）が関係。国際的な生物セキュリティ上の懸念と公衆衛生リスクが存在し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。DRC発生地域との関連性から国際的拡大リスクも懸念される。
triage.notes: 事件の主舞台は米国（対象国外）であるが、Mpox発生源地がDRCであり、DRC発生地での曝露が背景。記事では米国での逮捕と生物学的物質の不正輸入が主題であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ただし本事件は生物セキュリティ・違法輸入の側面が強く、感染症ケースマネジメントとしては限定的だが、国際的な生物学的脅威として重要。Bluedot自動分類（Mpox Clade I/II、COVID-19、Ebola）は過剰分類の可能性があるが、実際の関連性は確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Monsoon spike: Kerala on high alert as fever cases surge; 19 new Shigella cases reported
article.articleSummary: 19 fresh Shigella cases confirmed in Kerala this June, raising Shigella infections to 110 for the month; district breakdown: Kozhikode 9, Thrissur 3, Thiruvananthapuram 2, Kannur 2, Kollam 1, Ernakulam 1, Malappuram 1. Dengue remains a hotspot with 68 confirmed today and 297 suspected cases under observation, led by Thiruvananthapuram district (24 of today’s confirmed cases). Leptospirosis records 16 cases across districts. The monsoon-driven spike reflects rising vector-borne and waterborne disease activity; 13,849 fever-related outpatient visits were recorded in a single day. In response, the Health Department, with allied sectors, extended the sanitation and awareness drive until July 31 under the campaign 'Prevent Diarrheal Diseases, Save Lives,' prioritizing water chlorination, waste management, and early intervention to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: モンスーンの急増：熱病患者数が急増するため、ケーラ州が高度な警戒態勢に。19件の新しいシゲラ菌感染症が報告される
triage.triage_reason: ケーラ州において複数の水系・ベクター媒介感染症（シゲラ菌、デング熱、レプトスピラ症）が同時流行し、短期間での患者数急増と広い地域的拡大が確認されている。IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク）。
triage.notes: 記事はケーラ州全体におけるモンスーン期の多重感染症流行を報告。シゲラ菌110例（6月）、デング熱68例（単日確認）・297件疑い例、レプトスピラ症16例が同時報告されている。単日13,849件の発熱外来受診と対応措置の実施が確認されており、WPRO全基準に該当。地域検証：記事本体がインド・ケーラ州での発生を主題としており、GeoNames対象国リストにおいてIndia（1269750）のみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: Смертность от лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго превысила 230 случаев
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola fever in DR Congo exceeded 230.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths (case fatality ~26%), with 78 recoveries. The outbreak is reported in three DR Congo provinces and in Uganda. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the Congo outbreak and the Uganda situation. The circulating Bundibugyo strain has no approved treatments or vaccines; management relies on palliation, patient isolation, fluid replacement, and pain control. Health authorities and humanitarian workers warn of shortages of essential supplies such as masks and a lack of medical personnel, potentially hampering containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱による死亡者数が230例を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言している現行の大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。896確定症例・232死亡（CFR~26%）、Bundibugyo株、治療法・ワクチンなし、医療資源不足が報告されている。WHOがPHEICを宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。

article.articleHeadline: Minsa refuerza vacunación contra sarampión en la frontera con Brasil y Bolivia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health strengthens measles vaccination at the border with Brazil and Bolivia.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak prompts the Peruvian Ministry of Health to intensify house-to-house vaccination in Madre de Dios’s border areas with Brazil and Bolivia. Health teams from the Iñapari Health Post, adjacent to the Brazilian town of Assis, are conducting active case finding for children who have not completed the national immunization schedule. Vaccination teams are moving through jungle communities and chestnut-harvesting camps where many local families reside. At the same time, communications staff from Diresa Madre de Dios and the Ministry publicize key prevention and symptom-detection messages at tourist agencies, shops, and transport hubs to reach residents and travelers. The Iñapari Health Post reportedly carries all vaccines included in the routine schedule, and the Ministry urges parents and travelers to review their children's vaccination cards and visit the health centers or itinerant brigades to catch up for free.

triage.headline_ja: ペルー保健省、ブラジルとボリビアとの国境でのはしか予防接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ペルーでのはしか集団発生により積極的な予防接種対応が実施されており、国際的な懸念（ブラジル国境との関連）が示唆されるが、対象国はブラジルのみでサマリーから被影響国や深刻度、国際拡大の具体的なエビデンスが不足している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはペルー、ボリビアが含まれるが、対象国リスト内ではブラジル（3469034）のみに該当。ペルーとボリビアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事は国境地域でのはしか集団発生と対応を報じているが、患者数、死亡例、具体的な拡大リスクについては不明。続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Letters for June 19: Release USAID funds to assist in Ebola response
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-18, letters urge the rapid release of USAID funds to bolster the Ebola response in Africa. A new Ebola strain began circulating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and has spread to Uganda since early May, underscoring the need for humanitarian aid after the shuttering of USAID. The piece argues that foreign assistance is essential for global health and for preventing cross-border spread to the United States. It notes that the State Department is creating a disaster-response bureau and planning 12 regional emergency-relief hubs to improve relief capacity. Congress reportedly allocated $19 billion for foreign aid, currently held by the Trump administration for department closeouts, and activists warn the funds should be released promptly to fund outbreak containment.

triage.headline_ja: 6月19日付書簡: エボラ対応を支援するためのUSAID資金の迅速な拠出を求める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。既知のエボラ新株がコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダに拡大しており、米国への越境拡大の懸念も記述されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示されているのはコンゴ民主共和国での新株発生とウガンダへの拡大。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。米国への越境拡大の懸念は記述されているが、実際の発生例ではなく予防的警告のため、米国は含めない。対象国リスト内でコンゴ民主共和国のみが実際の発生地として確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo nhiễm sán dây lợn do ăn uống không bảo đảm vệ sinh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Pork tapeworm infection due to unsanitary eating and drinking.
article.articleSummary: Taenia solium (pork tapeworm) infection is a parasitic disease linked to unsanitary eating/drinking. Transmission between humans and pigs occurs when eggs shed by an adult tapeworm in human feces contaminate food, water, or pig tissue. Humans ingest cysticerci by eating undercooked pork, leading to intestinal tapeworm infection; autoinfection can occur. Eggs ingested via contaminated produce or water can migrate to muscle, subcutaneous tissue, eyes, or brain, causing cysticercosis. Neurological involvement (neurocysticercosis) is the most dangerous, presenting with prolonged headaches, memory problems, seizures, visual disturbances, behavioral changes, and potentially coma or death. Other sites include skin and heart; ocular cysts threaten vision. Prevention focuses on cooking meat, washing vegetables, using clean water, hand hygiene, proper pig-rearing and waste management, and seeking medical treatment under physician guidance; avoid self-treatment for neurocysticercosis. Risk foods include raw pork dishes such as nem chua, tiết canh.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：衛生管理が不十分な飲食によるブタ条虫感染
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける条虫症/神経条虫症に関する啓発記事。スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行性）で複数該当する可能性があるが、具体的な患者数や発生状況が記載されておらず、確定的なイベントであるかアウトブレイク規模が不明のため。
triage.notes: 記事は疾患啓発および予防勧告が主体であり、具体的なアウトブレイク事象の報告ではない。神経条虫症の重症性は高いが、発生患者数やイベント規模に関する具体的情報が欠落。衛生管理に関連する根本的な伝播リスク（豚肉調理方法、水・食物汚染）が言及されており、長期曝露と流行性の観点からはスクリーニング基準に該当。続報で具体的患者報告やアウトブレイク規模の情報が出現した場合はPICKUPに昇格する可能性。

article.articleHeadline: Alertan por avance del ébola en el Congo; deja más de 200 muertos en un mes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warnings about Ebola's spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; more than 200 dead in a month.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with more than a month since declaration and across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Africa CDC reports 875 laboratory-confirmed cases and 202 deaths, a case fatality rate of 23%. Contact tracing remains severely hampered by security and access challenges, limiting the ability to map transmission. WHO and partners warn that diagnostic capacity is stretched, complicating assessment of the outbreak’s true scope and peak timing may not be past. Daily there are new cases identified in additional health zones, reflecting widespread transmission and high population mobility. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is currently no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Public health responses focus on surveillance, infection control, and case management under difficult field conditions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の拡大について警告；1か月間で200人以上の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株によるアウトブレイク、高いCFR（23%）、セキュリティと接触追跡の困難さ、ワクチン・治療法の欠如により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク。875例の確認症例、202死亡（CFR 23%）。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州で多地点発生。セキュリティと接触追跡の困難により真の規模評価が困難。利用可能なワクチンまたは承認治療法がない。複数の新規ヘルスゾーンで継続的な新規症例発生報告。

article.articleHeadline: Жертвами лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго стали 232 человека - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 232 people have died from Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - News on Vesti.ru
article.articleSummary: As of 18 June 2026, Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has 232 deaths among 896 confirmed cases, with about 26% case fatality and 78 recoveries. The figures come 30 days after the outbreak was declared in Ituri province in the northeast. Health authorities say the rising case counts reflect improved detection under epidemiological surveillance. The outbreak remains under active management with ongoing laboratory confirmation of cases. The article notes Anatoly Altstein of the Gamaleya Research Center says Ebola is unlikely to spark a global pandemic, while Financial Times described the DRC outbreak as more than a local emergency, potentially a rehearsal for a future global pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により232人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という高危険性病原体による多数の死亡・確定症例が報告されており、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高危険性病原体であり、232人の死亡（確定症例896例中、26%の致命率）は極めて深刻。イトゥーリ州での発生宣言から30日での急速な症例増加が報告されており、積極的な疫学監視下での検出向上を反映。Financial Timesが「地方的な緊急事態以上の規模」と指摘し、国際的関心が高い。RRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda reached 827 confirmed cases and 194 deaths as of 15 June 2026 (DRC 808/192; Uganda 19/2). Ituri remains the epicenter; North Kivu is a rising concern with a 64% case-fatality ratio. The 16 June 2026 virtual HLPM, chaired by Burundi’s President Evariste Ndayishimiye, urged rapid cross-border action to contain transmission, protect communities and frontline workers, and prevent regional spread. A seven-day operational surge was requested to boost case investigations, 21-day contact follow-up, treatment and isolation capacity, IPC/PPE, safe burials, laboratory clearance, point-of-care diagnostics and risk communication. National funding commitments: DRC USD 50m, Uganda USD 5m. The June-December 2026 joint plan totals about USD 518m, supported by USD 910m in pledges; emphasis on front-loaded financing and in-kind support. Blanket travel bans are rejected; calls for data sharing and risk-based border measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ・ブンディブギョ・ウイルス病アウトブレイク - コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（高致死率、国際的懸念）の多国境アウトブレイクで、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、確認症例827件・死亡194件の重篤事象。国家レベルの支援体制と国際的な資金支援の必要性が確認され、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダの関与を明記しているが（19確認症例/2死亡）、対象国リストにはUgandaが含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。Burundi に関しては HLPM の議長国言及であり、発生地としての確認がないため除外。重篤度：CFR 64%（North Kivu）、多国境拡大リスク、及び USD 518m の国際支援要請により極めて高いリスク。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 사망자 200명 넘었다···접촉자 추적 12% 그쳐
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll exceeds 200; contact tracing only 12%.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 June 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province, show 875 cumulative confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality rate ~23%). In neighboring Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths are reported. Africa CDC warns contact tracing remains insufficient, with 4,112 active contacts out of an estimated 30,000 (about 12%), far below the government's claimed 50–60%. International support has surged, with donors pledging about $910 million for DRC and Uganda, including $80 million from African Union member states; this nearly doubles the earlier $518 million joint plan by Africa CDC and WHO. However, disbursement is slow, at under 20% of pledged funds. On 16 June, Africa CDC, WHO, and African leaders urged donors to release the full $518 million within four weeks, warning that outbreak response could rise to as much as $1.5 billion if control is not achieved.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの死亡者が200人を超えた···接触者追跡は12%に留まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。死亡者202名、接触者追跡率12%の低さ、国際支援総額9.1億ドルの緊急事態として、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ発生が記述されている。ウガンダのGeoNames IDは発生地域フィールドに含まれていない（226074は Republic of Uganda の古い登録ID）ため、標準的な1860554で表記。アフリカ大陸全体（6255146）は verified_locations から除外し、具体的な発生国のみを列挙。死亡者数202名、CFR~23%、累積確認症例875件は深刻な公衆衛生影響を示し、接触者追跡率12%の低さは対策不十分を示唆。国際資金動員（9.1億ドル）は国際的関心の高さを反映。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: la barre des 200 morts dépassée, la progression du virus dans le Nord-Kivu inquiète
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 200-death toll surpassed; the virus's spread in North Kivu is worrying.
article.articleSummary: 875 confirmed Ebola cases and 202 deaths have been reported in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo by Africa CDC. Ituri remains the epicenter with 799 confirmed cases; North Kivu has 73 confirmed cases but a case fatality rate of 59%. Uganda's situation is unchanged. Africa CDC warns that insecurity in North Kivu hinders outbreak response, limiting access for teams to conduct prevention, isolate suspected cases, and follow up contacts. The province also records the lowest identification and contact-tracing rates among the three affected regions, raising concern that the true case count could be higher due to access constraints. Authorities are urged to grant rapid access to affected areas to bolster surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ出血熱：死者数200人を超える、北キブ州でのウイルス拡大が懸念される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱は確認数875例、死亡202例と深刻な公衆衛生への影響を示し、複数州での拡大と国際的な懸念（ウガンダへの波及リスク）が存在。セキュリティ制限により対応が困難な状況にあり、シグナル特性が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高優先度の国際的脅威。記事サマリーはDRC（Ituri州、北キブ州）での確定症例と死亡数を主に報告。ウガンダは「状況に変化なし」と記載されているため、確定的な流行は認識されていない。セキュリティ上の理由による対応障害が重要なリスク要因。Africa CDCによる警告の発出は政府間の関心の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática del Congo reporta más de 200 muertos por brote de ébola - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports more than 200 deaths from Ebola outbreak - teleSUR
article.articleSummary: From May 15, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 202 deaths (case fatality rate 23%) with 67 recoveries. Ituri province remains the epicenter, hosting 91% of cases and 78% of deaths, while the virus has spread to North Kivu where conflict hampers response and contact tracing is weak; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases, 14 imported from DRC, and two deaths. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo Ebola virus, which has a 30–50% fatality rate and currently lacks an approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. The African Union has pledged about $910 million to accelerate response, including $80 million from member states, aiming to disburse $518 million within four weeks for surveillance, laboratory capacity, case management, infection prevention, and cross-border coordination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ出血熱の流行により200人以上の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と国際的拡大リスクを持つシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo型）により2026年5月15日から202人の死亡（致死率23%）が確認されている。Ituri州が流行中心地で全症例の91%、死亡の78%を占める。ウガンダに19確認症例（14は DRC からの輸入症例、2人死亡）が報告されている。WHOは2026年5月17日に国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。アフリカ連合が対応加速のために約9億1000万ドルを誓約しており、複数国での報告と国際的支援体制の起動がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : les fonds de la riposte gérés de manière transparente et décentralisée(ministre de la santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: funds for the response are managed in a transparent and decentralized manner (Health Minister) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola response funds in the Democratic Republic of Congo are being managed in a transparent, decentralized manner. In Bunia, Ituri, the Health Minister stated that 20 million dollars already received must be administered by the National Institute of Public Health and relevant directorates, with every expenditure traceable and no use outside the banking circuit. An overall 50 million dollar pledge remains, with 30 million yet to be collected by the government; once received, these funds will also be disclosed. Finances are directly injected into the outbreak epicenter to meet immediate field needs—vehicles, physicians, and personal protective equipment—rather than being centralized in Kinshasa. The briefing occurred amid a severe resurgence of Ebola in eastern DRC, with government plans to release the remaining funds progressively as they arrive.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱：対応資金が透明性と分散化の方式で管理されている（保健大臣）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の再発生が東部DRCで報告されており、IHR基準（異常性・重症度・国際的拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準（異常性・重症度・感染の容易性・管理性）が複数該当します。フルリスク評価が必要です。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月配信で、東部DRC（イトゥリ州、ブニア）における重大なエボラ再発生を報告しています。キナシャなど複数地域での感染確認と、国際的な資金確保努力が言及されており、WPROs基準全5項目に該当する高リスク事象です。

article.articleHeadline: Число смертей от Эболы в ДР Конго выросло до 232
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola in DR Congo rises to 232.
article.articleSummary: Death toll from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo rises to 232, with 896 total cases (up 21) as of 18 June 2026; 6 deaths occurred in the last 24 hours, according to the Ministry of Communications and Media. The outbreak, identified on 15 May, shows ongoing transmission, with about 90% of cases in Ituri Province where armed conflict and impeded aid hinder response. The risk of spread to new districts remains if measures are not implemented. On 16 June, Burundi, DR Congo, Uganda, the UN Secretary-General, and the WHO Director-General held an online summit on the outbreak. International funding is sought for the response, with a required amount of $518 million."

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱死者数が232人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（232死亡、896例）、異常で予想外のアウトブレイク、複数国への地域的拡大リスク（ウガンダ・ブルンジ含む）、国際的支援と資金援助の必要性が明らかである。
triage.notes: 武力紛争地帯での発生により対応が阻害されている。ウガンダ・ブルンジは同日オンラインサミットに参加していることから地域的懸念が高まっている。国際資金援助として5億1,800万ドルが必要とされている。記事サマリーではウガンダ・ブルンジは同日のサミット参加国として言及されているが、イベントの実発生地は確認できないため verified_locations には含めない（対象国リストに含まれていないため）。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Ebola constitue désormais une urgence humanitaire majeure (ministre des Affaires sociales) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola now constitutes a major humanitarian emergency (Minister of Social Affairs) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Ituri province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo, has been declared a major humanitarian emergency by Minister of Social Affairs Eve Bazaiba. The outbreak, centered in Ituri with spillovers such as Uvira, has outpaced response capacity and funding. With traditional humanitarian financing gutted by the withdrawal of the United States and United Kingdom, roughly 85% of funding is no longer available. CNCAH had warned of severity by late 2025. Estimates indicate that at least 15 million Congolese would need humanitarian assistance in 2026, with 7.3 million in urgent need, requiring about $1.4 billion. Despite mobilization, only about $417 million has been raised, and funds have not yet been transferred to the government. Kinshasa is seeking new partners (Germany and others) while awaiting disbursement. A strategic coordination meeting is planned to prioritize interventions, with data publicly accessible on UNOCHA platforms.

triage.headline_ja: エボラはもはや人道的大惨事である（社会問題大臣）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの多地域での発生、人道的危機宣言、国際的支援ニーズ、資金確保の困難さが報告されており、国際的スクリーニングが必要。
triage.notes: エボラ感染症の複数省での多地域発生（Ituri、South Kivu、Kinshasa）、人道的大惨事の公式宣言、15百万人の人道援助需要、資金ギャップ（目標14億ドルに対し4.17億ドルのみ）。米国・英国からの資金撤退による85%の資金喪失が報告されている。WPRO基準は対象地域外だが、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当するため優先度高。国際支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak is three times bigger than any previous outbreak at the same stage
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is three times larger than any previous outbreak at the same stage, one month after detection. Health workers report severe resource shortages in eastern Congo, with armed militias and distrust hindering contact tracing. The outbreak has spread to 31 health zones across three provinces and spilled over into neighbouring Uganda, with 875 Congo cases, 19 Uganda cases, and 204 deaths. The Africa CDC cites a 38% weekly increase; after a month the caseload is more than triple that of prior outbreaks. Donors pledged about $910 million, but less than 10% has been received. Safe burials require 540 workers and 98 vehicles, yet only 84 workers and 7 vehicles are available. For each patient, 20–40 contacts should be traced; less than 20% have been traced and 12% actively followed, far short of the 90–95% goal. Ituri and North Kivu face access challenges amid fighting with M23; Red Cross and MSF report ongoing gaps and distrust.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が同段階での過去のいかなる流行よりも3倍大きい
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は国際保健上最重要な病原体であり、複数国での急速な流行拡大は直ちにフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからUgandaへの流行拡大が記載されているが、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRC(203312)のみとした。本イベントはエボラウイルス感染症であり、同段階での過去流行対比で3倍のケース数、月1ヶ月で875例、死亡204例、国際拡大、医療資源の極度な不足、接触者追跡の深刻な不備（目標90-95%に対し実績<20%）が報告されており、IHR条約の核となる通知義務が生じている。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: UNFPA trains Goma health professionals to respond to the Ebola outbreak - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 18 June 2026, UNFPA reports in Goma, North Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, an Ebola outbreak response package for maternity care. The agency trained frontline maternity health professionals—midwives, nurses and triage staff—to sustain sexual, reproductive, maternal and newborn health services during the Ebola outbreak. The five-day training combined theoretical sessions and practical simulations, focusing on triage, early identification and reporting of suspected Ebola cases, infection prevention and control in maternity wards, proper use of personal protective equipment, and emergency obstetric and neonatal care in an Ebola context. An emphasis on maintaining dignified, reassuring, and respectful communication with patients is included. The initiative is funded by the United Kingdom, with UNFPA assisting partners to ensure the Ebola response does not compromise the health of women, mothers and newborns.

triage.headline_ja: UNFPA、ゴマの保健医療専門家をエボラ流行対応に向けて研修—ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤な疾患であり、コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのアウトブレイク対応に関する報告は、国際的影響と管理可能性の観点から IHR 基準を複数満たし、WPRO スクリーニング基準も該当する。国際支援が既に行われていることが確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国ゴマ市におけるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応の研修に焦点を当てており、DRC でのイベント発生が明確である。イギリスは資金提供国として言及されているが、イベントの発生地はDRC である。エボラは極めて高い死亡率と感染力を有する指定感染症であり、公衆衛生上の影響は極めて深刻である。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ熱支援額9割未着　アフリカ連合、各国に拠出訴え
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Only 10% of Ebola aid funds have arrived; African Union urges countries to contribute.
article.articleSummary: Only about 10% of promised funds have arrived for the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, Africa CDC reports, with pledges totaling at least $910 million but more than 90% yet to be delivered. The shortfall threatens expansion of treatment facilities and surveillance. As of 2026-06-19, Congo’s Health Ministry confirms 896 Ebola cases and 232 deaths, centered in Ituri Province. Africa CDC notes the early growth rate is faster than in prior large outbreaks. The country operates nine Ebola treatment facilities with about 430 beds, 86% of which are in use; authorities are adding nine more. Contact tracing could involve up to 35,000 individuals, but only around 4,000 are currently being monitored.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱支援額9割未着　アフリカ連合、各国に拠出訴え
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱はDRC東部で進行中の重大アウトブレイク（896例、232死亡）であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを有する。
triage.notes: DRC東部Ituri州を中心とした現在進行中のエボラアウトブレイク。記事は資金不足による対応能力の低下を報告。早期成長率が過去の大規模アウトブレイクを上回るとのAfrica CDCの指摘あり。接触者追跡対象は最大35,000人だが、実際の監視は4,000人程度に留まる。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو تتخطى 200 حالة وتحذيرات من تفاقم الأزمة الصحية - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in Congo surpass 200 cases, with warnings of the health crisis worsening.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 204 confirmed deaths (including Uganda) and 894 confirmed cases, with 875 cases in the DRC and 74 recoveries. The first month of the outbreak is the highest on record for the period, with current totals more than threefold the second-largest outbreak in the same timeframe. Contacts under follow-up total 4,112, far below the roughly 35,000 believed to have been exposed, underscoring gaps in contact tracing and continuing transmission. Officials say the outbreak remains far from under control and warn that the health crisis is worsening.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱死者数が200例を超え、保健危機の悪化の警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。致命的で制御困難なエボラ出血熱の多国間流行で、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラ出血熱の発生地はコンゴ民主共和国が主で、ウガンダについては括弧内で言及（確認死亡数に含まれる）されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの流行である。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみであり、ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。発症日時が2026年と記載されているが、これは配信日時の誤記と考えられ、2025年の可能性あり。接触者追跡が著しく不十分（4,112人のみ、推定35,000人の曝露あり）であり、継続的な感染の危険性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: وفيات "إيبولا" في الكونغو تتخطى 200 حالة وتحذيرات من تفاقم الأزمة الصحية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in Congo exceed 200, with warnings of a worsening health crisis.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) worsens as of 18 June 2026: 204 confirmed deaths (including Uganda) and 894 laboratory-confirmed cases (875 in the DRC), with 74 recoveries. The first month records the outbreak's highest monthly total, more than three times the second-largest on record. Cross-border transmission is evident, with Uganda contributing to the total fatalities. Health authorities say the outbreak remains far from under control, as only 4,112 contacts are being followed, far below the roughly 35,000 believed exposed. The update signals a growing health crisis in border regions, highlighting the need for intensified surveillance, expanded contact tracing, and strengthened response to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱による死亡者が200人を超え、保健危機の悪化警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病は極めて重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国境を越えた感染拡大が確認され、制御下にない状況が確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。DRCはリスト対象国であり、記事の主要な発生地域として確認される。エボラウイルス病は致死率が高く、接触者追跡が不十分であることが明記されており、コントロール外の状態が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Ituri: Two ministers arrive in Bunia to assess response activities - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, declared May 15, 2026. It is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment, complicating containment. By mid-June, DRC officials reported more than 650 confirmed cases and over 130 deaths, with the epicenter in the Mongbwalu mining area of Ituri and spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, and Kampala, Uganda. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The outbreak is the 17th Ebola event in the DRC. On June 18, 2026, two central-government ministers arrived in Bunia to assess the response, identify strengths and weaknesses, ensure resource mobilization, and coordinate with the new provincial governor. This marks the third government mission within 30 days to monitor actions on the ground and halt further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリでエボラ：2人の大臣がブニアに到着して対応活動を評価 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、Bundibugyo株による大規模なエボラ熱アウトブレイク（650例以上、130人以上の死亡）でWHOが国際保健上の懸念事項である公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。DRC・ウガンダ両国での多国境展開とハイレベルな政府対応が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株（ワクチン・治療法がない）による極めて重篤な状況。記事ではウガンダのKamphalaへの広がりが記載されているが、DRCが主要な発生地であり、ウガンダの具体的な症例数や人的影響については記載がない。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、多くのエボラ基準に該当している。

article.articleHeadline: วันใหม่ ไทยพีบีเอส - "ตั้ม สมประสงค์" เตือนระวังนกพิราบ ก่อเชื้อโรค | Thai PBS รายการไทยพีบีเอส
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Day Thai PBS - "Tum Somprasong" warns against pigeons that spread disease | Thai PBS program
article.articleSummary: A former Thai singer, Tum Somprasong, from Mae Rim district, Chiang Mai, warns of pigeon-borne infection after his illness last week. He required eight days of hospitalization at Mae On Hospital in Mae On District, Chiang Mai, following exposure to pigeon droppings from birds perched on his balcony, door frame, and windows. Before illness, he cleaned the droppings, then developed nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, shortness of breath, and severe headache, leading to an eight-day hospital stay. He is recovering but awaiting laboratory confirmation of the exact cause, though he remains convinced the infection originated from pigeon feces. The report highlights the risk of pigeons as infection sources and advises caution around droppings.

triage.headline_ja: 新しい日タイPBS - 「タム・ソムプラソン」がハトによる病原菌感染に警告 | タイPBSプログラム
triage.triage_reason: 未確定の原因不明疾患で、単一事例の個人的な感染報告。実験室確認待機中であり、感染症イベントとしての公衆衛生的な重要性は現在のところ限定的。追加情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 単一の有名人による個人的な感染報告で、実験室確認が未完了。ハトとの接触による感染リスクに関する認識啓発的な報道。感染症として確認されていないため、原因確定後の動向が重要。

article.articleHeadline: El brote del ébola ha matado ya a más de 200 personas en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has already killed more than 200 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths, with 67 recoveries and a case-fatality rate of 23%. Declared in eastern DRC on 15 May, Ituri province remains the epicenter, hosting 91% of cases and 78% of deaths, with spread to Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu. Nord-Kivu is described as heavily affected by ongoing conflict between the army and rebel groups, rendering large parts inaccessible to response teams, and reporting the highest fatality rate and the lowest rate of contact tracing among the three provinces.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行により、コンゴ民主共和国ですでに200人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つ全て満たす。確定患者875名、死亡202名（致命率23%）の大規模流行で、複数州への拡大、紛争地帯での管理困難性があり、国際的な公衆衛生上の重要事象として即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、DRC（Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivu州）における大規模エボラ出血熱流行の確定報告。Ituri州が震源地（患者の91%、死亡の78%）であり、紛争地帯での対応困難性が特に懸念される。2026年5月15日宣言、6月19日現在で確定患者875名、死亡202名、致命率23%。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 232 décès et 896 cas confirmés enregistrés un mois après (Ministre de la Santé) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 232 deaths and 896 confirmed cases recorded one month after (Minister of Health) - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 18 June 2026, Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reaches 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths after 30 days since Ituri province declaration, with 78 recoveries after two consecutive negative tests. The case fatality rate stands at about 26%. About 6,000 contacts are being traced, with a 71% follow-up rate; the goal is 95%. Minister of Health Roger-Samuel Kamba says the rising case counts reflect intensified active case finding and surveillance. The update covers Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, with Bunia as the outbreak’s epicenter. Declared May 15, 2026, this is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or treatment. The United States has provisionally approved 500 monoclonal doses for severe cases in response to DRC’s request.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：1ヶ月後に232人の死亡と896人の確認症例が記録（保健大臣）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全5基準該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率と国際的脅威をもつシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株によるアウトブレイク、ワクチン・治療法なし。米国からのモノクロナール抗体投与開始。6,000人以上の濃厚接触者を追跡中（フォローアップ率71%）。発生地域にUSAが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCでの発生が主体であり、米国は支援国として言及されているのみため、verified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: شخبوط بن نهيان يشارك في القمة الافتراضية الطارئة بشأن تفشي "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shakhbout bin Nahyan participates in the emergency virtual summit on the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Shakhbout bin Nahyan Al Nahyan, UAE Minister of State, spoke on behalf of President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan at an emergency virtual summit on the Ebola outbreak in Africa. He said that under the President's directives, the UAE provides support to strengthen World Health Organization efforts to contain Ebola in Africa through the UAE International Aid Agency. He reaffirmed UAE solidarity with the affected communities, especially the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, and praised the work of WHO, the Africa CDC, and national health authorities in leading the response. He emphasized UAE's commitment to rapid, urgent responses to crises and to combating diseases and epidemics through humanitarian and medical actions, in coordination with governments and international organizations. He concluded that the UAE will continue to work with partners in Africa, WHO, and the international community to support effective responses and strengthen health-emergency preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: シャフブート・ビン・ナハヤン、エボラ流行に関する緊急オンラインサミットに参加
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生がアフリカ（特にDRC、ウガンダ）で報告されており、IHR基準を複数満たす。また国際的な懸念と高レベルの政府関与が確認されるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はUAE政府高官によるエボラ流行への国際的対応を報じている。実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダが明記されており、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。UAEは支援国であり発生地ではないため除外。エボラの高い死亡率と感染力、及び国際的緊急サミット開催という事実から、重大なシグナルとして判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases up nearly 40% in eastern Congo outbreak zone: Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo has surged about 38–40% in the past week across 32 health zones. Africa CDC reports at least 894 confirmed cases since the outbreak began on May 15, with the current event three times larger in its first month than Uganda’s 2000 outbreak, and evidence suggests circulation for weeks before declaration. About 35,000 people are identified as potential contacts, but only 4,000 are being tracked and evaluated. For roughly 800 confirmed cases, 17,000–35,000 contacts should be listed, underscoring gaps in tracing due to remoteness, funding and personnel shortages, and displacement. Only 74 recoveries have been reported across eastern Congo and Uganda. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo virus yet; monoclonal antibodies are in development. More than $900 million has been pledged, but ~10% activated; Africa CDC operates 84 staff, far short of the preferred 540.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部のエボラ症例が1週間で約40%急増：アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響、迅速な感染拡大、国際的拡大リスク、ワクチン・治療手段の欠如が確認される。WPROスクリーニングも全項目で懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ東部のエボラ症例の急増を主題としている。ウガンダへの言及は歴史的比較文脈（2000年の過去流行）であり、現在のウガンダでの活発な流行を示唆していない。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみとした。症例数894件、1週間で38-40%の急増、接触者追跡の重大な不備（35,000人中4,000人のみ）、利用可能なワクチンや承認済み治療法がない状況が確認される。Africa CDCの人員不足（84名対必要540名）と資金制約が対応能力を著しく制限しており、国際的な支援と関与が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: 我中招了，都是在小蓝上乱来的结果"！20岁小伙哭诉撞上HIV_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: I got infected—it's all because I messed around on Xiaolan! A 20-year-old man tearfully laments contracting HIV.
article.articleSummary: A 20-year-old man in China contracted HIV after unprotected sex with strangers via the Xiaolan app, later testing positive and enrolling for lifelong treatment with his mother accompanying him to the hospital. The incident reflects ongoing youth HIV infection in China. By end-2025, the Chinese CDC reports about 1.41 million people living with HIV/AIDS. Annual new infections among 15–24-year-olds are roughly 3,000; in 2022 this group accounted for about 10,700 new infections, with 82.5% transmitted through male-to-male sex; the average age at diagnosis is 19.9 years. Contributing factors include risky online dating, inadequate sex education, and low use of post-exposure prophylaxis within 72 hours. HIV remains incurable and necessitates lifelong treatment, imposing physical, psychological, and social burdens. The piece urges youth to practice safe sex, avoid casual/anonymous encounters, and pursue prevention and testing promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 「私が感染した。全て小藍アプリでの不用意な行動の結果だ」20歳の青年がHIV感染を涙ながらに嘆く
triage.triage_reason: 個人の感染事例を取り上げた啓発記事であり、新たな集団発生や異常な感染パターンを示す疫学的シグナルではない。中国における既知の継続的な感染傾向の一般的な事例報道。
triage.notes: 記事は個人のHIV感染事例を健康教育の文脈で報道したもの。既知の統計情報（年間新規感染者数、男性同性間感染の割合など）を補足しているが、新規の集団発生や予期しない感染パターンは記述されていない。したがってシグナル性なし。

article.articleHeadline: 科研团队：本轮埃博拉疫情源自动物向人类跨物种传播
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Research team: This round of the Ebola outbreak originated in animals and spread to humans through cross-species transmission.
