article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda traces to a wildlife-to-human spillover in a novel cross-species transmission, with no evidence of long-hidden human transmission. Collaborative genome sequencing by Uganda National Health Laboratory and the DRC Institute of Biomedical Research shows the current strain differs markedly from the 2007 Ugandan and 2012 DRC Ebola strains. Since the outbreak was declared on May 15, the DRC has reported over 870 cases and 202 deaths, concentrated mainly in Ituri Province; Uganda has 19 cases and 2 deaths. Researchers urge sustained cross-border collaboration to trace transmission, bolster border surveillance, and prevent further spread. The findings underscore the role of animal reservoirs in triggering outbreaks and the importance of rapid genomic surveillance for outbreak response. Published June 19, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 研究チーム：今回のエボラ疫情は動物から人間への種間伝播に由来
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。また複数国での確認、高い死亡率、活発な国境協力と国際的関心が存在。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRCにおいても19例2死亡と言及しているため、対象国リストに無いウガンダは検証済み位置から除外した。DRCにおいて870例以上202死亡という深刻な状況が示されており、ゲノム解析による新規の種間伝播であることが報告されている。6月19日公開の研究であり、現在進行中の疫学事象。

article.articleHeadline: Congo informa que número de casos confirmados de Ebola sobe para 896
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo reports that the number of confirmed Ebola cases has risen to 896.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 896 confirmed cases, including 232 deaths, as of 18 June 2026, per government data. The situation report, covering cases confirmed through Wednesday, notes 21 new cases and six new deaths in the last 24 hours. Health authorities report a week-on-week rise in confirmed cases, indicating ongoing community transmission. The article provides no details on laboratory confirmation methods, specific infection sources beyond community spread, or imported/exported cases. These figures signal a persistent outbreak within the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of the published date, underscoring the need for sustained surveillance and response efforts to curb further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ確認症例数が896件に増加したと報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：232死亡、異常：週単位での症例増加、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラは重大感染症で、継続的な地域伝播とリスク管理が重要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患の継続的な流行として報告。2026年6月18日時点で確認症例896件、死亡232件、過去24時間で新規症例21件、新規死亡6件。週単位での症例増加傾向と地域伝播の継続を示唆。国家規模の対応が進行中と考えられるが、フルRRA段階での国際的支援ニーズ評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 木工不曾出国却感染美洲真菌 原来是接触过进口木材 _新闻频道_厦门网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A carpenter who had never left the country contracted a fungus from the Americas; it turned out he had come into contact with imported wood.
article.articleSummary: Disseminated histoplasmosis due to Histoplasma capsulatum infected a 63-year-old carpenter in Xiamen, Fujian, China, linked to contact with imported wood dust. Despite no overseas travel, long-term exposure to wood, sawdust and dust from imported lumber led to systemic infection. Beginning last year, he suffered repeated abdominal pain, progressive weakness, weight loss of about 15 kg, fatigue, chest tightness, and exertional dyspnea. PET-CT showed bilateral adrenal high uptake; evident adrenal insufficiency with hypotension (88/52 mmHg) and hyponatremia/hypochloremia. Fine-needle biopsy showed extensive necrosis, granulomatous inflammation, and fungal bodies; special staining suggested a fungus; when subjected to molecular testing, diagnosed as disseminated histoplasmosis involving adrenal glands and lungs. Treated in Infectious Diseases with multidisciplinary care; after 20 days, symptoms improved, weight increased by 4 kg, and he was discharged with regular follow-up and ongoing meds. The report highlights environmental exposure to fungal pathogens could transmit infections without international travel.

triage.headline_ja: 木工が未出国なのにアメリカ大陸の真菌に感染 ～輸入木材への接触が原因だった
triage.triage_reason: 散発的な職業関連ヒストプラズマ症の単一症例報告であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は低く、公衆衛生への重大な脅威は示唆されていない。しかし環境曝露経路の記録および中国での未知の輸入木材関連リスク要因は継続監視に値する。
triage.notes: 散発症例であり流行の兆候なし。輸入木材を通じた環境曝露経路が特異的であり、同様の職業曝露リスクを有する作業者への予防啓発は有用。記事がメディアで報道されたことは、職業衛生・環境感染症としての注目を反映。フォローアップは輸入木材取扱い環境での追加症例有無を重点とすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Tin thị trường 24h: Đồ hộp Hạ Long sản xuất trở lại sau lùm xùm 130 tấn thịt lợn bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Market News 24h: Ha Long canned goods resume production after the uproar over 130 tonnes of diseased pork
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) contaminated pork linked to Ha Long Canfoco’s Haiphong plant prompted a production halt in January. The factory resumed operations on June 11, after the company’s board announced renewed focus on food safety and quality control, heightened internal oversight, and process improvements. About 130 tonnes of ASF-infected pork were uncovered during investigations into the procurement, transportation, and processing of swine meat, triggering significant business disruption and senior management changes. The incident underscores ongoing risks to Vietnam’s pork supply chain and food-safety governance in Haiphong. No human cases are reported; the outbreak concerns animal health and biosafety in the Vietnamese pork industry, with the response centering on compliance, transparency, and risk mitigation between producers and regulators.

triage.headline_ja: 市場ニュース24時間：ハイフォン缶詰工場、130トンの病気の豚肉騒動後に生産を再開
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）の動物感染イベントであり、ベトナムの豚肉サプライチェーンに対するリスクが存在するが、人への感染報告がなく、工場は既に生産を再開している。情報更新の経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病であり人への直接的な公衆衛生上の深刻な影響はないが、ベトナムの食品安全体制と豚肉サプライチェーンの脆弱性を示す。既に生産再開されており、リスク低下傾向にあるが、ベトナムにおけるASFのより広範な拡大リスクがあれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Zone Cases Up Almost 40% In A Week
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has grown to 894 confirmed cases and more than 200 deaths in its first month, making it the worst known outbreak at this stage. The outbreak has spread across 32 health zones in eastern Congo. Africa CDC notes the outbreak is roughly 38% larger than the previous week and is three times larger in confirmed cases than Uganda's 2000 outbreak at a similar point (281). Only 74 patients have recovered so far. About 4,000 people have been identified and are being evaluated, with 4,112 contacts currently under follow-up and an estimated 35,000 exposed. Contact tracing is hampered by remoteness, funding and personnel shortages, and displacement, hindering efforts to bring the situation under control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症アウトブレイク地域での症例数が1週間で約40%増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は最重症度の感染症であり、1ヶ月で894確定症例、200以上の死亡、32保健地区での拡大、国際的な拡大リスク、公衆衛生への極度の影響が認められる。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最重症度の病原体であり、死亡率が非常に高い。DRCでの894症例は記録的規模であり、接触者追跡の困難さ（遠隔地、資金不足、人員不足、避難民）が管理可能性を大幅に低下させている。ウガンダでの過去事例との比較から国際的拡大リスクも高い。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de ébola en el Congo suben a 896
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo rise to 896.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues as the 17th outbreak, declared May 15. As of 19 June 2026, confirmed cases reach 896 with 232 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, spanning 33 health zones. Wednesday reported 21 new confirmed cases and 6 deaths. Affected patients isolated or hospitalized total 383; 78 have recovered, including 11 discharges after negative tests. Suspected cases total 151 with 35 deaths. Contact tracing covers 6,367 individuals, of whom 4,525 were located (70.1%–71.1% follow-up). The outbreak indicates ongoing community transmission and potential rapid geographic spread if public health measures are not quickly scaled up. The current strain is Bundibugyo Ebola virus; laboratory confirmation and active surveillance remain critical.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例が896件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも5項目すべて該当。確定患者896名、死亡232名、コミュニティ内伝播継続中。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日宣言の17番目のエボラアウトブレーク。確定患者896名（死亡232名）、疑い患者151名（死亡35名）。Bundibugyo Ebola virus株。33の衛生地域に拡大、接触者追跡6,367名中4,525名を追跡中。コミュニティ内伝播が継続しており公衆衛生対策の強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: وفيات "إيبولا" في الكونغو تتخطى 200 حالة وتحذيرات من تفاقم الأزمة الصحية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 200, with warnings of a worsening health crisis.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease continues to surge in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention reporting 204 confirmed deaths (including fatalities recorded in Uganda) and 894 confirmed cases, of which 875 are in the DRC and 74 have recovered. The first month of this outbreak features the highest number of new infections on record for the period, more than three times the second-largest outbreak in the same timeframe. Authorities warn that the situation is deteriorating, as the number of contacts being traced has fallen to about 4,112, far short of the roughly 35,000 believed to have been in contact with patients. Public health officials say the response remains well below control, underscoring a worsening health crisis.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死亡数が200人を超過、保健危機悪化の警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大（死亡数200人超、感染数894人）、予想を上回る感染速度（同時期で過去3倍以上）、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、および制御下にない状況が確認された。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダが発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーでウガンダ発生を明確に述べる言及がなく、DRC内での死亡数統計に含まれている模様。対象国リストではウガンダが不含であるため、DRCのみを verified_locations に記載。エボラ出血熱は極めて高いシグナル価値を持つ。

article.articleHeadline: Covid-19 surge expected in coming weeks
article.articleSummary: Macau's Health Bureau reports a Covid-19 surge, with the weekly positivity rate rising to 17%, surpassing the warning threshold and markedly higher than the prior week. Officials warn that transmission is likely to remain elevated in the coming weeks, indicating sustained community spread. The update stresses protection for high-risk groups—elderly residents, people with chronic illnesses, and those with weakened immune systems—and urges vaccination against Covid-19 to reduce potential severe outcomes. The notice underscores ongoing transmission activity in Macau and calls for vigilance among residents, continued adherence to public health measures where appropriate, and sustained readiness as the situation develops in the territory.

triage.headline_ja: 今後数週間でCOVID-19の急増が予想される
triage.triage_reason: マカオでのCOVID-19感染の上昇を報告しており、異常性・重症度のスクリーニング基準を満たす可能性があるが、死亡やアウトブレイクの急速な拡大等の深刻な影響の詳細が不明であり、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はマカオ（香港・マカオは中国に含める）での局地的なCOVID-19上昇を報告。週間陽性率17%という数値的上昇と、高リスク層への呼びかけが認められ、WPRO基準の異常性・長期曝露・流行しやすさに該当。ただし国際的拡大リスクやIHR基準の該当がなく、死亡者数等の重症度情報が不明であるため、WATCH段階が適切。

article.articleHeadline: MPAC aciona Justiça para obrigar Prefeitura de Sena Madureira a criar controle de zoonoses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MPAC files suit to compel Sena Madureira City Hall to create a zoonosis control program.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-18, in Sena Madureira, Acre, Brazil, the Public Prosecutor's Office of Acre (MPAC) filed a civil action to compel the City Hall to establish a zoonosis-control program and strengthen public health protection. The suit cites the absence of a shelter for abandoned, abused, or stray animals and the lack of a Center for Zoonoses Control (CCZ). It seeks a 30-day action plan detailing temporary shelter space, veterinary care, staff, food, medications, vaccination campaigns, adoption programs, and a ongoing sterilization policy for dogs and cats; plus educational initiatives and foster-family schemes. The request also mandates a CCZ within 180 days, with budgetary provisions and operational steps. The MPAC warns that gaps in animal-population management, sanitation, and waste management elevate risks of zoonoses such as rabies, leishmaniasis, and leptospirosis.

triage.headline_ja: MPAC（アクレ州公共検察庁）がセナ・マドゥレイラ市庁舎に動物由来感染症対策プログラムの設立を強制する訴訟を提起
triage.triage_reason: 複数の人獣共通感染症（狂犬病、リーシュマニア症、レプトスピラ症）がリスク要因として指摘されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・長期曝露・流行容易性）に複数該当する可能性があるが、現在の症例報告や実地アウトブレイクの記載がなく、情報が法的対応・政策レベルに限定されているため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は公共検察庁が動物由来感染症対策の欠落を理由に市庁舎に対して法的措置を講じた事案である。狂犬病、リーシュマニア症、レプトスピラ症が予防対象として言及されているが、現在の症例数や病気の活動性に関する具体的なデータはない。Sena Madeiraはアクレ州ブラジルに位置する。WPROスクリーニング基準では「長期曝露」（放置された動物、衛生管理の欠落が継続的曝露を示唆）、「流行しやすさ」（犬・猫の未管理個体群、動物用ワクチン接種不足）、「異常性」（CCZ存在しない）に該当する。管理可能性は国・地域レベルの組織的対応の必要性を示唆している。ただし公開情報では実患者報告がなく、潜在的なリスク評価に留まる。

article.articleHeadline: Presidential Ebola task force urges vigilance against
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-19, Nigeria’s Presidential Task Force on Ebola Preparedness, established by President Tinubu, aims to prevent importation of Ebola from the DRC, Uganda and neighboring countries. Chaired by Femi Gbajabiamila, the 18‑member panel is the principal decision‑maker on measures needing presidential approval—flight restrictions, port closures, quarantine orders, and emergency funding—and will coordinate the whole‑of‑government response and public communication. It will oversee the National Ebola Virus Disease Preparedness and Response Plan, review subcommittee recommendations, and escalate actions as needed. The task force is to meet every two months or as circumstances require and can be stood down if the threat is contained. The NCDC has strengthened surveillance at Lagos and other international airports and at land borders, coordinating with airport authorities and state governments. Members include ministers (Aviation, Interior, Finance, Information, State for Foreign Affairs), health officials, FAAN MD, Lagos/Kano/Rivers/Enugu health commissioners, WHO rep, APHPN, DRASA MD. Tinubu approved N10 billion for emergency preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 大統領エボラ対策本部がウイルス流入に対する警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病は高リスク病原体であり、DRCからの流入リスク評価と大統領レベルの対応体制構築が国際公衆衛生上の重大な関心事項である。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアでのエボラ対策強化に関するもので、DRC・ウガンダからの流入リスク防止が主題。Bluedotが抽出した地域（ナイジェリア、DRC、ウガンダ）のうち、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）のみであるが、記事サマリーに明示された該当地域がDRCであり検証地域として追加。ただし対象国リストに直接該当する検証地点がないため、本質的には地域検証上の課題がある。本トリアージはエボラウイルス病の高リスク性とナイジェリアの公式対応体制確立に基づき判定。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ禍コンゴに届けた歴史的「勝ち点1」　トランプ政権の入国制限でサポーターたどり着けず - スポニチ Sponichi Annex 社会
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Historic 'one point' delivered to Congo by the Ebola outbreak — supporters unable to reach due to the Trump administration's travel restrictions.
article.articleSummary: Congo and Portugal drew 1-1 in a World Cup Group K match in Houston, giving Congo its first World Cup point in 52 years; their last appearance had three losses and 14 goals conceded. The Ebola outbreak expanding in Congo prompted the United States to bar entry for foreigners who had stayed in Congo or neighboring African countries within the past 21 days, preventing many Congolese supporters from travelling. Refugee math teacher Manasse Kwete, living in Dallas, lamented the absence of Congolese fans. Players entered the United States after quarantine in Belgium. In Congo, large gatherings are restricted for infection control, yet fans gathered in cafes with televisions to celebrate the draw. The article notes the U.S. travel ban covered 39 countries, including Iran, and that 78 of 104 World Cup matches in the U.S. were played amid limited spectator access.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ禍コンゴに届けた歴史的「勝ち点1」　トランプ政権の入国制限でサポーターたどり着けず
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。コンゴでのエボラ流行による広範な入国制限が実施されており、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴでのエボラ流行に関連する入国制限がワールドカップに与えた影響。Bluedot APIが複数国を列挙しているが、実際の感染症イベント発生地はコンゴのみ。米国テキサス州での試合開催は感染症の発生地ではなく、コンゴのエボラ流行による対応措置の影響を受けた場所。イランやベルギーなどの他国は対象国リストに含まれていないため含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Número de casos confirmados de Ebola na RD Congo sobe para 896 | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Number of confirmed Ebola cases in DR Congo rises to 896
article.articleSummary: As of 18 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 896 confirmed Ebola cases and 232 deaths. The government data released on 18 June show 21 new cases and 6 new deaths in the past 24 hours, with authorities noting a weekly rise in confirmed cases and ongoing community transmission. They warn the outbreak could rapidly spread to new areas if public health measures are not promptly implemented. The US CDC announced US$107 million in emergency funding to bolster responses in DR Congo and neighboring Uganda. About a month after WHO declared an international emergency, officials warn this could become the worst Ebola outbreak on record, potentially surpassing the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which killed more than 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確認症例数が896件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルスは公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクのいずれも明確。WHO国際緊急事態宣言済み、複数国での報告あり。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、Angola、USAも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC内のエボラ発生。UgandaはWPRO地域外のため対象国リストに含まれず、DRCのみ verified_locations に列挙。US CDC資金提供はDRC・Uganda支援の目的であり、これ自体は新たな発生地域の追加を示さない。WHO国際緊急事態宣言済み、月前から宣言されており、過去最大規模のアウトブレイク警告あり。シグナルピックアップは確実。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يودي بحياة أكثر من 200 شخص في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills more than 200 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has killed more than 200 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, about a month after the outbreak began. Africa CDC reports 202 deaths among 875 confirmed cases, a case fatality rate of 23%. An Africa CDC official warns that contact tracing remains weak due to security constraints and limited access for response teams from Africa CDC, WHO, and partners. The Red Cross says the outbreak, announced May 15, has not peaked and could take up to a year to contain. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC, with three Northeastern provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu—divided by armed conflict and displacement, complicating response. The strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are no vaccines or treatments currently. The outbreak has extended to Uganda, but containment there has been effective, with 19 cases and 2 deaths, most of them Congolese travelers.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で200人以上の死者を出す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスは国際感染症規則で最高リスク疾患であり、国境を越えた拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及）、高い死亡率（23%）、国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事に言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主要な発生地。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株であり、ワクチン・治療法なし。コンタクトトレーシングの困難さ（セキュリティ上の制約、対応チームへのアクセス制限）が懸念される。1ヶ月で200人以上の死亡、上昇傾向を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: हिमाचल में डायरिया और हेपेटाइटिस-ए सबसे बड़ा स्वास्थ्य संकट, 2021 से 25 के बीच 3 जिले सबसे ज्यादा प्रभावित - himachal pradesh diarrhea hepatitisa major health crisis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diarrhea and Hepatitis A in Himachal Pradesh: the biggest health crisis, three districts most affected between 2021 and 2025.
article.articleSummary: Diarrhea and Hepatitis A emerge as the major public health challenges in Himachal Pradesh from 2021–2025, according to a study by the State Health Education Directorate’s Community Medicine department. Across 34 outbreaks, 3,937 people were affected and 2 deaths occurred. Acute Diarrheal Disease accounted for 18 outbreaks affecting 2,796 people (71%), while Hepatitis A caused eight outbreaks with 702 infections. Dengue comprised 9.6% of total cases; Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease and jaundice were comparatively lower. The year 2024 was the most alarming, with 17 outbreaks (50% of total) and 2,964 people affected, including both deaths. Hamirpur, Solan, and Mandi districts bore the heaviest burden, contributing over 60% of cases. Outbreaks clustered during monsoon and post-monsoon months (peaks in October, November, and June); water source contamination and infrastructure were key drivers. Recommendations: strengthen surveillance, regular water testing, timely warnings, and targeted prevention."} ,

triage.headline_ja: ヒマーチャルプラデシュ州における下痢とA型肝炎：最大の健康危機、2021年～2025年に3地域が最も大きな影響を受ける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：3,937人の感染・2死亡、異常/予想外：複数の流行、国際的拡大リスク：デング熱を含む）。WPRO基準でも複数該当（重症度あり、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の問題）。フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 2024年の50%の流行集中、水道インフラの汚染が主要なリスク要因、モンスーン期における季節的クラスタリング、3地域での大規模集中は感染力の高さを示唆。ただし記事は過去の歴史的サマリーであり、現在進行中の流行かどうかは不明だが、2024年の急増と改善の勧告提示から現在進行中の懸念事項と解釈される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo informa que número de casos confirmados de Ebola sobe para 896
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo reports that the number of confirmed Ebola cases has risen to 896.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: confirmed cases have risen to 896 with 232 deaths, according to government data released on Thursday night. A situation report indicates 21 new confirmed cases and six new deaths in the last 24 hours, and notes a week-to-week increase in confirmed infections, signaling ongoing community transmission. Health authorities warn the outbreak could rapidly spread to new areas if public health measures are not promptly implemented. The figures reflect cases confirmed through Wednesday; the article provides no details on laboratory confirmation. This ongoing outbreak in the DRC underscores the need for strengthened surveillance, case management, contact tracing, safe burials, and community engagement to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ確定患者数が896人に増加したことを報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を有し、継続的なコミュニティ伝播と週単位での患者増加が確認されており、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の流行は国際的に高い懸念事項である。記事では過去24時間に21例の新規確定患者と6例の死亡が報告されており、週単位での患者増加が継続している。公衆衛生措置の実装遅延リスクも指摘されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго за сутки от лихорадки Эбола умерли шесть человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, six people died in 24 hours from Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo totals 232 deaths from 896 infections as of June 19, 2026, with six fatalities in the last 24 hours. Reuters, citing the Ministry of Health, reports a weekly rise in confirmed cases, indicating active transmission and potential spread to new areas. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15; about 90% of cases are in Ituri province, where armed conflict hampers medical response. Authorities and the World Health Organization estimate a $518 million funding requirement to combat the epidemic. Jean Kaseya, head of the African Centres for Disease Control and Prevention, warned the East Africa outbreak could last a year. If transmission does not slow, the scale could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic, which WHO data show killed more than 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで24時間にエボラ熱で6人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを持つ確立された感染症。現在の流行は232死亡/896感染で、継続的な伝播と東アフリカへの拡大の可能性が示唆されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則上の報告対象感染症。記事ではDRC内のイトゥリ州が約90%の症例を占めており、武装紛争による医療対応の阻害が懸念される。東アフリカへの拡大警告と2014-2016年西アフリカ流行（11,000人超死亡）との比較が示唆する重大性により、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة صحية: إيبولا يودي بحياة أكثر من 200 شخص في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A health organization: Ebola has claimed the lives of more than 200 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has claimed 202 lives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to Africa CDC, about a month after the outbreak was declared on May 15. Confirmed cases total 875, yielding a case fatality rate of about 23%. The outbreak has extended to Uganda, with 19 infections and 2 deaths among Congolese travelers; authorities say the contacts of these cases have been traced and follow-up is ongoing. The report notes concerns about weaknesses in contact tracing, underscoring the need for intensified surveillance and public health measures to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 保健機関：エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で200人以上の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生脅威であり、複数国での確認、高い死亡率（23%）、国際的拡大リスク、および接触追跡の弱さが報告されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国の主要な発生を述べており、これが対象国に該当するため PICKUPと判定。接触追跡の弱さが明示的に報告されており、管理可能性に対する懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: وفيات إيبولا في الكونغو تتخطى 200 حالة - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola deaths in the Congo exceed 200
article.articleSummary: On 19 June 2026, the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 200 deaths, with 204 fatalities after including Uganda-reported deaths, and 894 laboratory-confirmed cases (875 in the DRC), with 74 recoveries. Most cases (875) are in the DRC, while deaths include Uganda-reported fatalities as cross-border transmission concerns grow. Public health officials noted a sharp decline in contacts under follow-up to 4,112 from an estimated 35,000 previously linked to exposures, signaling surveillance gaps. The update underscores ongoing transmission and cross-border implications with Uganda, highlighting challenges in contact tracing and containment as the outbreak persists.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱死亡者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（200人以上の死亡、894確定例）、異常・予想外の事態、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの国境越え感染）、渡航・貿易制限リスク。WPRO基準も5項目すべて該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高致死性のため深刻度が高い。接触者追跡の著しい減少（35,000→4,112）は監視の盲点を示唆し、管理可能性への懸念がある。DRCとウガンダ間の国境越え感染による国際的拡大リスクが具体的に記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: وكالة سرايا : منظمة صحية: إيبولا يودي بحياة أكثر من 200 شخص في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Saraya Agency: Health Organization: Ebola claims more than 200 lives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, Africa CDC reports an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo with 875 laboratory-confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality rate ~23%), about a month after it was declared on 15 May. The virus has reached Uganda, with 19 infections and 2 deaths among Congolese travelers; some contacts have been traced. Security challenges in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu—driven by armed conflict and displacement—hinder contact tracing and response efforts for this hemorrhagic fever. A major barrier is the absence of licensed vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the strain driving the current wave. The Red Cross warns the outbreak has not peaked yet, and containment could extend up to a year under present conditions.

triage.headline_ja: サラヤ通信社：保健機関：エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で200人以上の命を奪う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WPRO基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、高い致死率（23%）、セキュリティ上の課題による対応困難が確認され、フルRRA実施の必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラ出血熱の発生地はDRC（South Kivu、Ituri、North Kivu州）が主要で、ウガンダへの波及は確認されているがウガンダ国内での流行ではなく、コンゴからの越境感染。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。2026年6月19日時点で875例の確定症例と202死亡（致死率23%）を報告。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による流行で、ワクチン・治療薬の欠如、武装紛争による治安悪化が対応を著しく阻害している。Red Crossは流行がピークに達していないと警告。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases increase almost 40% in week as death toll passes 200
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo and Uganda severely escalates: 894 confirmed cases and over 200 deaths in the first month, with 74 recoveries. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, which has no approved vaccines or treatments; early days lacked testing for this strain. Up to 35,000 suspected contacts are identified across 32 health zones, with Ituri province driving the crisis (over 90% of cases) and spillover into North Kivu and South Kivu; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. Experimental monoclonal antibodies are under development. Contact tracing is hampered by remoteness, insecurity in Ituri, and nearly 1 million displaced people, complicating containment and tracing among miners. Of 800 confirmed cases, an estimated 17,000–35,000 contacts should be tracked; only ~4,000 are currently monitored (under 15%). Pledged funding exceed $900 million, but only about $90 million released; Africa CDC estimates 540 personnel are needed, with only 84 deployed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の症例が1週間でほぼ40%増加、死亡者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。Bundibugyo型エボラの大規模アウトブレイク（894確認症例、200死亡以上）で、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの流行入り）、国際支援必要性が明白。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにUgandaが含まれ、サマリーでもウガンダへの流行入り（19確認症例、2死亡）が明記されているが、対象国リストにUgandaは含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみ対象国該当。ワクチン・治療法未承認、接触者追跡不十分（4,000/17,000–35,000）、資金不足（$90M/$900M以上）など管理上の深刻な課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يودي بحياة أكثر من 200 شخص في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills more than 200 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed more than 200 people a month after its May 15 outbreak declaration, with 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality 23%). African CDC notes transmission and weaknesses in contact tracing amid security challenges; Red Cross says the outbreak has not peaked and containment could take up to a year. Eastern provinces Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, where armed conflict and displacement hinder response; Uganda has reported 19 cases and 2 deaths among travelers. No vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak. In a study, researchers using human brain organoids show Ebola can persist in semen for months to a year and within the CNS, with replication up to 120 days in organoids. Spread occurred via direct cell-to-cell transmission and budding; researchers urge more work on Bundibugyo and other strains.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、民主共和国コンゴで200人以上の死者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の流行拡大、国際的な感染拡大リスク（ウガンダへの伝播確認）、および渡航制限リスクを示している。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも19症例2死亡が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo株による流行で、ワクチンと治療法が存在しない状況。武装紛争と人口移動により対応が困難。記事サマリーから、DRCが主たる発生地域であることは明確。

article.articleHeadline: نسبة وفيات 23% من المصابين.. إيبولا يقتل 200 شخص في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 23% case-fatality rate among the infected... Ebola kills 200 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola remains active in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with 202 deaths among 875 confirmed cases (case fatality rate 23%), about a month after the outbreak was declared on May 15. Africa CDC cautions that contact tracing is hampered by security constraints, limiting access for response teams from Africa CDC, WHO, and partners. There are no vaccines or treatments for the Bundibugyo Ebola virus lineage driving this outbreak, complicating containment efforts. The hardest-hit provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu—face armed conflict and mass displacement, hindering control measures. The Red Cross warns containment could take up to a year. Cross-border spread has reached Uganda, with 19 cases and 2 deaths, most patients among Congolese travelers, underscoring the need for cross-border surveillance and coordinated response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが感染者の23%の死亡率で... コンゴで200人が殺される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラは極度に深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、予想外の大規模アウトブレイク、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクを示している。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当し、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも越境感染が確認されているが、記事の主題はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクであり、ウガンダはdeclared case による反応地域のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo Ebolavirus系統、治療法・ワクチン不在、セキュリティ制約による接触追跡の困難さが重要なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: المناخ يهدد حياة أطفال العالم.. اليونيسف: 1.1 مليار طفل معروضون لمخاطر مناخية الجفاف والحر الشديد أبرزها ومليار آخرين للملاريا.. الساحل الأفريقى أكثر المناطق تضررا.. ومديرة المنظمة: تأُثر الحياة اليومية للأطفال - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Climate threatens the lives of children worldwide: UNICEF says 1.1 billion children are exposed to climate risks, notably drought and extreme heat, with a further 1 billion at risk from malaria. The African coast is the most affected region, and the organization's director says daily life for children is affected.
article.articleSummary: UNICEF warns that as of 19 June 2026, 1.1 billion children—almost half of all children worldwide—are exposed to at least three interconnected climate risks, threatening health, education, and survival. Drought, extreme heat, and heatwaves are the most widespread, with more than 296 million children in affected regions. A billion children are at risk from malaria, adding another layer of danger for those already facing multiple climate hazards. The African coast and the Sahel are particularly hard hit, where over 4 million children face the triple threat of heat, extreme heat, and dust storms. In Asia, Bangladesh, Myanmar, and Pakistan face high simultaneous risks; in Italy, more than 6 million children experience prolonged heat and drought. Air pollution threatens nearly all children globally. The report urges rapid emission cuts to prevent worsening impacts.

triage.headline_ja: 気候が世界中の子どもの生命を脅かす：ユニセフが11億人の子どもが気候リスクにさらされており、干ばつと極端な高温が特に顕著で、さらに10億人がマラリアのリスクにあると発表。アフリカ沿岸地域が最も被害を受けており、組織の長官は子どもの日常生活に影響が出ていると述べている
triage.triage_reason: マラリアを含む気候変動関連の健康脅威に関するUNICEFの警告報告。対象国内ではバングラデシュ、ミャンマー、パキスタンで高いリスクが指摘されているが、記事は広域的な社会的警告であり、特定の急性感染症アウトブレイク情報ではなく、情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はUNICEFの広域的な気候変動影響レポートであり、バングラデシュ・ミャンマア・パキスタンでの具体的な現在進行中のマラリアアウトブレイク情報ではない。パキスタンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Indiaは地理的に関連地域（アジア）として含めるが、記事本文に具体的な言及がないため「不明」と判定した基準が多い。続報による具体的なアウトブレイク情報の提供を待つべき。

article.articleHeadline: Novo caso de febre amarela é registrado em Lagoinha em São Paulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New case of yellow fever reported in Lagoinha, São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever case confirmed in Lagoinha, São Paulo. As of 18 June 2026, São Paulo state reports 11 cases and six deaths from yellow fever in 2026, with a 55-year-old man from Lagoinha—the latest case and unvaccinated. The Vale do Paraíba accounts for 82% of 2026 cases; nine of 11 cases are in Lagoinha and five deaths occur there. None of the confirmed 2026 cases had vaccination. Despite the surge, 2026 figures are lower than 2025, which recorded 57 cases and 35 deaths in the state. Vaccination is free at UBS primary health units across 645 municipalities, and is positioned as safe, effective, and recommended for the entire population since 2019; individuals should vaccinate at least 10 days before exposure to risk areas. Vaccination guidance: children 9 months with booster at 4 years; unvaccinated 5–59 years receive a single dose; those with 2018 fractional dose should verify need for update. Yellow fever is transmitted by wild mosquitoes; there is no direct human-to-human transmission, while monkey die-offs indicate viral activity.

triage.headline_ja: São Pauloのラゴーニャで黄熱病の新規患者が報告された
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（São Paulo州）で確認された黄熱病の流行事象。2026年に11症例・6死亡が報告され、死亡率約55%と重症度が高く、IHR基準の「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」「予想外性」に該当。ワクチン接種率の低さと野生蚊媒介により感染の長期継続リスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、São Paulo州Lagoinha地域が主要な発生地であり、2026年の流行は2025年（57症例・35死亡）より少ないものの、高い死亡率（11症例中6死亡=55%）が特徴。全症例が未接種者。野生蚊媒介による継続的な感染リスクと、ワクチン接種キャンペーンの展開が記述されている。Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはSão Paulo、Paraíba、Brasilが含まれているが、サマリーの主題はSão Paulo州（特にLagoinha）であり、Brasilを対象国として verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Motivul incredibil pentru care a lipsit celebrul suporter "Lumumba" din meciul Portugalia - Congo! Ţinut în carantină înainte să ajungă în America
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The incredible reason why the famous fan 'Lumumba' was absent from the Portugal vs. Congo match! Kept in quarantine before arriving in America.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo and Portugal drew 1-1 in Houston in the World Cup opener, marking Congo’s first-ever World Cup goal. Celebrated fan Michel Kuka Mboladinga, nicknamed “Lumumba,” missed the match after a 21-day quarantine in Brussels, a visa condition tied to Ebola-related travel restrictions for entrants from so-called third-world countries. He is slated to attend the June 24 match against Colombia in the Akron Stadium, Guadalajara. Large Congolese support persisted, with about 10,000 fans in Houston and roughly 16,000 in Texas. The tribute reflects Patrice Lumumba, Congo’s independence hero, with the fan’s gesture echoing Kinshasa’s statue.

triage.headline_ja: 有名なサポーター「ルムンバ」がポルトガル対コンゴ戦から欠席した信じられない理由！アメリカに到着する前に検疫で隔離
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は、エボラ関連の渡航制限が過去に存在したことに言及した歴史的背景であり、現在の感染症イベント（患者発生、流行、アウトブレイク）を報告していない。サッカー・ワールドカップの試合に関する社会面ニュースであり、感染症危機管理上のシグナルに該当しない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数国（DRC、USA、Mexico等）を検出しているが、記事の主題はサッカー試合とファンの逸話である。エボラは過去の渡航制限の文脈でのみ言及され、現在の感染症イベントは記載されていない。スポーツニュースであり感染症シグナルではない。

article.articleHeadline: Kematian Akibat Wabah Ebola di RD Kongo Tembus 200 Orang : Okezone News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola outbreak in DR Congo tops 200: Okezone News
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 200 deaths, with Africa CDC reporting 875 confirmed cases since May 15 and 202 deaths (case fatality ~23%) as of June 18, 2026. The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with Ituri accounting for about 95% of infections. The virus has crossed into Uganda, with 19 cases and 2 deaths confirmed. Africa CDC says testing capacity and digital surveillance have been strengthened to improve detection and curb spread. DR Congo Health Minister Roger Kamba visited Bunia to assess response and discuss strategies. Africa CDC Director warns the outbreak could be more severe than the 2014-2016 West Africa Ebola epidemic if not controlled, which caused over 11,000 deaths in Guinea, Liberia, and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行による死亡者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPRO基準5項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク疾患であり、200人超の死亡、複数国への拡大、歴史的流行との比較言及により社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ出血熱がDRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州）で主要な発生地として報告されており、ウガンダへの越境も記載。Sierra Leone、Liberia、Guineaは2014-2016年の過去流行との比較参照として言及されているため、現在の発生地には含めない。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: UDF govt delaying doctors appointment as Kerala reels under communicable diseases: Vijayan
article.articleSummary: Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan alleged that the UDF government is delaying doctors' appointments, compounding a public health crisis as the state battles a spike in communicable diseases. He listed Shigella, Nipah, dengue, cholera, West Nile virus, and amoebic meningoencephalitis among the mounting infections, with deaths also rising, according to his remarks. Vijayan claimed coordination failures in disease prevention and a lack of vigilance, and he asserted that essential medicines were not available. He also framed the situation within broader political action, arguing that measures for welfare schemes, such as women's security programs and monthly youth stipends, have been put on hold by the new government. In the same press conference, he urged steps to avoid electricity restrictions amid the FIFA World Cup 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州が感染症に揺れる中、UDF政府が医師任命を遅延させている：ビジャヤン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的な懸念病原体の複数同時流行）。WPRO基準も複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ）。政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ケーラ州で複数の病原体（ニパウイルス、デング熱、コレラ、ウェストナイル熱、赤痢、アメーバ髄膜脳炎）による同時多重流行が報告されている。死亡が増加しており、医療資源の不足と調整の失敗が指摘されている。政治的論争の中での報告だが、公衆衛生危機の実質性は高い。Nipahは特に懸念される高病原性病原体である。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Issues First-Ever Guidelines For Ebola And Marburg Viruses As Africa Battles Ongoing Outbreak
article.articleSummary: WHO's first comprehensive clinical management guidelines for filovirus diseases cover all Ebola variants and Marburg. Launched June 17, 2026, amid an active Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo caused by Bundibugyo virus. Filoviruses—including Ebola species Zaire, Sudan, Bundibugyo, Taï Forest, and Marburg—cause fever, bleeding, organ failure and high mortality (case fatality 25–90%). Since 1967, Africa has recorded 72 filovirus outbreaks. With no licensed vaccines or specific treatments for several strains, high-quality supportive care remains the most effective tool. Developed from global expert consultations, the 16 evidence-based recommendations aim to harmonise clinical practices and strengthen preparedness in resource-limited settings. Highlights: prioritised laboratory monitoring for complications; rapid dehydration treatment with oral or IV fluids; early shock management with IV fluids and vasoactive drugs; prompt antibiotics for suspected co-infections; survivor after-care to reduce persistence-related transmission. Governments are urged to integrate these into national plans.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラおよびマールブルグウイルスの初の包括的ガイドラインを発表、アフリカの継続的な感染症対策に対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRC内で進行中のエボラ（Bundibugyo株）の感染症イベントがあり、高い致死率と感染しやすさが確認される。
triage.notes: DRC内でBundibugyo株エボラが現在進行中の感染症イベントとして記載されている。WHOの新しいガイドライン発表は対応の強化を示す。致死率25-90%、ワクチン・特異的治療が限定的という高リスク特性が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Wabak Ebola: Jumlah kematian di Congo lepasi 200 orang | Berita Harian
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Death toll in Congo surpasses 200 people | Berita Harian
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 200 deaths, with 875 lab-confirmed cases and 202 fatalities since the outbreak was declared on 15 May, yielding a 23% case fatality rate. The spread spans Ituri Province and North Kivu and South Kivu, with Ituri contributing about 95% of cases. Cross-border transmission is evident, with 19 confirmed cases in Uganda, including two deaths. In response, testing capacity and digital surveillance have been scaled up to close detection gaps. Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya warned the outbreak could be worse than the West Africa 2014-2016 epidemic if not rapidly contained. Congo’s Health Minister Roger Kamba visited Bunia, Ituri’s capital, to assess progress, challenges, and new strategies to accelerate control.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：コンゴでの死亡者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致命率を持つ公衆衛生上の重大脅威であり、既に国境を越えた拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaも含まれており、記事サマリーで19確認症例と2死亡がウガンダで報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。エボラウイルス病は最高リスク病原体であり、23%の高い症例致命率、急速な地域拡大、Africa CDC責任者による2014-2016年西アフリカ流行超過警告など、全ての重大シグナルが明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الديمقراطية تسجل أكثر من 200 وفاة جراء تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo records more than 200 deaths due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is contending with its seventeenth Ebola outbreak, reporting 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality rate 23%). Declared May 15, the outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or therapeutics. Africa CDC notes weak contact tracing and security/access challenges hinder response by Africa CDC, the World Health Organization, and partners in the northeast provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, where armed conflict and displacement complicate control. The International Red Cross warned containment could take up to a year. The outbreak has spread to Uganda, with 19 cases and 2 deaths, most among travelers from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, illustrating cross-border transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ流行による200人以上の死亡を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、Bundibugyo株による大規模流行（875確定症例、202死亡、CFR 23%）、ウガンダへの国際的な越境感染の確認があり、緊急性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダの患者発生が言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRC内の大規模エボラ流行であり、ウガンダは越境感染の事例として記載されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。本流行の対応能力不足（ワクチン・治療薬なし、接触追跡の弱さ、武装紛争による混乱）と国際赤十字による1年の封じ込めに要する予想期間から、極めて高いリスク判定。

article.articleHeadline: Perú refuerza la vacunación contra el sarampión en su frontera con Brasil y Bolivia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Peru strengthens measles vaccination along its border with Brazil and Bolivia.
article.articleSummary: Measles vaccination is being intensified in Peru along the Madre de Dios Amazon border with Brazil and Bolivia after a measles outbreak alert. The Ministry of Health (Minsa) and the Regional Health Directorate (Diresa) of Madre de Dios report house-to-house immunization campaigns to vaccinate children in border communities, jungle settlements, and Brazil nut harvesting camps. The Iñapari health post, on the frontier with Assis, Brazil, is leading outreach to identify minors who have not completed the national immunization schedule. The Ministry notes that Iñapari possesses all vaccines included in the national schedule and urges parents and travelers to check vaccination cards and receive free vaccines at centers or via itinerant brigades. The effort aims to raise coverage in border areas in response to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ペルーがブラジルとボリビアとの国境でのはしか予防接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: はしかの流行警報に対応した予防接種強化の報道であるが、確定した流行の詳細情報が不足している。対象国外のペルーでの事象であり、検証可能な国の確認が困難。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した発生地域にはペルー、ボリビア、ブラジルが含まれているが、記事の主題はペルーの国境地域での予防接種強化であり、ペルーとボリビアは対象国リストに含まれていない。ブラジルのみが対象国（GeoNames ID: 3469034）として該当する。記事ではペルー側での事象が中心であり、ブラジル側での確定した流行事象の詳細記述がないため、情報不足と判断される。WPRO基準は複数該当するが、対象国内での実際の発生確認が明確でないため、継続的な情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 누적 사망자 200명 넘어서..."국제사회, 1조 이상 지원키로
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 200; international community pledges more than 1 trillion won in aid.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is accelerating. Africa CDC reports 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths as of June 18, yielding a case-fatality rate around 23%. In neighboring Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths have been recorded. Active contact tracing lists 4,112 individuals under monitoring out of an estimated 35,000 contacts (about 12%). International support pledges total $910 million to aid response in DRC and Uganda, with AU member states contributing $80 million; this exceeds the earlier $51.8 million plan announced by Africa CDC and WHO. Funds should be allocated through November for emergency coordination, surveillance, diagnostics, infection prevention and control, clinical care, research, logistics, and health-service support. Officials warn that if transmission remains unchecked, required funding could rise to as much as $1.5 billion. Published June 19, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ累積死亡者200名を超える...国際社会が1兆円以上の支援を約束
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急加速、複数国での国際的拡大、国際支援規模）。エボラウイルスの確認症例875件、死亡者202名、23%の高い致死率、隣国ウガンダへの拡大が確認され、国際社会による大規模支援が実施中。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: サマリーでウガンダ（19症例、2死亡）の記述があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。本イベントは明らかに緊急対応レベルの重大感染症危機であり、即時フルRRA実施が必要。国際的な資金支援（$910百万以上）が既に動員されている段階を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Africa Region | Ebola (BVD) Epidemic - Operation Update (MDRS1007)
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda shows rapid escalation. As of 14 June, 827 confirmed cases (DRC 808; Uganda 19) and 194 deaths (DRC 192; Uganda 2). Ituri province accounts for 808 cases and 192 deaths (97.7% of cases, 99% of deaths; CFR 23.8%), with Kampala and Wakiso in Uganda reporting cases. North Kivu (67 cases, 38 deaths; CFR 56.7%) and South Kivu (3 cases, 1 death; CFR 33.3%) are also affected. Bundibugyo Ebola incubation is 2–21 days; more cases likely in the next 2 weeks amid intensified screening, contact tracing and risk communication. Insecurity and population mobility in eastern DRC hinder response; isolation facilities faced attacks in Rwampara illustrating community mistrust. Cross-border risk remains high; Africa CDC/WHO coordination and Red Cross support focus on surveillance, IPC, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ地域 | エボラ出血熱（BVD）流行 - オペレーション更新（MDRS1007）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な死亡・重症化、予想外の急速な拡大、複数国での国際拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。エボラウイルス病は最高リスク病原体であり、即座にフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでBVD（Bundibugyo virus disease）がDRC及びウガンダで報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations はDRCのみ。2026年6月19日配信のため日付が未来年だが、イベント情報として処理。Ituri州での97.7%の症例集約、23.8%のCFR、急速な拡大、国境を越えた蔓延リスク、対応の困難さ（治安悪化、施設への攻撃）があり、緊急度が極めて高い。Africa CDC/WHO等による国際支援体制が既に動員されている。

article.articleHeadline: Dấu hiệu nhận biết trẻ mắc sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Signs of dengue fever in children
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is a mosquito-borne viral disease in Vietnam, with children often presenting after abrupt high fever (39–40°C) lasting 1–3 days and poor response to antipyretics, resembling flu or COVID-19 early on. Additional signs include fatigue, reduced feeding, headache, pain behind the eyes, muscle and joint aches, and nausea or vomiting. Petechiae or unusual bruising that do not fade with pressure, and possible nasal or gum bleeding, reflect thrombocytopenia and coagulation changes. Cold extremities, reduced urination, and rapid breathing indicate circulatory involvement requiring hospital care. Signs of shock may appear as lethargy, cold/clammy skin, and a rapid weak pulse. The 3–7 day window after fever onset is a high-risk period for plasma leakage and shock. Nationwide, >50,000 dengue cases were reported in the first five months of 2026, about 2.5× 2025. Prevention: mosquito control, eliminate standing water, sleep under nets; vaccination in eligible groups can reduce risk and severity.

triage.headline_ja: 小児デング熱の兆候と識別方法
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのデング熱患者増加（2025年比2.5倍、5ヶ月間で50,000例以上）が報告されており、スクリーニング基準では重症度・流行しやすさで該当する可能性があるが、記事が症状教育・予防啓発コンテンツであり、新規感染症イベント（アウトブレイク）の直接的な通知ではないため詳細情報の続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはデング熱の症状教育と予防対策に主眼を置いているが、ベトナム全土で2026年1月～5月に50,000例以上のデング熱患者が報告されており、前年同期比2.5倍の増加が記載されている。IHR基準は公衆衛生への影響（重症度：出血症状、ショック、入院の記載あり）で1項目該当。WPRO基準は重症度（血小板減少症、凝固異常、循環不全が記載）、長期曝露（蚊媒介、広範な患者発生）、流行可能性（蚊ベクター、感染者継続発生）で3項目該当。ただし記事は公式のアウトブレイク通知ではなく、臨床教育コンテンツであるため、フルRRA前に追加の疫学情報確認が適切。

article.articleHeadline: بسبب إيبولا.. وفاة أكثر من 200 شخص في الكونغو الديموقراطية - اليوم 24
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 200 dead in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to Ebola - Youm24.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has claimed 202 lives among 875 laboratory-confirmed cases as of June 19, 2026, a 23% case-fatality rate. The outbreak, the seventeenth Ebola event in the country, was declared on May 15. African Union‑affiliated health authorities and Africa CDC warn that transmission has not yet peaked and containment could take up to a year. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which the report notes there are no vaccines or therapies available. Ongoing transmission is occurring in a central Africa setting, with no details in the article about infection sources or imported/exported cases. The data reflect updated counts from AU/Africa CDC monitoring through mid-June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱により民主コンゴで200人以上が死亡 - Youm24
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも5つ全てに該当。政府・国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模なアウトブレイク（17番目のイベント、2026年5月15日宣言）を報告。202人の死亡、875人の検査確認症例、23%の致命率。ブンディブギョウエボラウイルス株であり、利用可能なワクチンや治療法がない。アフリカ連合傘下の保健当局とAfrica CDCは、感染がまだピークに達していないと警告。遺棄地域フィールドに「Africa」も含まれているが、実際の発生地はDRCであることが明確。DRCは対象国リストに含まれているため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Regional External Update #38 West and Central Africa Region - Eastern DRC Situation - May 2026
article.articleSummary: 808 confirmed Ebola cases and 192 deaths in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo as of May 2026, spanning 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Two internally displaced people are among those affected since 15 May. The outbreak is rapidly spreading in a volatile humanitarian context marked by armed clashes, displacement, and constrained humanitarian access, compounding response challenges. No specific symptom profile, transmission source, or details on imported/exported cases are provided in the update. The figures reflect ongoing transmission and an escalating humanitarian crisis that complicates surveillance and control across the region. Response coordination continues, focusing on surveillance and cross-border collaboration; however security and access constraints hinder field operations.

triage.headline_ja: 西中部アフリカ地域地域外部更新第38号 - 東部DRC状況 - 2026年5月

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших от лихорадки Эбола в ДРК увеличилось до 232
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of deaths from Ebola fever in the DRC has risen to 232.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths (approximately 26% case fatality) as of June 19, 2026, per Health Minister Roger-Samuel Kamba. Seventy-eight patients have recovered after two consecutive negative tests, and about 6,000 contacts remain under surveillance. The outbreak remains centered in Ituri province, which accounts for 487 cases (about 94% of the total). Laboratory-confirmed cases underpin these figures, with intensified detection and contact tracing identifying patients who might otherwise have been missed. The report notes rising case numbers may reflect improved surveillance, while the international response includes funding from UN agencies and the European Union to support containment, vaccine research, and health-system strengthening in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死亡者数が232人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率（約26%）、急速な症例増加、国際的な支援体制の構築、および明確な国際的拡大リスクを示す。

article.articleHeadline: UN Allocates $4M for Uganda Ebola Response
article.articleSummary: UN allocates $4 million from CERF to Uganda's Ebola response, targeting 29 districts including refugee-hosting areas with health and logistics support. Agencies involved—IOM, UNDP, UNICEF, and WFP—focus on screening, surveillance, mobility management, risk communication, community engagement, and continuity of essential services. Julien Harneis is appointed senior Ebola coordinator to strengthen coordination and address operational challenges. The funding is part of a CERF package up to $60 million announced in late May to bolster the response. WFP has delivered more than 6,000 meals to patients, contacts in isolation, and frontline health workers. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, UN partners delivered over 16 metric tonnes of medical supplies and opened new health screening facilities at Kinshasa International Airport to strengthen surveillance. Ebola (Ebola virus disease) is a rare, often fatal hemorrhagic fever caused by orthoebolaviruses, primarily in sub-Saharan Africa, with an average fatality rate around 50%.

triage.headline_ja: 国連、ウガンダのエボラ出血熱対応に400万ドルを配分
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準で4項目全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で該当。複数国での対応と国連の大規模資金支援により社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にウガンダへの国連資金配分が主題だが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCはサマリーで医療供給支援と空港スクリーニング施設の開設が明記されており、対象国リストに含まれるため列挙した。エボラ出血熱は極めて高リスクの感染症であり、複数国での活動が確認されているため、早急なフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UN จัดสรรงบ 4 ล้านดอลลาร์ช่วยยูกันดารับมืออีโบลาระบาด : อินโฟเควสท์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UN allocates $4 million to help Uganda tackle the Ebola outbreak: InfoQuest.
article.articleSummary: UN allocates $4 million from CERF to Uganda to bolster Ebola outbreak response across 29 districts, including refugee-hosting areas. The funding, part of a CERF package up to $60 million announced in late May to strengthen response capacity, will back health and logistics operations inside Uganda. UN agencies will intensify screening, surveillance, and movement management at key entry points; IOM and UNDP are leading border controls, while UNICEF supports community engagement, risk communication, and continuity of essential health services. The World Food Programme has delivered more than 6,000 meals to patients, contacts in isolation, and frontline health workers, and is ensuring delivery of medicines and relief items. Separately, UN and partners have shipped over 16 tons of medical supplies to the Democratic Republic of the Congo this week and established a new health screening facility at Kinshasa International Airport to bolster surveillance.

article.articleHeadline: В приграничных с РФ и КНР регионах Монголии уничтожили более 2300 животных из-за ящура
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 2,300 animals culled in Mongolia's border regions with Russia and China due to foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease SAT-1, a strain not previously registered in Mongolia, is spreading in four soums of Bayan-Ölgii and Khovd aimags along the Russia–China border. As of 19 June 2026, 2,632 animals are infected, with 2,380 culled. Authorities began culling and plan vaccination from 20 June using Russian and Chinese vaccines after Mongolia signed a 12 June deal with Russia for 1 million doses and China pledged 1 million doses on 15 June. Vaccination prioritizes cattle, which show stronger symptoms; small ruminants may have milder signs. FMD is a fast-spreading viral disease of ruminants, capable of airborne transmission; humans can be infected via raw milk or dairy products. Mongolia had not recorded FMD since the 1960s and re-emerged in 2000, with types O and A most common, vaccinated against twice yearly.

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊波拉病毒奪202命　疫情恐需1年才受控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo claims 202 lives; outbreak may take a year to be under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) worsens, with 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality ~23%) due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no licensed vaccines or therapies exist. Declared May 15, this is the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak, and authorities warn containment may take up to a year. Security constraints hinder access and contact tracing, leading to low tracing coverage in conflict-affected, displacement-heavy areas. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, reporting 19 cases and 2 deaths, mainly travelers from the DRC, with no large-scale local transmission yet. Emphasis on ongoing cross-border risk and challenges from safety issues complicating outbreak response and surveillance, underscoring the need for sustained public health measures.

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Cases Rise to 896: Health Update
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 896 confirmed Ebola cases and 232 deaths in its 17th outbreak, declared May 15, with ongoing community transmission in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Twenty-one new confirmed cases, including six deaths, were recorded in Ituri and North Kivu on Wednesday. The outbreak spans 33 health zones across three eastern provinces. There are 383 patients in isolation or hospitalized; 78 have recovered (including 11 after negative tests). A total of 151 suspected cases, including 35 deaths, are reported; 6,367 contacts remain under follow-up, with 4,525 reached in the latest period (71.1% follow-up). The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, malaise, muscle pain, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and impaired kidney/liver function. Public health measures are needed to prevent rapid geographic spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染者が896人に増加：保健当局の最新情報

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情死亡病例超200例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 200.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak (Ituri Province, Bunia) has reached 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths, with 383 patients in isolation or hospital and 78 recoveries. Ongoing gaps include patient care, safe burials, and community mobilization. At a recent Ebola response video summit, donors pledged $910 million, though funds could rise to $1.5 billion if containment lags. All figures cited are as of June 18, 2026.

article.articleHeadline: Can Traditional Healers Help or Hinder Ebola Outbreak Control?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) caused by the Bundibugyo strain continues amid distrust of formal health services and reliance on traditional medicine. Early Ebola symptoms—fever, weakness, headaches, bleeding—are often interpreted as spiritual or supernatural, delaying diagnosis and fueling transmission. Traditional healers remain the first contact in many communities, a factor that can worsen outbreaks if they lack infection-control training. WHO reports previous outbreaks in North Kivu and Ituri where healers treated patients without protection, risking spread. However, trained traditional healers can play a critical role: recognizing symptoms, using PPE, practicing hand hygiene, and quickly referring suspected cases to treatment centers; some have helped with community awareness and encouraging care-seeking. Excluding them risks eroding trust; successful control relies on integration, local engagement, and partnerships with respected leaders to improve detection, referrals, and infection-control practices.

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉疫情死亡病例超200例

Uganda has 19 confirmed cases (2 deaths, 7 recoveries). Africa CDC warns the outbreak is expanding faster than response capacity, with contact tracing as a major bottleneck. To cut transmission, 90–95% of contacts must be actively traced, but about 35,000 contacts exist and only ~12% are under active follow-up. Gaps persist in case management, safe burial, and community mobilization. Donors pledged $910 million at a virtual Africa Ebola response summit; funding could rise to $1.5 billion if spread is not quickly contained.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（キンシャサ）のエボラ疫病の死亡例が200例を超える

article.articleHeadline: FG sets up task force as Ebola outbreak hits 894 cases, 204 deaths in one month
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak across Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 894 confirmed cases and 204 deaths, with 74 recoveries in the first month since the May 15, 2026 declaration. Uganda reports 19 cases, 2 deaths (case fatality 10.5%), 7 recoveries, and 100% contact listing confined to a single Kampala health zone. In the DRC, Ituri Province remains the epicenter with 91 confirmed cases, accounting for 78% of deaths; North Kivu is the most worrisome area due to insecurity limiting responder access, with 32 health zones affected across DRC and Uganda (up from three zones earlier in the week). Africa CDC official Dr Wessam Mankoula spoke during a webinar on the update. Nigeria has launched a Presidential Task Force on Ebola Preparedness, with no cases yet; subcommittees cover surveillance, border management, and inter-agency coordination, and the NCDC is intensifying airport surveillance to sustain a zero-case status.

triage.headline_ja: FG sets up task force as Ebola outbreak hits 894 cases, 204 deaths in one month
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も4つ以上該当。エボラウイルス病の複数国での集団発生は直ちにRRA対象となるシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダとDRCでの集団発生が主題。ナイジェリアは言及されているが現在確認症例なし（準備段階のため発生イベント自体ではない）。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが実際の発生地である。894例、204死亡（致命率22.8%）、複数州での拡大、1ヶ月間での急速な増加、クロスボーダー症例ありという状況は、WHO PHEIC通知相当の深刻度。

article.articleHeadline: Botswana: Boko Calls for United Front Against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Botswana's President Advocate Duma Boko urged urgent political, financial, and technical support to contain the Ebola outbreak currently affecting the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. During a high-level virtual meeting on June 16, 2026, Boko said Botswana stood in solidarity with affected countries despite having no recorded Ebola cases. He joined other African leaders in reaffirming commitment to combat the outbreak, emphasising collective action. The appeal calls for accelerated regional and international cooperation, including resource mobilization and technical assistance to bolster surveillance, containment, and response efforts. The statement underscores that containment hinges on coordinated action across borders. As of 2026-06-19, the outbreak remains centered in DRC and Uganda, with no further details provided on case counts or fatalities.

article.articleHeadline: Σποροτρίχωση: Η "νόσος του κηπουρού" εξαπλώνεται στην άγρια πανίδα της Βραζιλίας - Μπορεί να προσβάλει και τον άνθρωπο - HuffPost - Ειδήσεις και Απόψεις από την Ελλάδα και τον Κόσμο
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sporotrichosis: The "gardener's disease" is spreading through Brazil's wildlife — it can also affect humans.
article.articleSummary: Sporotrichosis (gardener’s disease) caused by Sporothrix is spreading into Brazil’s wildlife, signaling potential wild-reservoir expansion. A study along 530 km of BR-376 near the Atlantic Forest and 150 km of PR-445 near Campos Gerais analyzed 178 tissue samples from 81 animals (39 mammals, 36 birds, 6 reptiles) collected during 2017–2023. Sporothrix DNA was detected in heart, liver, lungs, and urinary bladder cysts, suggesting many animals may harbor the fungus asymptomatically. Detected in wildlife such as the South American wildcat, European hare, white-eared opossum, and agouti, and in a reptile including a species of pseudocoral snake, the findings imply broader host range. S. brasiliensis is highlighted as a significant pathogen transmitted from cats to humans and other animals. US CDC warns of potentially more severe disease; no North American cases reported. The study, published in Mycopathologia, calls for intensified surveillance and containment measures."} {
