article.articleHeadline: ยอดป่วยอีโบลา "หวนพุ่งอีก" ยืนยันติดเชื้อเฉียด 900 คน-เสียชีวิตแล้วกว่า 230 ราย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases surge again as infections near 900 and death toll tops 230.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda worsens. As of June 19, 2026, 894 confirmed cases (875 in DRC, 19 in Uganda) and 234 deaths (232 in DRC, 2 in Uganda) are reported, with at least 74 recoveries. The transmission spans 32 eastern health zones, centered in Ituri Province, with an estimated 17,000–35,000 contacts at risk, though only about 4,000 are being actively monitored (under 15%). The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment, unlike the Sudan virus strain; experimental therapies, including monoclonal antibodies and laboratory-made proteins, are under development. Contact tracing remains challenging due to remote terrain and insecurity in Ituri. Africa CDC notes this is the worst known stage of the outbreak to date, with ongoing transmission and monitoring efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱患者が再び増加 感染者数900人間近、死亡者230人以上確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大、異常性）し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の大規模多国籍流行であり、緊急のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしサマリーではウガンダへの流行拡大が明記されており、国際的拡大リスクは高い。Bundibugyo株であり、ワクチン・承認済み治療薬が存在せず、接触者の監視率が低い（4,000/17,000-35,000未満15%）。Africa CDCが「現在までの最悪段階」と述べており、重大性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情逾200死　刚果控疫恐需一年 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak has killed more than 200; Congo's containment could take a year.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak has killed over 200 of 875 confirmed Ebola cases (case fatality ~23%), Africa CDC reported on June 19, 2026. It is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, spanning Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu in the northeast, where years of conflict and displacement impede response. Security challenges and restricted access for Africa CDC, WHO, and partners have kept contact tracing rates low. The Red Cross warns the outbreak has not peaked yet and containment could take up to a year. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccine or therapy. The outbreak has also spread to Uganda, which reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, most linked to travelers from the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が200人以上の死者、コンゴの封じ込めに1年かかる可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）および重症度の高さ、流行性の懸念からシグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの拡大も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。DRCのイツリ州およびキブ州での流行が主要な問題。セキュリティ上の課題により対応が制限されており、管理可能性に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള സംശയത്തെ തുടർന്ന് കോട്ടയം മെഡിക്കൽ കോട്ടയം കോളജിൽ നിരീക്ഷണത്തിൽ കഴിയുന്ന മധ്യവയസ്കയുടെ സ്രവങ്ങളുടെ പരിശോധന ഫലം ഇന്ന് ലഭിക്കും. സൗത്ത് സുഡാനിൽ നിന്ന് ഉഗാണ്ട വഴി കേരളത്തിലേക്ക് എത്തിയ പാലാ സ്വദേശിനിയാണ് നിരീക്ഷണത്തിൽ കഴിയുന്നത്. രോഗിക്ക് എബോളയുടെ ലക്ഷണങ്ങൾ ഇല്ലെന്നും സ്വാഭാവിക നിരീക്ഷണം മാത്രമാണ് ഇപ്പോഴുള്ളതെന്നും ആശുപത്രി അധികൃതർ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Due to Ebola suspicion, the test results of the middle-aged man’s secretions under observation at Kottayam Medical College, Kottayam will be available today. A Palakkad native who arrived in Kerala via Uganda from South Sudan is under observation. The patient has no Ebola symptoms, and only routine monitoring is currently being conducted, according to hospital authorities.
article.articleSummary: Ebola suspicion in Kerala: A middle-aged man at Kottayam Medical College is under observation after arriving in Kerala from South Sudan via Uganda, with Palakkad origins. He currently exhibits no Ebola symptoms; routine monitoring continues. Kerala lacks an on-site Ebola testing facility, so his samples have been sent to the National Laboratory in Pune for laboratory confirmation. Results are expected today; a positive result would confirm the case, while absence of symptoms keeps the patient under observation pending lab confirmation. An Infectious Diseases Board has been formed for ongoing management, led by Medical College Principal Dr. Varghese P. Punnoose and Hospital Superintendent Dr. TJ Thomas Jacob, with Deputy Superintendents Dr. Saderuddin Ahmed, Dr. Frederick Paul, and Dr. Sam Christie Mammen, and heads of Community Medicine, NeuroMedicine, and Microbiology. Current status: under observation awaiting test results.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い例：ケーララ州コッタヤムの医療大学で、南スーダンからウガンダ経由でケーララに到着した中年男性が観察中。患者は現在、エボラ症状を示していない。日常的な監視が続行中。
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の疑い患者が対象国インドで確認され、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。また、WPRO基準では流行感受性（ヒト-ヒト感染可能性）と重症度基準に該当し、複数のスクリーニング基準を満たすため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケーララ州コッタヤムの医療大学におけるエボラ疑い患者の観察について記述。南スーダンおよびウガンダは患者の感染源地としてサマリーに言及されているが、実際の疾患発症地はインドであり、verified_locationsはインドのみ。患者は現在症状なし、検査結果待機中。感染症疾患委員会が組織されており、インド当局の対応体制が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : deux ministres à Bunia pour évaluer les activités de la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Two Ministers in Bunia to Assess the Response Activities - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo escalates after its May 15, 2026 resurgence, driven by the Bundibugyo strain—the 17th Ebola event in the DRC. The epicenter is Ituri province, notably the Mongbwalu mining area, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, and even Kampala, Uganda. By mid-June, the official tally exceeds 650 confirmed cases and over 130 deaths in the DRC, prompting the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment. On June 19, 2026, two Congolese ministers arrived in Bunia to assess the one-month response and coordinate with the new governor, marking the third government mission in 30 days to strengthen on-ground actions to halt transmission and improve the response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ブニアに駐在する2人の大臣が対応活動を評価 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern(PHEIC)宣言済みで、国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCのIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州およびウガンダのKampalaでのエボラ発生が述べられているが、発生の主体はDRCであり、ウガンダへの拡大は二次的な言及。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、Bundibugyo株はワクチンなし、有効な治療法なし。650例以上の確定例と130人以上の死亡が報告されており、フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Por qué regresó el ébola y una advertencia para la próxima pandemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why Ebola Has Returned and a Warning for the Next Pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is unlikely to become a global pandemic, but it underscores funding cuts and preparedness gaps for a true disease X threat. The piece recounts the 1976 discovery near Yambuku in present-day DRC by Jean-Jacques Muyembe and the lab work of a 27-year-old Peter Piot that confirmed Ebola after a nun’s blood sample in Antwerp; the early outbreak carried mortality approaching 90%. The current outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with bats as the suspected reservoir and spillover through wildlife and human-to-human transmission; diagnostics, therapies, and vaccines are not effective against Bundibugyo, complicating containment. The WHO declared the outbreak on May 17; several countries imposed travel bans on people from the region, and the U.S. planned to evacuate patients to a quarantine center in Kenya. The article frames this as a stress test for global health systems and post-COVID-19 funding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが再び現れた理由と次のパンデミックへの警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つ全て該当。エボラ感染症の流行は高い重症度と致死率を有し、複数国での対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事で明記されているのはDRCでのエボラ流行。ベルギー（アントワープ）は1976年の歴史的発見地の言及のみであり、現在の流行地ではない。ケニアは米国による患者疎開先として言及されているが、発生地ではない。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による流行で、現有診断法・治療法・ワクチンが無効という管理困難性、WHO公式宣言（5月17日）、複数国による渡航制限が確認される高リスク事象。

article.articleHeadline: Diễn biến mới về dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New developments in the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda report the worst Ebola outbreak to date, per Africa CDC on June 18. There are 894 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 200 deaths, with the outbreak roughly three times larger than Uganda’s 2000 event, and cases rising 38% week over week across 32 health zones in eastern DRC. Ituri province accounts for more than 90% of cases, with spillovers to North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border transmission into Uganda (19 confirmed cases, 2 deaths). The Bundibugyo virus strain drives this outbreak; there is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo, unlike the Zaire strain, which has vaccines. By now, 74 patients have recovered in DRC and Uganda. Contact tracing is hindered by Ituri’s remoteness and instability; only about 4,000 of an estimated 17,000–35,000 contacts are monitored (<15%). Funding (~US$900 million pledged; $90 million disbursed) and staffing (84 of 540) remain strained.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行に関する新しい動向
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、死亡例、国際的拡大、ワクチン・治療法なし、管理能力不足など極めて高いリスク。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行。894例の検査確認例、200人以上の死亡。Bundibugyo株で承認ワクチン・治療法なし。ウガンダへの国境を越えた感染拡大（19例、2死亡）。接触追跡率15%未満で管理能力が著しく不足。資金・人員ともに不足。Africa CDCが6月18日時点で報告。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : les sages-femmes alertent sur le manque d'équipements de protection - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Midwives Warn of Protective Equipment Shortage - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province remains the epicenter, with more than 80% of cases concentrated there one month after the outbreak was declared. Midwives in Ituri warn of a critical shortage of personal protective equipment (PPE) for frontline health workers, risking exposure as they assist births in maternities. Despite government assurances from Health Minister Samuel Roger Kamba that protection kits are being distributed, field reports by Synasafco secretary-general Louis Lubieno describe persistent PPE gaps in facilities, endangering patients and staff. The Congolese Syndicate calls on national authorities, international partners, and local NGOs to provide urgent, effective assistance. Newborns continue to be delivered during the crisis, underscoring the ongoing need for adequate infection prevention measures even as the outbreak persists.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ：助産婦が保護具不足について警告 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全項目該当。DRC国内での活動中の大規模発生で、医療従事者のPPE不足が報告されている。
triage.notes: DRC（対象国リストに含まれる）のイトゥリ州でのエボラウイルス病発生。発生宣言後1ヶ月で症例の80%以上がイトゥリに集中。医療従事者のPPE不足による曝露リスク、妊娠・出産時の感染対策の不備が顕著。国際的支援の必要性が明確に示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Seven dead, 35 JE cases Reported in Assam so far in 2026
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, Japanese Encephalitis (JE) has claimed seven lives and 35 confirmed JE cases in Assam this year, with 470 AES cases and 32 AES deaths reported. The AES-JE season runs June–August. The National Health Mission, Assam, reported ongoing preparedness measures including enhanced surveillance, case management, hospital readiness, vaccination activities, and inter-department coordination since February 2026. Initiatives include training nodal medical officers, deploying district coordinators, strengthened referral mechanisms, ensuring essential medicines, and expanding JE vaccination coverage. A JE death involved 30-year-old Narbahadur Chetry of Panikhaiti, Guwahati. Early JE symptoms include high fever, stiff neck, and severe headaches. No laboratory confirmation or infection source details are provided beyond JE-confirmed cases; no imported/exported case data are mentioned.

triage.headline_ja: アッサム州で日本脳炎による7人の死亡、2026年の患者数は35人に
triage.triage_reason: 日本脳炎による複数死亡者と確定患者の発生、加えてAES症例470件・死亡32件の報告があり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常性を示している。インド国内の季節性流行であるが、重症度と長期曝露の懸念がWPRO基準を満たし、シグナル認識に値する。
triage.notes: 季節性AES-JE流行（6月～8月）の開始時期であり、アッサム州での準備体制は整っているが、既に7人の死亡と35人の確定患者が報告されている。AES全体では470症例・32死亡となり、公衆衛生上の実質的な影響が確認されている。入院患者数や地域内の流行拡大状況の詳細は記事サマリーに記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases near 900 as health officials warn of continued spread
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached 896 confirmed cases and 232 deaths, with health authorities warning of continued community transmission and potential geographic spread. In the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, 21 new confirmed infections and six additional deaths were recorded on Wednesday, elevating the outbreak across 33 health zones. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is implicated. Currently, 383 patients are in isolation or hospital treatment, and 78 have recovered; 11 more recovered after follow-up tests. There are 151 suspected cases, including 35 deaths, reported on Wednesday. Contact tracing remains active, with 6,367 individuals identified for follow-up; 4,525 were reached in the latest period, a monitoring rate of 71.1%. The update underscores sustained transmission and the need for continued surveillance and response across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ確認症例が900に近づき、保健当局が継続的な拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（896確認症例、232死亡）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、継続的な地域感染とさらなる地理的拡大の可能性、国際的拡散リスクが明確。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo strain）の大規模、持続的なアウトブレイク。33の保健地域に拡大、継続的なコミュニティ伝播、接触者追跡中（6,367人、到達率71.1%）。外部支援（国際的介入）の必要性が明確。フルRRA優先度が最高。

article.articleHeadline: Eksperti noraizējušies: bīstamais vīruss izplatās straujāk nekā gaidīts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts are worried: the dangerous virus is spreading faster than expected.
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 200 deaths, with Africa CDC reporting 204 fatalities, including two in neighboring Uganda. A total of 894 confirmed cases have been recorded, of which 875 are in the DRC; 74 people are recovered. Contact tracing remains severely limited, with 4,112 identified contacts, while estimates suggest about 35,000 contacts exist. Health ministry spokesperson Vesams Mankoula warned the situation is far from under control. Ebola spreads via direct contact and bodily fluids, posing a deadly threat. The current outbreak is particularly hard to contain because there is no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bandibadi Ebola virus strain. At present, the outbreak is three times larger than the second-largest outbreak on record in its first month.

triage.headline_ja: エキスパートが懸念：危険なウイルスが予想より急速に拡大している
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（200死亡、894確認症例）で、IHR基準4つ全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全てに該当。国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも2人の死亡が報告されているが、主たる発生地はDRC。ワクチンなし・治療法なしのBandibadi株による大規模アウトブレイク。初期段階で過去2番目の規模の3倍に達しており、極めて重大な公衆衛生上の緊急事態。接触者追跡が著しく限定的（4,112人特定されたが、推定35,000人）で管理可能性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ ускоряет разработку вакцин против нового штамма Эболы в Африке
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO accelerates the development of vaccines against a new Ebola strain in Africa
article.articleSummary: As of June 19, 2026, the Bundibugyo Ebola strain outbreak spans the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with over 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths, numbers likely underestimated due to transmission in remote, conflict-affected Congo regions. There are currently no licensed vaccines or approved therapeutics for this strain. The World Health Organization and partners are accelerating vaccine and treatment development. The leading candidate is an rVSV-based vaccine adapted to Bundibugyo, leveraging the platform used for the licensed Ebola vaccine. Additional contenders include a ChAdOx1-based vaccine being developed by Oxford University in collaboration with the Serum Institute of India, and an mRNA vaccine from Moderna. The outbreak underscores ongoing spread in remote areas of Congo and spillover risk to neighboring Uganda, with containment hinging on rapid international research and collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがアフリカにおける新しいエボラ株に対するワクチン開発を加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、新株の出現、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。新しいBundibugyo株による多数の死亡者と複数国への拡大、ワクチン・治療薬不在が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでの発生を言及しているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。Bundibugyo株は新規変異株で、既存のEbolauavirワクチンでは対応できない。875例以上の確認症例と202例の死亡が報告されており、遠隔地での感染が続行中で実数はより多い可能性あり。WHOが複数のワクチン開発候補を加速している点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Najstarsza epidemia dżumy? Naukowcy znaleźli dowody sprzed tysięcy lat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The oldest plague epidemic? Scientists have found evidence dating back thousands of years.
article.articleSummary: Ancient DNA from four hunter-gatherer cemeteries beside Lake Baikal shows plague-causing Yersinia pestis bacteria in 18 of 46 individuals (~39%), a prevalence higher than in some medieval plague pits. The findings, published in Nature, indicate a highly lethal early plague epidemic before flea-driven transmission became common. The cemeteries contain numerous child and adolescent burials, a pattern aligning with the large-scale mortality. The study links these ancient strains to a previously unknown superantigen, a toxin-related feature not seen in later plague variants, offering a possible mechanism for severe immune reactions and deadly disease. The authors argue the data support a Central/Northeast Asian origin for plague, spreading into Eurasia via wild rodents after crossing from Asia. Close contact with marmots among the hunter-gatherers could have enabled direct zoonotic spillover to humans.

triage.headline_ja: 最古のペスト流行？科学者が数千年前の証拠を発見
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は数千年前の古代ペスト流行に関する古病理学的な考古学研究であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。現在の公衆衛生上の脅威を示す証拠がない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが検出した「Kingdom of Thailand」および「Bangkok」は、記事が古代湖バイカル地域の遺跡から回収されたDNAについて述べている点と一致しない。記事サマリーは中央/北東アジアの古代ハンター・ギャザラー集団に関する過去の事象を説明しており、現在進行中のペスト発生ではない。現在の感染症監視対象外の学術報告であるため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: GHS to reach 8 million people with drugs on Neglected Tropical Diseases
article.articleSummary: Ghana Health Service will conduct a nationwide Mass Drug Administration from 20 June to 3 July 2026, targeting nearly eight million people with preventive treatment against three neglected tropical diseases: onchocerciasis (river blindness), lymphatic filariasis (elephantiasis) and schistosomiasis (bilharzia). Free medicines will be distributed in 86 onchocerciasis-endemic districts across 15 regions; about 266,000 people in two elephantiasis-endemic districts will receive treatment; schistosomiasis deworming will be carried out in 13 districts across eight regions. Eligible participants include all except children under five years, pregnant women, and those with a prior severe reaction. WHO-endorsed MDA is described as safe and essential. Ghana reports progress: LF transmission interrupted in 114 of 117 endemic districts; onchocerciasis and schistosomiasis nearing elimination in several areas. Milestones include Guinea worm (2015), trachoma (2018) and sleeping sickness (2023). Donor support is declining; calls for increased domestic funding and a National NTD Fund.

triage.headline_ja: GHS、顧み られていない熱帯病の医薬品で800万人に到達予定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は公衆衛生キャンペーン（予防的MDA）の実施予告であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイク、異常事例、または公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告していない。既知の風土病に対する計画的な制御活動である。
triage.notes: 記事は顧みられていない熱帯病（NTD）に対するガーナの予防的MDA（Mass Drug Administration）キャンペーンについての公式発表である。これは計画的な公衆衛生介入であり、新規アウトブレイクや緊急事態ではない。ガーナの進捗（LFの伝播遮断114/117地区、オンコセルカ症とビルハルツ住血吸虫症の排除段階）は肯定的である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 38 लोगों ने कभी नहीं किया कंडोम का इस्तेमाल, हिमाचल के जनजातीय क्षेत्रों में तेजी से बढ़ रहा STD; रिपोर्ट ने चौंकाया - himachal tribal areas see rising std risk 33 percent people never use condom study reveals
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 38 people have never used condoms; STDs are rising rapidly in Himachal's tribal areas; the report shocks — study reveals that 33 percent of people never use condoms.
article.articleSummary: In Himachal Pradesh’s tribal areas, a 12-month study of 3,000 people aged 15–49 (1,000 per district: Chamba, Kinnaur, Lahaul-Spiti) found sexually transmitted disease (STD) symptoms in 20% of participants. Conducted with IGMC Shimla’s Community Medicine Department via tribal development authorities, the survey highlights low condom use: 24.9% used at last sex, 38% did not, and 33.1% never used condoms. STD awareness is moderate (72% have heard of STDs) but knowledge is limited; only 12.3% completed the treatment course, while 90.2% sought care at government facilities. District-wise prevalence peaks in Chamba (24.2%), followed by Kinnaur (20.1%) and Lahaul-Spiti (15.7%). Most infections occur among 35–44-year-olds (33.5%), with 54.3% male and 45.7% female participants; 61.7% are married, and 61.4% report monogamous relationships. The study urges intensified awareness, timely testing, complete treatment, and expanded rural health access to curb transmission and underreporting in remote areas.

triage.headline_ja: ヒマチャルプラデシュ州の部族地域でSTD（性感染症）が急速に増加、調査によると33％の人がコンドームを使用したことがない
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は性感染症に関する疫学調査報告であり、急性の感染症アウトブレイクを示していない。既知の疾患である性感染症の有病率調査であり、IHR基準やWPRO基準の該当が認められず、公衆衛生の急速な危機をもたらす要因がない。
triage.notes: 本件は既知疾患（性感染症）の有病率調査報告であり、新規アウトブレイク、異常発生、または予期しない公衆衛生上の危機の兆候がない。社会的・政治的関心も限定的。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Пациенты с Эболой сбегают из больниц в Конго из-за голодного кризиса
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patients flee hospitals in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid a hunger crisis.
article.articleSummary: Nearly 900 people in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo are infected with Ebola, with over 25% fatalities. Since late May, more than 150 Ebola patients have fled treatment and isolation centres in search of food, including an incident in the Mongbvalu district where 11 patients left a hospital due to shortages. Health workers are tracing about 6,400 individuals who may have been exposed. The hunger crisis is hindering outbreak control as communities face a trade-off between quarantine and sustenance. The World Food Programme estimates at least $175 million is needed to sustain humanitarian operations in Congo through November. International actors, including the G7, are coordinating the response to the Ebola outbreak in Africa as the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の飢餓危機によるエボラ患者の病院からの脱出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症による死亡（25%超）、患者の隔離施設からの脱出による感染リスクの拡大、国際的な感染拡大リスク、および国際支援・移動制限の必要性が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国東部の約900人のエボラ感染、25%超の致命率、150人以上の患者が食料不足により隔離施設から脱出したことを報告している。飢餓危機が感染制御を妨害し、6,400人以上が曝露の可能性がある状況。G7を含む国際的なアクターが対応を調整中。WFPが1億7,500万ドル以上の人道支援が必要と指摘。すべての基準で懸念が確認されるため、フルのRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Пацієнти з Еболою тікають із лікарень у Конго через голодну кризу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Patients with Ebola flee from hospitals in Congo due to a hunger crisis.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has grown to nearly 900 people affected, with more than 25% mortality. Since the end of May, over 150 Ebola patients have fled treatment and isolation centers seeking food, including an incident near Mongbalu where 11 patients escaped. Health authorities are tracing about 6,400 potential contacts. Hunger is severely hindering containment, forcing families to choose between quarantine and survival. The World Food Programme warns that hunger directly undermines outbreak response. To sustain humanitarian operations in the DRC through November, at least $175 million is needed.

triage.headline_ja: 患者がエボラから脱出 コンゴの飢饉危機のため病院から脱走
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の患者逃走、複数国への国際拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WPRO基準でも全5項目該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で死亡率25%以上、患者隔離破綻により制御困難。国際的な人道支援が必切実なフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最優先度の国際的脅威。患者の隔離施設からの大量逃走は接触者追跡を著しく困難にし、制御不可能な流行拡大リスクを高める。飢饉による人道危機が感染症対策を直接阻害している点が特に懸念される。約6,400名の濃厚接触者追跡中との情報あり。DRCの医療インフラ限界と国際的な支援体制の緊急性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola fuera de control en África: Ya van más de 200 muertos en un mes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Out-of-control Ebola outbreak in Africa: more than 200 deaths in a month.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda has caused over 200 deaths in its first month, with 894 confirmed cases by mid-June 2026. It is the worst at this stage, triple the size of Uganda’s 2000 outbreak (281 cases). The surge centers in eastern Congo’s Ituri province (>90% of cases) and has spread to North and South Kivu, with Uganda reporting 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. Bundibugyo has no vaccines or approved treatments; experimental monoclonal antibodies are under development. Contact tracing is hampered by insecurity and displacement, with only about 4,000 of an estimated 17,000–35,000 contacts traced. Nearly 1 million people displaced in Ituri. Africa CDC notes $90 million disbursed of more than $900 million pledged and only 84 of the needed 540 staff deployed, underscoring calls for faster funding.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで制御不能なエボラ出血熱の流行：1ヶ月で200人以上の死亡者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当する高リスクシグナル。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる大規模流行で、確認症例894件、死者200人超、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、セキュリティと資源の深刻な課題がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo型エボラの発生地をコンゴ民主共和国（特にIturi州、South Kivu、North Kivu）に特定し、ウガンダへの波及（19確認症例、2死亡）も記載。ただし対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。資金不足（$900M中$90Mのみ支給）と人員配置の不十分さ（540人中84人）により、国際支援の必要性が明確。接触者追跡の不完全性と大規模な人口流動がさらなる拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS menține alerta: Ebola a ucis peste 200 de persoane în Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO maintains the alert: Ebola has killed over 200 people in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in North-East Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) has surpassed 200 deaths with 875 laboratory-confirmed infections and 202 fatalities as of mid-June 2026; the cluster was officially declared May 15. The Bundibugyo virus strain has no vaccine or specific treatment. In Uganda, 19 cases and 2 deaths have been confirmed; Africa CDC reported Uganda’s situation under control as of June 11. WHO maintains an international health alert, with very high public health risk in the DRC, high regional risk, and low global risk. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids, with hemorrhagic fever symptoms. The region’s accessibility is hindered by poor road infrastructure and armed-group insecurity, complicating response efforts. NGOs warn of severe gaps in health-system organization. The epicenter is Ituri, raising cross-border spillover concerns into Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: WHO保健警報を継続：エボラがコンゴで200人以上を殺害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。Ebola（致死率高い）の確認された流行で、200人以上の死亡、国際的なウガンダへの越境リスク、及び国際保健警報発令中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus strain（ワクチン未開発、特異的治療なし）による確認流行。ウガンダでも19症例・2死亡と越境伝播が既に生じており、国際的な懸念は高い。記事ではウガンダの状況が「管理下」と報告されているが、DRCの情勢は不安定で医療体制が脆弱。WHO国際保健警報発令中であり、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: سيستخدم مركز السيطرة على الأمراض 107 مليون دولار من التمويل الطارئ لاستجابة إيبولا في جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية وأوغندا - ميزو نيوز
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The CDC will use $107 million in emergency funding for the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda - Mezu News
article.articleSummary: CDC allocates $107 million in emergency funding for Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, addressing Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), a rare Ebola virus illness. The western DRC/eastern Uganda border outbreak is the third-largest on record. As of June 15, 2026, 837 confirmed cases in the DRC and 19 in Uganda have been reported, with 198 total deaths across both countries; about 31 health zones in the DRC are affected, and Kampala, Uganda has 31 cases. The case fatality rate for this outbreak is estimated at 30–50%. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, body fluids, and contaminated surfaces; the global risk remains low. The US CDC deploys 23 field staff and 125 other personnel in the two countries. Total Ebola response funding rises to about $910 million, with donor contributions under 10%. CDC aims to control the outbreak in both nations and maintain internal readiness for spillover.

triage.headline_ja: CDCは民主共和国コンゴとウガンダでのエボラ対応に緊急資金1億700万ドルを使用 - Mezu News
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。進行中の多国間エボラ流行で確定患者837例、死亡198例、CFR 30-50%と重篤。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaとUSAも記載されているが、記事サマリーを注意深く読むとウガンダは境界地域での限定的な確認（19例）であり、主流行地はDRCである。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみに該当。進行中の流行で国際機関による積極的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 美FDA專家力挺莫德納流感疫苗　剛果伊波拉疫情告急 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. FDA experts back Moderna's influenza vaccine; Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is dire
article.articleSummary: Influenza vaccination breakthrough in the United States as FDA advisory committee unanimously (9-0) endorses Moderna's mRNA influenza vaccine for adults aged 50 and older, signaling the first seasonal mRNA flu vaccine. Simultaneously, Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo remains dire as WHO's PHEIC enters its second month; health systems are collapsing with shortages of healthcare workers, ambulances, and even construction materials for isolation wards. Africa CDC notes that only a fraction of pledged funds—less than 10% of the $910 million—has arrived; CDC has activated $107 million in emergency funds to support outbreak response. Also, the United States moves to address flu season by approving Roche's single-dose antiviral Xofluza for influenza. Overall, US regulatory decisions spur vaccination advances while Ebola response faces critical funding and logistics gaps in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 米FDAの専門家がモデルナのインフルエンザワクチンを支持　コンゴでのエボラ疫情が深刻化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラは既知の高リスク病原体で、DRCでPHEIC発令中、国際的な資金・支援ギャップが存在し、複数の公衆衛生上の脅威が組み合わさっている。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は東部DRCでのエボラ疫情の深刻化。WHO PHEIC発令中で2ヶ月目、保健システムの崩壊、医療従事者と医療物資の深刻な不足、資金ギャップ（誓約額の90%未到着）が報告されている。米国でのインフルエンザワクチン承認はコンテキスト情報であり、主たるシグナルはエボラ。地域検証により対象国リストのDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Viêm gan B kèm nhiễm xoắn khuẩn gây vàng da
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis B with spirochete infection causing jaundice
article.articleSummary: 42-year-old man in Ho Chi Minh City with chronic hepatitis B and cirrhosis, irregular antiviral therapy, was laboratory-confirmed to have Leptospira infection causing jaundice. At Tam Anh General Hospital, he presented with ten days of fever. Liver enzymes were 5–10× ULN; total bilirubin 106.9 μmol/L and direct 60.9 μmol/L, with evident jaundice. Leptospira bacteria inhabit water, moist soil, and environments contaminated by animal urine, especially rats. Coexisting chronic liver disease can worsen hepatic injury and may precipitate renal dysfunction, hemorrhage, sepsis, and multi-organ damage if untreated. After antibiotic therapy and liver-supportive care, fever subsided, jaundice diminished, and discharge occurred after two weeks. Leptospirosis is not rare in Vietnam but often overlooked due to flu-like early symptoms. Prevention focuses on environmental hygiene, rodent control, protective clothing when cleaning damp areas, and proper wound care.

triage.headline_ja: B型肝炎と螺旋菌感染を伴う黄疸
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのレプトスピラ症と慢性B型肝炎の併発事例。個別事例に基づき、単一症例報告にとどまるが、ベトナムでレプトスピラ症が見落とされやすい公衆衛生課題として記述されている。情報不足のため WATCH で経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事は単一症例（42歳男性）のホーチミン市での事例報告。レプトスピラ症は水・湿潤環境・動物尿汚染環境に生息し、ベトナムでは「稀ではないが見落とされやすい」と述べられている。スクリーニング基準で重症度（多臓器障害リスク）、長期曝露（環境汚染源）、流行易感性（ネズミ媒介、初期症状の非特異性）の3項目に該当するが、国家レベルの流行警報や国際的な拡大の具体的証拠は記述されていない。地域検証はベトナム（対象国リストに含有）を確認。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC Warns Ebola Outbreak In Congo And Uganda Kills Over 200 As Cases Rise Fast - The Logical Indian
article.articleSummary: As of 19 June 2026, Africa CDC warns of a fast-spreading Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (eastern regions) and neighboring Uganda, with over 894 confirmed cases and more than 200 deaths in the first month across 32 health zones, and cross-border transmission into Uganda. The rare Bundibugyo strain appears to drive transmission, with case counts rising 38% in one week. Contact tracing is severely constrained, with fewer than 15% of an estimated 35,000 exposed individuals traced, hampered by conflict, displacement, difficult terrain, and insecurity. The outbreak unfolds in conflict-affected, remote areas, stressing fragile health systems and raising regional spillover risk via informal trade routes and population movement. Uganda has intensified cross-border surveillance along affected frontiers, but surveillance and response remain strained.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCがコンゴとウガンダのエボラ感染症アウトブレイクを警告 - 200人以上の死亡、症例が急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な死亡と症例数、Bundibugyo株という稀な変異株、国際的拡大リスク、地域的な渡航制限リスク）。また、WPRO基準でも異常性、重症度、高い流行性が認められ、社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、エボラアウトブレイクは主にDRC東部で発生し、ウガンダへの越境伝播が確認されている。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株は稀な変異株であり異常性が高い。接触追跡が15%未満と大幅に制約されており、紛争・難民移動・難アクセス地域という地政学的複雑性がある。第1ヶ月で894確定症例、200人以上の死亡は深刻度が高く、週38%の症例増加速度は急速な拡大を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 782 cas confirmés et 181 décès, l'Ituri demeure l'épicentre de la 17e épidémie (bilan du 13 juin)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths, Ituri remains the epicenter of the 17th Ebola outbreak (as of June 13).
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo reports 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths (case fatality 23.1%) as of June 13, with Ituri remaining the epicenter. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC and the first linked to Bundibugyo; there is no vaccine or specific treatment for this strain, unlike the Zaïre-targeting Ervebo. The outbreak spans three provinces: Ituri (20 health zones), North Kivu (10), and South Kivu (Miti-Murhesa; 1), affecting 31 health zones. By June 13, 56 patients had recovered and 359 were in isolation or hospital; contact follow-up stood at 56.5%. Transmission is rising, with cases increasing more than eightfold from 63 on May 22 to 515 by June 6; WHO notes intensified transmission and a higher regional risk. Response relies on standard public health measures. Security challenges and community mistrust hamper sample transport and contact tracing; a helpline (151) exists; PHEIC declared May 17.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラ出血熱：確認患者782例、死亡181例、イトゥリが第17次流行の震源地（6月13日時点）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、新規Bundibugyo株での異常、地域発生による国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。PHEIC宣言済みで国際支援が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株による初のエボラ流行であり、Zaïre型対応ワクチン（Ervebo）が効果なし。感染が指数関数的に増加（5月22日の63例から6月6日の515例へ8倍以上）。セキュリティ上の課題と地域への不信が対応を阻害。PHEIC宣言済み（5月17日）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola patients flee treatment centres in Congo for food as hunger crisis deepens
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has infected almost 900 people and killed more than a quarter, as of 19 June 2026. Hunger and food insecurity in eastern Congo drive isolation challenges, with more than 150 escapes from Ebola treatment and isolation facilities since late May; about 6,400 people may have been exposed. Ituri Province accounts for more than 90% of confirmed cases, with the epicenter around Mongbwalu; incidents include 11 suspected patients fleeing a hospital in Bambu, 40 km from the outbreak center. The World Food Programme distributes hot meals at treatment centres and to contacts and affected families, delivering 590 meals in one day. WFP seeks $175 million for Congo operations, including $32 million for Ebola activities; funding shortfalls hamper response amid a broader hunger crisis affecting nearly 10 million people.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者が食糧確保のため治療センターから逃げ出す—コンゴの飢饉危機が深刻化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致命性と感染力を持ち、約900人が感染、死亡者は25%超、150人以上の患者が治療施設から逃亡して約6,400人の曝露リスクが生じている。国際的な感染拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクも高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にDRCのIturi州Mongbwalu周辺でのエボラ発生を主題としている。Bambù（イタリア）およびVeneto州は地理的な参照位置（40km距離表示の文脈）であり、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。患者逃亡による大規模曝露、食糧危機による対応困難、WFP資金不足など複合的なリスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: NAJMANJE 90 MRTVIH I 12.000 ZARAŽENIH! Kolera hara Nigerijom, broj žrtava raste!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At least 90 dead and 12,000 infected! Cholera ravages Nigeria, death toll rising!
article.articleSummary: Nigeria’s Borno state reports a cholera outbreak with at least 90 deaths and more than 12,000 cases since it began in early May. Humanitarian agencies, led by UN OCHA, are expanding treatment, case-surveillance, and access to safe water to curb transmission, with an additional $4 million from OCHA-managed funds allocated to emergency response; more funding is needed for prevention and care. Borno, in northeastern Nigeria, has long faced conflict and humanitarian crises that hinder control of infectious diseases. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola numbers rose to 635 confirmed cases and 127 deaths as of June 10, with 22 recoveries; new cases have not ignited widespread spread across health zones. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain was reported May 15 in a setting already affected by conflict across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, making this one of the largest Ebola outbreaks in the world.

triage.headline_ja: 少なくとも90人の死亡、12,000人の感染！コレラがナイジェリアで猛威を振るい、死亡者数が増加！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、長期曝露のリスクが高い。複数国・複数疾患の同時多発が検出された。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア（ボルノ州）のコレラアウトブレイク：90人以上の死亡、12,000人以上の感染。DRCではEbola（Bundibugyo strain）635確認症例、127死亡。両国とも長期的な紛争と人道的危機により疾病管理が困難。複数疾患・複数国での同時発生はIHRリスク評価の高優先事項。国際支援（UN OCHA等）が既に展開されているが、追加資金が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Riset BRIN: Limpa Bisa Jadi Tempat Persembunyian Parasit Malaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: BRIN Research: Limpa Could Be a Hiding Place for Malaria Parasites.
article.articleSummary: Malaria can hide in the spleen, not just in the blood, complicating elimination in Indonesia. BRIN researchers, including Ari Winasti Satyagraha of Eijkman BRIN, reported findings from Steven Kho (Menzies School of Health Research, Darwin, Australia) that the spleen may serve as a reservoir for Plasmodium vivax and Plasmodium falciparum, allowing parasites to persist outside peripheral blood and evade standard tests, potentially enabling asymptomatic carriers to retransmit to mosquitoes. The discovery emerged from a 12 June 2025 webinar on the spleen’s role in malaria pathogenesis. Concurrently, red blood cell disorders—G6PD deficiency, thalassemia, Hemoglobin E (HbE), and Southeast Asian Ovalocytosis (SAO)—arise under malaria pressure and can confer protection by inhibiting parasite growth, accelerating clearance of infected cells, or boosting immune responses. Implications for Indonesia’s elimination efforts are significant, highlighting the need for spleen-focused surveillance and integration of host genetics into control strategies.

triage.headline_ja: BRIN研究：脾臓がマラリア寄生虫の隠れ場所となる可能性
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのマラリア排除戦略に影響する重要な科学的発見であり、寄生虫の貯蔵部位や無症候性キャリアに関する異常な知見が報告されている。ただし、現在の流行状況や公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響に関する情報が不足しており、フルRRA前の経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: この記事は学術的な研究発見（脾臓がマラリア寄生虫の貯蔵庫となる可能性）に焦点を当てており、現在進行中の流行や患者数増加の報告ではない。オーストラリアは研究関係者の所属機関の所在地のみであり、実際のマラリア発生イベントはインドネシアに限定される。無症候性キャリアの存在はマラリア排除努力に対する重要な含意を持つため、今後の疫学的影響を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Study Explains How Anti-CRISPR Protein Promotes The Spread Of Hospital-Acquired Infections
article.articleSummary: Klebsiella pneumoniae, a common cause of hospital-acquired infections such as pneumonia and meningitis in immunocompromised patients, spreads antibiotic resistance via plasmids that carry resistance genes. Researchers from Skoltech in Russia, with U.S. and Chinese colleagues, report in PNAS that although K. pneumoniae harbors a CRISPR-Cas immune system targeting the resistance-carrying plasmid, the plasmid uses anti-CRISPR proteins to suppress immunity, enabling persistence and spread. The team identifies AcrIE9 and AcrIE10 as two anti-CRISPR proteins that typically operate in tandem, and also discovers a previously uncharacterized anti-CRISPR protein that may target bacterial DNA rather than CRISPR proteins. Experiments with E. coli showed the same plasmid can invade diverse species, suggesting anti-immunity genes facilitate conjugative plasmids and outbreaks of drug-resistant infections. The study recommends monitoring anti-immunity genes alongside resistance genes, with future work aiming to reactivate bacterial immunity to remove resistance plasmids.

triage.headline_ja: 抗CRISPR蛋白がいかに院内感染の拡散を促進するかを説明する研究
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究論文の報告であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク事象ではなく、疾患監視の対象外。社会的・政治的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 記事は基礎研究（Skoltech、米国、中国の協力研究）の学術報告であり、実際の感染症患者発生やアウトブレイク事象ではない。疾患名「E. coli」は研究実験の対象菌として言及されたもの。発生地域に記載されている国々は研究機関の所在地を示しているに過ぎず、実際のイベント発生地ではない。感染症監視シグナルとしての価値はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolas upuru skaits Kongo DR pārsniedz 200
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in DR Congo surpasses 200.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri in the east, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu) reports 875 confirmed infections and 202 deaths, according to Africa CDC on 2026-06-19. Over the past week, confirmed cases rose 38%, though the true burden is believed higher since the outbreak was confirmed only on May 15 after symptoms began weeks earlier. Seventy-four recovered. Ituri houses the vast majority of cases (over 90%). Cross-border transmission is evident, with 19 infections and two deaths reported in neighboring Uganda. The report notes no additional laboratory details beyond Africa CDC figures; no specifics on symptoms or infection sources are provided. The situation indicates an ongoing, regional Ebola outbreak necessitating continued surveillance, containment, and cross-border cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。確認感染者875人、死亡者202人で深刻な公衆衛生影響がある。ウガンダへの越境感染が確認されており国際的拡大リスクが明白。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの越境感染報告（19感染、2死亡）があるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため含める。2026年6月19日時点でのデータ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: une épidémie sans vaccin, des groupes armés et une défiance populaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: an outbreak without a vaccine, armed groups and public mistrust
article.articleSummary: Seventeenth Ebola outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo on May 15 after Kinshasa’s lab confirmed Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The epicenter is Ituri province, notably Bunia, with 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths reported early on. A Congolese national died in Kampala, Uganda, marking an imported case; Uganda later reported 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths and closed its border with DRC. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; Africa CDC warned ten African countries are at risk. Bundibugyo has no vaccine or specific treatment; existing vaccines protect only Zaire ebolavirus, so control relies on isolation and contact tracing. Bunia airport has been suspended to facilitate humanitarian access. Africa CDC hopes a Bundibugyo vaccine by year-end; trials are underway. Testing capacity is weak; within two weeks there were about 1,140 suspected cases and 246 deaths. Local mistrust and violence hinder the response; Tedros visited Kinshasa and Bunia urging containment. International travel restrictions and visa policies vary.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ：ワクチンなしの流行、武装勢力と国民の不信
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo種）の国際的流行で、死亡例、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの輸入例、10アフリカ国が危険）、WHOによるPHEICの宣言により、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）の流行で、既存ワクチンは無効（ザイール種のみに有効）。ウガンダでも輸入例19例、死亡2例報告。国境閉鎖、WHO PHEIC宣言。地域の不信と暴力が対応を阻害。国際支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Количество умерших от лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго увеличилось до 232
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of deaths from Ebola virus disease in the DR Congo has risen to 232.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached 232 deaths and 896 confirmed cases, as of June 18 in the government daily bulletin. Transmission remains ongoing among residents in districts affected by the outbreak, with health authorities warning of the risk of further spread to other regions within the DRC. Reuters reports the health authorities’ concerns. Japanese researchers have stated that Ebola virus carriers from Africa could reach major European and Asian transit hubs within a month. Financial Times described the Congo outbreak as a dress rehearsal for a new global pandemic, citing shrinking health funding and waning public trust in science. An Evening Moscow article discusses what the virus is, its danger, its potential reach toward Russia, and available treatments. The report emphasizes international concern and potential implications for travel and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱による死者数が232人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模集団発生で深刻な公衆衛生影響、進行中の人間への伝播、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性があり、即座にフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、エボラ出血熱の発生地がコンゴ民主共和国と明記されており、死者数232人、確認患者数896人と具体的な統計が示されている。日本の研究者による国際的な懸念も記載されている。Bluedot APIで「Russian Federation」が発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーではロシアは発生地ではなく、ウイルス運搬のリスク評価の文脈でのみ言及されているため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en Congo y Uganda supera las 200 muertes en un mes y África CDC advierte que aún está lejos de ser controlado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda has surpassed 200 deaths in a month, and Africa CDC warns that it is still far from being under control.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda has surpassed 200 deaths in its first month, with 894 confirmed cases and up to 35,000 contacts under follow-up. Ituri Province accounts for more than 90% of cases, with additional spread in North and South Kivu amid movement and access challenges. Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, signaling cross-border transmission. The Bundibugyo variant lacks approved vaccines or specific therapies. Cases rose 38% in a week as surveillance expands to 32 health zones. About 74 recoveries have been reported. A major barrier is contact tracing: for 800+ cases, 17,000-35,000 contacts would require monitoring, but only around 4,000 are under surveillance. Ongoing conflict, displacement (nearly 1 million in Ituri), and mining-driven mobility impede response. Africa CDC needs 540 workers but has 84; funding (over $900 million pledged) remains largely undisbursed, with ~90 million released.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴとウガンダのエボラ出血熱感染流行が1ヶ月で200人以上の死亡を超過、アフリカCDCは依然としてコントロール下にないと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の確認事例、国境を越えた感染拡大、管理体制の不備が明確。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目に該当。
triage.notes: ウガンダも記事で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCにおいてBundibugyo亜種エボラウイルスの大規模流行が進行中。1ヶ月で894確定例・200人以上の死亡、国境越え伝播（ウガンダ19例2死亡）、管理体制の深刻な不足（追跡対象35,000人に対し実施4,000人のみ）、紛争・難民移動による対応困難が特徴。資金問題も大きい。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ужасът Ебола: Вирусът се крие в тялото години след оздравяване и може да удари отново
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola Horror: The virus hides in the body for years after recovery and can strike again.
article.articleSummary: Persistent Ebola virus infection: A Nature Microbiology study shows Ebola can linger in the brain long after clinical recovery. Using lab-grown mini-brains, scientists found Ebola can infect brain immune cells—astrocytes and microglia—and immune molecules produced in these models fail to clear the virus, implying current treatments may not fully eradicate persistence. Survivors may develop meningitis, brain inflammation, or ocular disease months after infection, and researchers identified a mutated, longer-lasting but defective viral genome in late-stage persistent infections, raising questions about its impact on human disease. The team aims to determine whether such persistence occurs in people. The finding occurs during an ongoing Ebola outbreak in Africa as of 2026-06-19, with about 200 deaths and hundreds of cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with rising cross-border cases detected in Uganda. Ebola spreads via contact with blood or bodily fluids; bats are thought to be the natural reservoir.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの恐怖：ウイルスは回復後も体内に数年間潜伏し、再び発症する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの持続感染に関する重要な科学的知見と、2026年6月時点でのDRC・ウガンダでの現在進行中の流行の併報。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが全て認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、現在進行中のエボラ流行は民主共和国コンゴでの主要な発生地であり、ウガンダでも越境例が検出されていると記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはDRCのみを列挙した。エボラウイルスの持続感染メカニズムに関する新知見（脳内の免疫細胞への感染、変異ゲノム検出）は臨床的に重要であり、現在進行中の流行との組み合わせで高い優先度評価を正当化する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Claims More Than 200 Lives in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, the 17th Ebola outbreak, concentrated in Ituri province in eastern DRC, accounting for >90% of 875 confirmed cases and 202 deaths (case fatality 23%) within its first month since declaring outbreak on May 15. By June 19, 2026, 67 recoveries and 379 patients in isolation or hospitalized have been reported. The northeastern provinces Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu face conflict-driven insecurity; contact tracing hampered by remoteness and security challenges, delaying control. A Red Cross official warned the peak may still be ahead and containment could take up to a year. The outbreak has spilled across the border to Uganda, with 19 confirmed cases and two deaths. The Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccines or treatments, compounding response difficulties.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがコンゴ民主共和国で200人以上の死亡者を出す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当する。エボラ出血熱の国境越え拡大、高い死亡率、社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの国境越え感染（19確定例、2死亡）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ただし記事の主要な感染症イベント発生地はDRCであり、当該国が明確な対象国である。Bundibugyo virus（ワクチン・治療法未承認）による第17次エボラアウトブレイク、28日以内の875例・202死亡（致命率23%）、紛争地での接触追跡困難、最大1年の封じ込め予測など、極めて高リスク。フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Ébola aumentam quase 40% numa semana, número de mortos ultrapassa os 200
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases rise nearly 40% in a week; the death toll surpasses 200.
article.articleSummary: On 19 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo and Uganda has reached 894 confirmed cases and over 200 deaths in its first month, three times larger than Uganda’s 2000 outbreak (281). Confirmed on 15 May, the cluster spans 32 health zones, with Ituri province accounting for more than 90% of cases; North Kivu and South Kivu report cases, and Uganda has 19 cases and two deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo, while Zaire ebolavirus—more common in Congo—has a vaccine. About 74 people have recovered; experimental monoclonal antibodies are being developed for Bundibugyo. Contact tracing is hampered by insecurity and displacement in Ituri (nearly one million) and miners’ movements. Africa CDC estimates 17,000–35,000 contacts for roughly 800 confirmed cases, but only about 4,000 have been traced; funding shortfalls persist: over $900 million promised, only about $90 million available; 540 responders needed, 84 deployed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の症例が1週間でほぼ40%増加、死亡者数が200人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は重篤な公衆衛生脅威であり、DRCおよびウガンダでの大規模アウトブレイク（894確定例、200死亡）は異常かつ予想外。国際拡大リスク（既にウガンダで19例）と渡航制限リスクが存在。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事内で症例（19例、2死亡）が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による初のアウトブレイクで既承認ワクチン/治療薬がない。資金不足（900百万ドル約束のうち90百万ドルのみ利用可能）と接触者追跡困難が懸念される。
